jobs.title: Staff FrontEnd Engineer - Platform - App Core Usage | Canada | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity:

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise.

The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculations, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts.

This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana Cloud scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana Labs also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope.

What You’ll Be Doing:

The Usage squad owns the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations and customer usage calculations. Our domain encompasses maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, cost management and billing applications, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the customer user portal.

Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. We build full-stack web applications, customer portals, backend services, APIs, and data integrations across internal Grafana platforms and third-party systems like NetSuite and Salesforce. When this domain works well, customers get clear usage visibility, reliable billing, and seamless account management workflows. This role is about 75% FrontEnd and 25% BackEnd.

  • Design, build, operate, and evolve reliable full-stack web applications, customer-facing account portals, and backend services that power core customer usage and billing workflows
  • Build and maintain backend APIs (Golang, Node.js) and intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend technologies (TypeScript, React)
  • Design and maintain integrations between Grafana systems and external business platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Develop and automate business logic for customer usage metering, pricing structures, promotions, and billing reconciliation
  • Collaborate across product management, DealOps, GTM, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads to deliver robust end-to-end features
  • Address technical debt, optimize CI/CD pipelines, strengthen test coverage, and improve system observability and operational resilience
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while shaping pragmatic solutions for complex systems challenges
  • Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations
  • You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe.

We are seeking a Staff FullStack Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and user experience are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain.

You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams.

Some things you might be expected to do could include:

  • Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code
  • Designing new microservices or systems
  • Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions
  • Coordinating with product and UX when needed
  • Responding to customer requests and feedback
  • When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation
  • Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization

Requirements:

  • You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience
  • You have worked on a big SaaS platform and dealt with common distributed systems problems (e.g. scalability, multi-tenancy, data isolation, HA, …)
  • Strong professional experience with backend technologies (Golang, Node.js) as well as modern frontend web development (TypeScript, React)
  • Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on
  • Have some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, and brainstorming ideas to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way
  • You write clean, robust, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain
  • Have experience with mentoring junior engineers in a collaborative but asynchronous environment
  • Can take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve tight learning loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively
  • You are willing to work across teams. Your work has to be aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders. You make your plans transparent, bring stakeholders on board, and are open to feedback and suggestions
  • Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.)

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with high-volume usage metering, billing engines, or customer-facing cost management applications
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining integrations with third-party business systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Cloud Marketplaces)
  • Experience with frontend component libraries, design systems, and modern CSS-in-JS tooling
  • Familiarity with cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS provisioning/tenancy patterns
  • Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems
  • Experience with incident response involving configuration drift, partial failure, or cross-service state mismatch

In Canada, the compensation range for this role is $186,368 - $223,642 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

WHO WE ARE:

As a member-owned, not-for-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.

You excel at partnering with stakeholders, leading Agile initiatives, and managing enterprise-wide software solutions from requirements gathering through implementation and support. With strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, you drive process improvements, optimize system functionality, and serve as a trusted technical advisor who delivers high-quality solutions that enhance operational efficiency and business performance.

  • Drives efficient and effective joint business/IT requirements and solution discussions in addition to stakeholder review meetings.
  • Provide high-quality analytical system solutions for key stakeholders.
  • Proactively identifies software functional gaps and opportunities of improvement.
  • Collaborates with product owners to create product backlog by using Agile practices.
  • Creates user stories with relevant acceptance criteria.

  • Keep application users regularly informed on progress and resolution for all application issues reported and in alignment with internal service level agreements using clear and proactive communication.
  • Collaborate and coordinate with third-party service providers or other internal technical teams to address software needs-based solutions and production issues with implemented resolutions and consistent follow-up.
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with business line, other internal technical teams, and third-party service providers needed to improve Enterprise-wide software solutions.

Golden 1 Credit Union provides its employees a market-competitive and internally equitable total rewards compensation package through a variety of programs. These programs are designed to attract, motivate, and retain employees that drive and support the achievement of Our Mission, Vision, and Strategic Goals. jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Solutions Architect to join its ANZ Team, specifically focused on working with our Neo Clouds and their customers on stand up and operational excellence.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Solutions Architect to join its ANZ Team, specifically focused on working with our Neo Clouds and their customers on stand up and operational excellence. Ideally the successful candidate would be located in either Sydney or Melbourne. Enterprise, Government and Academic Research groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to redefine deep learning and data analytics, and to power data workloads. Be involved with the crew developing many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with Neo Clouds, customers, partners and various departments, to analyze, define and implement and operate large scale AI Operational projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of System Building, Kubernetes-based platforms, Automation, Hardware and Networking.

What you'll be doing:

  • Maintain large scale computational and AI infrastructure, focusing on monitoring, logging, workload orchestration (Kubernetes and Linux job schedulers).

  • Optimize scalable, production-ready Kubernetes-based container platforms coordinated with enterprise-grade networking and storage.

  • Serve as a key technical resource, develop, refine, and document standard methodologies and operational guidelines to be shared with internal teams.

  • Perform end-to-end resolving across the stack, from bare metal and operating system, through the software stack, container platform, networking, and storage.

  • Support Enterprise, Research & Development activities and engage in POCs/POVs to validate new features, architectures, and upgrade approaches.

  • Deploy monitoring solutions for the servers, network and storage with a focus on services performance and availability optimisations to meet requirements and SLAs.

  • Develop tooling to automate deployment and management of large-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self-service consumption of resources.

  • Create and deliver high-quality documentation, including runbooks, onboarding materials, and best-practice guides for customers and internal teams.

  • Become the technical leader for assigned customer accounts, providing strategic guidance on DevOps and platform architecture and influencing long-term infrastructure and operations decisions.

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields, with 5+ years of professional experience in managing scalable cloud environments and automation engineering roles.

  • Kubernetes & AI/ML Workloads: Extensive experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration, resource scheduling, scaling, and integration with HPC environments.

  • Cloud & HPC Expertise: Proven understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP stack), data center architectures, and hands-on experience managing HPC/AI clusters, including deployment, optimization, and fixing issues.

  • Hardware & Software Knowledge: Familiarity with HPC and AI technologies (CPUs, GPUs, high-speed interconnects) and supporting software stacks.

  • Linux & Storage Systems: Deep knowledge of Linux (RedHat/CentOS, Ubuntu), OS-level security, and protocols (TCP, DHCP, DNS). Experience with storage solutions such as Lustre, GPFS, ZFS, XFS, and emerging Kubernetes storage technologies.

  • Automation & Observability: Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, configuration management, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform). Experience with observability stacks (Grafana, Loki, Prometheus) for monitoring, logging, and building fault-tolerant systems.

  • Solution Architecture & Customer Engagement: Strong background in crafting scalable solutions and providing consultative support to customers.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for software deployment and automation.

  • Solid hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and container-based microservices architectures.

  • Experience with GPU-focused hardware and software (e.g., NVIDIA DGX, CUDA, GPU Operator).

  • Background with RDMA-based fabrics (InfiniBand or RoCE) in HPC or AI environments.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Dutch-speaking Customer Care Agent
jobs.excerpt: At myPOS, we’re all about helping businesses grow and get paid.
jobs.description:
At myPOS, we’re all about helping businesses grow and get paid. We make payments simple, smart, and accessible for everyone, but we’re more than just payment solutions — myPOS is a partner in growth. From free multicurrency accounts to powerful e-commerce tools, we’re here to support business owners of all sizes and everyone out there who dreams of starting their own business.

As we expand our team, we’re looking for a Dutch-speaking Customer Care Agent to help us make a real difference in the fintech industry. Ready to join us and shape the future of payments? Let’s make it happen!

About the role

As a Customer Care Agent at myPOS, you’ll handle a variety of day-to-day interactions: helping merchants get set up, explaining how a payment was processed, or seeing a more complex account issue through from start to finish. It’s fast-moving, hands-on, and no two days are quite the same.

What you’ll do

  • Be the friendly, knowledgeable point of contact for Dutch-speaking merchants and business owners across chat, email, and phone;

  • Take ownership of customer issues from first contact through to resolution — you’ll follow up, close the loop, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks;

  • Help customers understand their accounts, navigate our products, and get real value from the platform — in clear, easy-to-understand Dutch;

  • Act as the customer’s advocate internally, working with specialist teams across the business, such as Payments Operations or Account Verification, to get complex cases resolved faster;

  • Explain technical or financial topics, such as payment flows, fees, or account status, in a way that’s easy to understand and free of jargon;

  • Share patterns and feedback from customer conversations with the wider team to help us improve our products and customer experience.

This role is perfect for you if you have

  • Fluency in Dutch and a solid command of English, both written and spoken;

  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing role — experience in a call centre, BPO, or customer support environment is a great foundation;

  • The ability to explain technical or financial concepts in plain, friendly language — you make the complex feel simple;

  • A calm, composed approach when things get busy or complicated, and a genuine enjoyment of helping people;

  • Comfort working with digital tools and systems, and a good eye for detail;

  • An interest in fintech, payments, or business technology — if you’ve worked with payment systems or POS solutions before, that’s a strong advantage;

  • Adaptability — myPOS moves fast, and you’re someone who sees change as an opportunity rather than a disruption.

Why you should join myPOS

  • Vibrant international team operating in a hi-tech environment;

  • Annual salary reviews, promotions, and performance bonuses;

  • myPOS Academy for upskilling and training;

  • Unlimited access to courses on LinkedIn Learning;

  • Annual individual training and development budget;

  • Refer-a-friend bonus, as we know that working with friends is fun;

  • Teambuilding, social activities, and networks on a multinational level.

What we offer

  • Excellent compensation package;

  • 25 days annual paid leave, plus 1 additional day per year up to 30 days;

  • Full “Luxury” package health insurance, including dental care and optical glasses;

  • Meal vouchers of 102.26 EUR per month;

  • Fully covered Multisport card;

  • Free coffee, snacks, and drinks at the office.

Who we are

Since 2014, we’ve been all about making payments easier and more accessible for businesses of all shapes and sizes. Whether they’re at the counter, selling online, or on the move, we’ve got businesses covered with smart, accessible, and affordable solutions that keep things easy.

Our mission? It’s simple. Help businesses get paid by taking advantage of modern technology and innovative ideas, so payment challenges become a thing of the past.

Pro tip

Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Rhinelander

Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses(preferred)

29.5

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$83.69 - $180.25

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

Why Parallels, why now

Yaqeen is a nonprofit on a mission to pioneer Islamic research in creative, cutting-edge formats tailored to meet people where they are. We’re seeking like-minded professionals who embody Islamic values including sincerity, excellence, and compassion, and want to make a difference in the faith of people worldwide.

Role Overview

We are seeking a seasoned Data Engineer to join our Engineering team. You will design, build, and operate the data platform that powers analytics, research, and product decisions across the organization. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable modeling complex datasets, engineering resilient pipelines, and managing the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will own systems from ingestion and transformation through to the warehouse layer, and you will set the standards that keep our data trustworthy. Beyond building, you will partner closely with analytics, product, and platform teams to define how data moves through the organization and to raise the bar for reliability, quality, and governance.

Data Modelling & Transformation

  • Model and structure data for analytical and operational use, owning the transformation layer and its tooling, including dbt
  • Design data models that are clear, well documented, and easy for downstream teams to build on
  • Define and enforce data contracts and schema standards in collaboration with upstream and downstream engineering teams

Pipelines & Orchestration

  • Design and build scalable batch and streaming data pipelines across ETL, ELT, and change data capture patterns
  • Orchestrate and schedule workflows using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
  • Ensure pipelines are observable, recoverable, and well instrumented, with monitoring and data quality checks that catch issues before they reach consumers

Data Warehousing & Infrastructure

  • Architect and optimize our modern data warehouse, including storage layer design, table formats, and compute and query engine integration
  • Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure as code, and manage deployment and container orchestration
  • Implement privacy, anonymization, and governance controls to keep sensitive data protected and compliant

Collaboration & Communication

  • Participate in planning and requirements discussions to raise data quality and modeling concerns before development starts
  • Translate requirements from analysts, researchers, and product engineers into robust data models and reliable delivery
  • Keep engineering and the wider organization connected through transparent, timely communication

Qualifications

  • Advanced SQL, including performance tuning and complex analytical query design
  • Advanced Python for pipeline development, tooling, and automation
  • Familiarity and hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, AliCloud, or an equivalent
  • Data warehousing: expert knowledge of one modern platform (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Redshift), including architecture, storage layer design, table formats, and compute and query engine integration
  • Experience developing and orchestrating data pipelines across ETL, ELT, CDC, and stream processing
  • Data modeling and tooling expertise, including dbt
  • Experience with modern orchestration tools like Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure tooling, including Terraform, Helm, and Kubernetes or equivalent
  • Experience defining and enforcing data contracts or schema standards in collaborative engineering environments
  • Exposure to privacy and anonymization implementations
  • Background in a SaaS, startup, or product-led environment is a plus
  • Familiarity with data observability and lineage tooling such as Sentry or Datadog is a plus

Assignment

  • Technical assessment assigned after candidate screening.

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

The Role

Moderna continues to expand its innovative mRNA platform, unlocking new applications across diseases and therapeutic areas. As the company advances its oncology pipeline, including intismeran autogene, a personalized investigational mRNA therapy being developed in collaboration with Merck, this role will play a critical part in preparing for the potential launch of Moderna’s first commercial therapeutic in oncology.

Moderna’s intismeran autogene (INT) program represents an exciting advancement in personalized cancer treatment, leveraging the power of mRNA technology to develop therapies tailored to each patient’s unique tumor profile. This innovative approach has the potential to redefine the future of cancer care and marks a significant milestone in Moderna’s evolution beyond infectious diseases. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the commercial launch of a pioneering oncology program and play a foundational role in building Moderna’s oncology business.

Moderna is seeking a Sr. Director, Regional Sales, West, who will build, lead, and develop the West Region Oncology Sales team to drive regional sales strategy and execution for a co-promoted solid tumor oncology asset. This role is accountable for regional sales performance, oncology launch excellence, performance management and field execution across complex account ecosystems, while partnering closely with an alliance partner. The role requires deep expertise in oncology, and knowledge of account dynamics, experience building high performing teams, strong communication skills, analytical skills, ability to execute while partnering closely with the alliance, as well as proven leadership in a launch environment. This position is also responsible for building key business relationships with multi-disciplinary stakeholders across key health systems, accounts and large practice networks.

You combine strong sales and people leadership expertise with deep oncology knowledge and are comfortable partnering with alliance or other matrix partners to drive solutions that are best for patients and business. You are a collaborative thinker who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and brings a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

  • Manage and deploy resources to ensure the achievement of objectives and manage regional budgets to ensure appropriate utilization of funds.
  • Ensure full compliance with Moderna policies and all applicable healthcare laws and regulations.

  • Ability to travel up to 75%

  • Prior experience in melanoma is highly preferred
  • Experience successfully launching and executing in an alliance relationship is highly preferred.

  • Proven ability to utilize market knowledge and analytics to drive regional strategies, effective targeting, and achievement of sales goals

  • High adaptability, solution-oriented mindset, comfort operating in ambiguity and a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape
  • Exceptional interpersonal, leadership, communication and influencing skills

ABOUT US

ARRISE sets the benchmark for service delivery and excellence in the iGaming industry. Playing a key role in the success of its clients, which include Pragmatic Play, a brand relied upon by the world’s biggest online casinos for its cutting-edge products, ARRISE helps to deliver exceptional gaming experiences to millions of players worldwide.
Our global team of over 13,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon.

To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed — while embracing every step of the journey.
Be part of the future of iGaming with 13,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join our Data Science team as a Data Scientist working at the applied-research end of computer vision. You will frame open-ended problems as testable hypotheses, develop prototypes to validate them, and choose the model architectures and methods best suited to each. Computer vision is the core domain, with scope to work across text, audio, and tabular data. Working with ML Engineers, you will help take validated prototypes into production and see them run at scale.
Even if you don't meet every requirement, your skills and ability to deliver impact are what matter most.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Design and prototype ML and deep learning models, with computer vision as the primary domain (object detection, classification, tracking).
  • Frame business problems as testable hypotheses and develop proofs-of-concept to validate them, iterating on the results.
  • Evaluate and benchmark competing model architectures and pre-trained models to identify the best-fit approach.
  • Collaborate with ML Engineers to scale validated prototypes into production systems and stay engaged through deployment.
  • Track experiments, manage model and data versioning, and define evaluation metrics to compare approaches objectively.
  • Work with product, engineering, and business teams to turn objectives into applied ML solutions.

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

  • Master's degree in a relevant field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Hands-on experience developing ML and deep learning models, including demonstrated computer vision work.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and a deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Experience with computer vision models for object detection, image classification, and tracking.
  • Solid grounding in deep learning, traditional computer vision, and classical ML.
  • Strong experimentation mindset: benchmarking, ablation studies, and structured evaluation of competing approaches.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets.

Nice to have

  • Experience collaborating with ML Engineers to bring models into production.
  • Experience with any major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) for ML training and deployment.
  • Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, vision transformers, or self-supervised / representation learning.

How we work

Our stack includes Python with PyTorch and TensorFlow, experiment tracking and model versioning, containerized deployment with Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Data Scientists and ML Engineers work together across the full lifecycle, from early research through to models running in production.

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

  • Work on substantial, real-world computer vision and deep learning problems at scale.
  • End-to-end involvement, from research and prototyping through to production.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional environment with visible impact.

jobs.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Lab Automation and Orchestration.
Lab automation is where science meets engineering. Robotics, liquid handlers, instruments, and scheduling software are moving labs from manual work toward automated, data driven, and eventually autonomous operation. While we are supporting fully automated labs, most labs still run as islands. Instruments speak different languages, workflows are hard to change, and the data that comes off the line rarely arrives ready for analysis or AI.

We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Lab Orchestration and automation are core to our Molecule to Market story, and they connect directly to the strengths of Siemens in industrial automation. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.

This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with lab automation leaders at pharma, biotech, CDMOs, and research institutes across the UK and Europe, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to the lab automation market with confidence and one consistent story. You’ll work with industry thought leaders to shape the conversation on autonomous labs and AI. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in lab automation. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win.

How you’ll spend your time

  • Customer engagements: meeting automation leaders, scientists, and engineers, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business
  • Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors and automation vendors, and spotting trends early
  • Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win
  • Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the lab automation audience
  • Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on self driving labs and the future of the automated lab
  • Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get labs running on Luma and putting AI to work on automated workflows and data
  • Partner and ecosystem engagement: working with instrument makers, robotics providers, and integrators so our joint story is clear to customers
  • Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the lab automation market

The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to lab automation buyers, and turn that into real software adoption.

What you’ll do

  • Own the market strategy for Luma in lab automation, including workflow orchestration, scheduling, instrument integration, data capture, and autonomous lab concepts
  • Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority accounts, including Heads of Lab Automation, Automation Engineers, Discovery Technologies, Research IT, Core Facilities, and Operations leaders
  • Build positioning and messaging that speaks to automation engineers, scientists, IT leaders, and executives
  • Drive software adoption by working with customers and field teams to find the workflows where Luma delivers value fastest, and by capturing what works so others can repeat it
  • Define and prove AI use cases for lab automation, including closed loop experimentation, smarter scheduling, and data prepared for tools like NVIDIA BioNeMo
  • Translate automation pain points into clear value, including less integration work, faster workflow changes, better use of instruments, trusted data, and a clear path from automation islands to connected labs
  • Partner with the Siemens Solution Marketing team to build content, campaigns, and events for the lab automation market
  • Work with industry thought leaders, analysts, and partners to build credibility and bring outside voices into our story
  • Create the competitive view against other informatics vendors, scheduling and orchestration tools, automation vendors, and in house builds
  • Develop the business case, pricing inputs, and value story with Finance and Sales
  • Equip global teams with talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and customer proof points
  • Partner with DISW and DI Automation teams to align messaging, joint offers, and customer conversations
  • Partner with Product on roadmap priorities based on what automation teams tell us
  • Connect lab automation to the bigger Molecule to Market narrative, including ELN, Biologics, and Tech Transfer
  • Support strategic pursuits and executive conversations with customers and partners
  • Track market trends, including autonomous labs, AI driven discovery, robotics, and data standards, and turn them into action

We are looking for people who have 10 or more years in life sciences, lab automation, or scientific technology, with hands on experience in a pharma, biotech, CDMO, research institute, or automation vendor setting. You will bring Strong analytical skills, including sizing markets and building a business case excellent writing and presentation skills. Ideally holding a degree in life sciences, engineering, robotics, or a related field, with a Masters or PhD a plus

The key skills

  • Deep understanding of how automated labs work day to day, including liquid handling, robotics, instrument integration, workflow scheduling, and the data that flows from them
  • Knowledge of how automation leaders make decisions, balance speed, cost, and flexibility, and work with scientists, IT, and engineering teams
  • Experience in product marketing, market strategy, product management, or commercial roles at a software, automation, informatics, or life sciences solutions company
  • Familiarity with scheduling and orchestration software, LIMS, ELN, or lab data platforms
  • A track record of driving software adoption, or of turning new technology such as AI into use cases customers actually adopt
  • Proven ability to turn complex science and technology into clear, simple messaging
  • Comfort working with senior leaders, industry experts, and customers
  • Ability to work across a large, global, matrixed organisation and build trust with teams in different regions and business units
  • Right to work in the UK

Nice to have

  • Experience running or supporting a lab automation team or an automated lab build
  • Knowledge of industrial automation concepts and how they apply to the lab
  • Familiarity with lab data standards and open interfaces
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, or data platforms in a scientific setting
  • Existing relationships with industry thought leaders, analysts, automation vendors, or research institutes
  • Experience working across the UK and European life sciences community

What success looks like

  • A clear lab automation market strategy adopted by Sales, Product, Services, and Solution Marketing
  • Messaging and sales tools that teams around the world actually use
  • One consistent story for lab automation across Dotmatics, DISW, and DI Automation
  • Growing software adoption and a library of proven AI use cases in lab automation
  • Industry voices who help tell our story
  • Growing pipeline and wins tied to lab automation
  • Automation leaders who can say, in their own words, why Luma helps them connect their labs and move toward autonomous operation

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Per Diem - Burlington

Job Location: Work at Home, Iowa, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

Interpretation Services
Accurately interpret oral statements from one language into another in real-time during court proceedings.

Position Title:

  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.

Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.

  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.

The role also carries responsibility for mentoring and developing Key Account Managers, strengthening the team's account strategy and execution. This position is designed to build the next generation of commercial leadership within a vertically integrated medical device manufacturing environment.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end commercial relationship for Exalta's most strategically significant OEM accounts, serving as the senior point of contact across multiple product lines, programs, and sites.
  • Lead the customer S&OP cadence for assigned strategic accounts, driving rollout, phased maturity, and ongoing governance in partnership with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP.
  • Develop account-level strategic plans that align customer growth expectations with Exalta's capacity and operational constraints.
  • Represent Commercial Operations in executive-level customer business reviews, contract discussions, and new program launch conversations.

SIOP Integration & Demand Ownership

  • Serve as the senior demand data owner for assigned strategic accounts within the SIOP process; validate and reconcile the highest-exposure forecast inputs ahead of the monthly demand review gate.
  • Own forecast accuracy performance for the largest accounts in the portfolio, identify variance drivers, and present trends into the SIOP executive alignment as needed.
  • Partner with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to ensure customer demand inputs are reflected accurately in the SIOP demand plan, surfacing capacity risk early.
  • Support new product introduction onboarding for strategic account programs, coordinating across quality, planning, and operations at the program level.

Escalation & Customer Experience Ownership

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues across assigned strategic accounts, providing strategic direction rather than case-level handling.
  • Own root-cause resolution for significant service disruptions, partnering with planning, supply chain, and quality to protect delivery commitments.
  • Drive proactive, executive-level communication with customers on constraint impacts, delays, or substitutions.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach Key Account Managers on account strategy, escalation handling, and demand data ownership.
  • Provide the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP with structured input on Key Account Manager performance, account coverage, and development needs.
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new Key Account Management team members.

Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Own KPI reporting for the Key Account Management team, consolidating on-time delivery, backorder, and fill rate performance across the portfolio.
  • Identify systemic trends across accounts and lead continuous improvement initiatives in customer operations, demand management, and order fulfillment workflows.
  • Contribute to ERP (Epicor) and Power BI reporting enhancements supporting Commercial Operations and SIOP objectives.
  • Ensure all customer-facing operations comply with FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and company quality standards.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Customer Focus — advanced ability to build and sustain executive-level relationships with OEM customers.
  • Leadership and Mentorship — proven ability to guide and develop Key Account Managers.
  • Business Acumen — strong understanding of OEM contract manufacturing economics, capacity constraints, and account profitability drivers.
  • Conflict Resolution and Negotiation — expertise managing complex, high-stakes customer issues to resolution.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking — ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account strategy.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of large, complex OEM accounts simultaneously, balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery commitments.

REQUIRED / PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field required; Master's degree a plus.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position operates in a professional office environment with periodic interaction with manufacturing and warehouse functions. Travel to customer sites and offices may be required (approximately 20%, generally on a quarterly cadence). Must be able to maintain composure and professionalism in high-visibility, executive-level customer escalation scenarios.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US AND ABOUT YOU

Clinician Nexus enables health care organizations to build thriving clinician teams with industry-leading technology products, workforce and compensation analytics, and automated workflow solutions. Backed by extensive technical expertise and industry-leading data, we deliver innovative approaches to help clients to plan, educate, and engage their clinical workforce at every stage of the lifecycle. We are committed to providing our clients with outstanding guidance and support as they focus on shaping the future of health care.

As a Data Platform Engineer your core responsibility revolves around crafting, advancing, and maintaining the infrastructure and systems essential for managing and optimizing data as an enterprise asset. In this capacity, you will create and maintain tooling, abstractions, and services that allow enterprise users to meticulously oversee the entire lifecycle of their data product, encompassing the efficient collection, storage, processing, and retrieval of data, all while upholding stringent standards for security, governance, and data quality. You will possess extensive expertise in working with diverse data storage technologies, including databases, data lakes, and data warehouses, as well as streaming architectures and service layer technologies. You are proficient in programming languages such as Python, Scala, Java, and SQL. Your skillset extends to encompass data integration, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, ELT (Extract, Load, Transform), Restful/GRPC services, Streaming, and the construction and abstraction of robust data pipelines. The overarching objective as a Data Platform Engineer is to enable enterprise product teams to deliver quality data products that drive business insight and value to our customers. This includes building tooling and services that connects data sources to data consumers and ensures the accessibility, structural integrity, and reliability of data to fulfill analytical and business imperatives.

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Collaborate with data platform architects to design and specify platform tooling, services, and integrations
  • Build data lake and lake house architectures
  • Build streaming data architectures to support data platform tooling and services
  • Collaborate with software teams to integrate streaming and batch architectures with software products
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to MVP optimal solutions
  • Collaborate with data governance teams and data platform architects to build governance into technical solutions
  • Maintain systems and services that provide transparency and observability into our critical systems
  • Implement and promote engineering and architectural patterns, perform code reviews, and collaborate in architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with product team data engineers and architects to MVP data products, maintain data models, and promote data modeling best practice
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to product and data engineers, guiding their growth and professional development and enabling their ability to use platform tooling and services
  • Lead by example through hands-on contributions to designing, coding, and troubleshooting complex data systems
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks and optimization opportunities within data pipelines, databases, and processing frameworks
  • Optimize data processing workflows to improve efficiency and reduce latency
  • Lead efforts to diagnose and resolve data-related incidents in a timely manner
  • Will participate in the grooming of stories
  • Will be responsible for their own tasking towards the completion of stories
  • Will mentor junior members of the team and guide junior members on best practice
  • Will participate in design
  • Will be responsible for the quality of their own code and will participate in code review of others product
  • Will be responsible for integrating their own code with the team's DevOps plan and implementation

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years relevant experience
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology or a related computer degree or equivalent experience. Master’s degree is a plus
  • Must know and have proficiency in one object or object/functional programing language. Preferably Python
  • Must know common object and object/functional design patterns. Builder, factory, façade, context, etc.
  • Must have proficiency with Apache Spark
  • Must know data lake and lake house design principles, OLTP (Online Transaction Processing) design principles, document data stores, and graph
  • Must know and understand how to build ELT/ETL patterns in a distributed compute system. Preferably Databricks
  • Must know and have proficiency with common data quality tooling and the design of configurable systems to front end that tooling
  • Must know and have proficiency with common systems and data observability tooling
  • Must know standard practices of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Must have proficiency in standard SDLC concepts and tooling including unit and integration testing frameworks like Pytest, IDE features like debugging, testing practices like mocking, CICD tooling like Github actions, build tooling (poetry), GIT
  • Must have proficiency in creating and using basic Restful or GRPC services
  • Must have proficiency in message bus and streaming technologies and understand common event stream architectures
  • Knowledge of the health care industry is a plus

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Work location is remote. Minimal travel. Must be physically able to perform the essential functions of the job.

SALARY, BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Medical and dental coverage at no premium cost for employees
  • 401(k) and profit-sharing retirement plans
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Generous paid time off (PTO)
  • Company paid holidays
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Bereavement and pet leave
  • Continuing education and professional accreditation sponsorship
  • Life and AD&D insurance
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • Employee assistance program
  • Mental health support program
  • Additional perks

Reflected below is the base salary range offered for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to academic achievements, skills and experience. The range listed is just one component of the compensation package offered to candidates.

  • $120,000.00 - $160,000.00 annually

  • Connect: Collaborate selflessly to support others, advance ideas, and solve problems using critical thinking.

Linguist is responsible for performing real-time translations or sensitive material from a foreign language into English; collecting, analyzing, identifying, and decoding of colloquialisms and slang terms; Extracting pertinent information and communicating that information to law enforcement agent(s).   • Ability to transcribe and translate a minimum of 18 - 22 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8-hour day.

  • Perform related duties as assigned, within your scope of practice.

Requirements

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree AND three (3) years’ experience in a professional setting OR Associate degree AND five (5) years’ experience in a professional setting OR a High School Diploma AND seven (7) years of experience.
  • U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Must have knowledge of source language colloquial terms and expressions.
  • Knowledgeable is SMS language, social media and Webchat.
  • Must be able to obtain a law enforcement sensitive clearance
  • Demonstrates excellent verbal and written skills in both the source and target language, including correct and accurate grammar, punctuation, and spelling.
  • Must be able to obtain an ALTA Language certificate in Foreign Language and English
  • Must possess strong computer skills in MS Office, including Microsoft Word and Excel; PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Requires strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with different departments within the company, employees and with clients.
  • Ability to take technical direction and feedback from various sources.
  • Must be able to identify and escalate non-technical issues to Operations Supervisor, Field and Site Supervisors and Team Leads in a timely and effective manner
  • Committed to providing outstanding customer service and representing TE in a Professional manner.
  • Requires the ability to prioritize work, meet stringent deadlines, balance multiple tasks and work in a team environment.
  • Must be able to testify based on completed work product
  • Ability to translate/transcribe 18-22 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8/hour day when performing Linguist duties.
  • Ability to type 45 WPM
  • Available to work a minimum of 32 hours per week.
  • Must be available to work a flexible schedule, to include nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 32 consecutive labor hours per week, 8 hours per shift, when assigned to local projects
CLEARANCE:
Applicants selected may be subject to a government background investigation and may be required to meet the following conditions of employment.

  • Ability to obtain/maintain a Security Clearance
  • Favorable credit check for all cleared positions
  • Successfully pass a background investigation, medical and drug screen.
  • Applicants selected will be subject to a government background investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  • Must be a U.S Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Residency requirement -3 consecutive years in the last 5 years.

Standing/Walking/Mobility: Must have mobility to attend meetings with other managers and employees.
Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: 0% - 10% of the time.
Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: 0% - 10% of the time.
Fingering/Grasping/Feeling: Must be able to write, type and use a telephone system 100% of the time.
Sitting: 90% to 95% of the time.
