Job Title: In-Home Physician Full Time - Madison

Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$174,070.00 - $374,920.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

jobs.description:
We Are

Accenture is a premier Google Cloud partner helping organizations modernize data ecosystems, build real-time analytics capabilities, and responsibly scale AI. As part of Accenture Cloud First and the Accenture Google Business Group (AGBG), we deliver solutions leveraging Google Cloud’s Data & AI platform—including BigQuery, Looker, Vertex AI, Gemini Foundation Models, and Gemini Enterprise.


You Are

A hands-on Engineer with foundational experience in Data Engineering, Analytics, or Machine Learning—now building deep expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You are eager to apply technical skills, learn advanced Data & AI patterns, and support delivery teams in designing and implementing modern data and AI solutions.

You’re comfortable working directly with clients, supporting senior architects, and contributing to end-to-end project execution.


The Work (What You Will Do)

As a GCP Senior Data Engineer, you will help deliver data modernization, analytics, and AI solutions on GCP. You will support architecture design, build data pipelines and models, perform analysis, and contribute to technical implementations under guidance from senior team members.


1. Hands-On Technical Delivery

  • Build data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and integrations using GCP services such as: BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage
  • Assist with data modeling, performance tuning, and query optimization in BigQuery.
  • Implement data ingestion patterns for batch and streaming data sources.
  • Support development of dashboards and analytics products using Looker or Looker Studio.

2. Support Agentic AI & ML Solution Development

  • Assist in developing ML models and AI solutions using:
    Vertex AI, Gemini Foundation Models, Gemini Enterprise, Model APIs & Embeddings
  • Implement ML pipelines and help establish MLOps processes (monitoring, retraining, deployment).
  • Support prompt engineering, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) experimentation.
  • Contribute to model testing, validation, and documentation.

3. Requirements Gathering & Client Collaboration

  • Participate in client workshops to understand data needs, use cases, and technical requirements.
  • Help translate functional requirements into technical tasks and implementation plans.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and insights to project leads and client stakeholders.

4. Data Governance, Quality & Security Support

  • Implement metadata management, data quality checks, and lineage tracking using GCP tools (Dataplex, IAM).
  • Follow best practices for security, identity management, and compliance.
  • Support operational processes for data validation, testing, and monitoring.

5. Continuous Learning & Team Support

  • Learn and apply GCP Data & AI best practices across architectural patterns, engineering standards, and AI frameworks.
  • Collaborate closely with senior data engineers, ML engineers, and architects.
  • Contribute to internal accelerators, documentation, and reusable components.
  • Stay current with GCP releases, Gemini model updates, and modern engineering practices.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, ML Engineering, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 4 years of practical experience with Google Cloud Platform.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience with SQL, data modeling, and building data pipelines.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Python or AI or GenAI tools (Vertex AI preferred).
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus point if you have

  • Experience with GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, and Looker.
  • Exposure to AI/ML development or experimentation with Vertex AI, Gemini models, embeddings, or RAG patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Git, or cloud-native engineering practices.
  • Google Cloud certifications (Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Data Engineer).
  • Experience working in agile delivery environments.

jobs.description:
US-Based Staff Veterinarian

Location: Remote, United States

Position Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Expected Commitment: ~ 40 hours per week

About Vetster & The Role

Vetster expands access to veterinary care by connecting pet owners with licensed veterinarians through a digital platform that supports professional veterinary advice, diagnoses, treatment, and prescriptions.

Vetster is seeking an experienced Staff Veterinarian to provide high-quality virtual veterinary care through the Vetster platform. This is a primarily clinical, fully remote 1099 contractor role. The Staff Veterinarian will maintain a consistent virtual appointment caseload, including Vetster marketplace appointments and consultations involving animals cared for through retail and strategic partnerships. In addition to scheduled appointments, the role includes continuity-of-care responsibilities, collaboration with Vetster’s RVT team, and clinical input across other internal teams.

What You’ll Do

Provide Virtual Veterinary Care to Clients

  • Provide virtual assessments, treatment recommendations, and prescriptions within applicable regulatory requirements through the Vetster platform.
  • Identify cases requiring emergency or specialty care and recommend escalation.

Continuity of Care

  • Serve as an Assigned Continuing Veterinarian when the originating Marketplace Veterinarian is unavailable, in accordance with applicable VCPR requirements.
  • Review medical records and support continuity-of-care needs, including:
    • Prescription renewals and fulfillment inquiries
    • Follow-up questions related to established treatment plans
  • Collaborate with the RVT team on escalated cases and cases requiring further review.

Clinical Expertise

  • Provide practical clinical feedback to Product, Engineering, Operations, and other Vetster teams regarding workflows that affect veterinary care.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable state veterinary telemedicine laws, proposed legislative changes, VCPR requirements, and relevant regulatory changes.

Education & External Engagement

As mutually agreed upon and based on availability, the Staff Veterinarian may also:

  • Participate in media, PR, and industry events.
  • Contribute to educational content for pet owners and veterinarians.

Schedule & Caseload

This role requires an expected commitment of approximately 40 hours per week, inclusive of scheduled appointments, medical records, administrative time, continuity-of-care activities, internal meetings, and clinical follow-up.

  • Appointments with clients are scheduled in 20-minute increments.
  • The anticipated average caseload is approximately 12–16 appointments per day.
  • Appointments are generally scheduled consecutively (varies by demand), with protected time given for meal breaks, medical records, and administrative responsibilities.
  • Veterinarians have flexibility in establishing their schedule while also maintaining consistent Monday through Friday weekday availability.
  • No routine nights, holidays, or on-call responsibilities are expected.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years companion animal clinical experience with a DVM or VMD degree.
  • Active veterinary licensure in good standing within the United States (preference of licensure in Florida, California, Arizona, and/or Ohio).
  • Willingness and ability to obtain additional state licenses.
  • Strong clinical judgment and ability to determine when virtual care is appropriate.
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills
  • Strong medical record and documentation ability
  • Ability to collaborate with veterinarians, RVTs, and cross-functional teams.

Previous experience in veterinary telemedicine or multi-state practice is considered an asset.

Licensure & Professional Expenses

Vetster will cover veterinary licenses and license renewals required for the role.

The Contractor is responsible for:

  • Continuing education expenses.
  • Maintaining personal professional liability insurance.
  • Any professional association memberships and associated dues.
  • Other individual professional expenses unless otherwise agreed upon.

Remote Work & Travel

The veterinarian is responsible for providing and maintaining the equipment, internet access, audiovisual technology, and private workspace needed to perform the role.

Quarterly travel within Canada and/or the continental United States is expected. Vetster will cover or reimburse reasonable expenses associated with required business travel.

Monthly Contract Compensation

We offer a retainer of $10,500 - $11,050 per month. This is based on experience, qualifications, and applicable state licensure(s). This represents an annualized contract value of approximately $126,000 - $132,600.

The Contractor is responsible for applicable federal, state, and local taxes and other obligations associated with independent contractor status.

Why Join Vetster?

  • Fully remote veterinary practice with flexible scheduling
  • No routine nights, holidays, or on-call responsibilities
  • Protected medical record and administrative time
  • Vetster-paid required veterinary licenses and renewals
  • Predictable clinical caseload
  • Quarterly company-paid travel
  • Opportunities to contribute to the continued growth of virtual veterinary care

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process includes:

  • A 30-minute introductory video call with People & Culture
  • A 45-minute clinical interview with members of Vetster’s Operations and Veterinary teams
  • A 45-minute final-round interview with members of Vetster leadership

Vetster uses a third-party provider to conduct background checks following an offer

Ready to Make a Difference?

Embark on a fulfilling journey with us to shape the future of pet healthcare. If you're driven by innovation, collaboration, and a love for pets, apply now to join our mission-driven team.

Accommodations

Vetster welcomes and encourages applications from everyone! We are committed to accommodating candidates in ways that will make them comfortable and successful throughout the hiring process - both physically and mentally. These accommodations are available at every stage of the application process upon request.

AI Use Statement

For this role, we will use AI screening in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to identify keywords and minimum qualifications as well as note-taking in interviews. These tools will assist us in pinpointing qualified candidates and moving the recruitment process along at a progressive pace. If you have any questions about our use of AI, please reach out to us.

Salary: $126,000-$132,600 USD

This role requires someone who can think strategically and work independently while thriving in a highly collaborative team environment. You'll balance technical problem solving with relationship management, applying broad experience across multiple areas rather than deep expertise in just one. The Newspack platform and its applications are vast and continuously evolving—there's no way any one person can hold it all in their brain, which makes our team's collaborative approach essential to success.

This is a blended role that combines migration project management with ongoing publisher support. You'll typically manage multiple concurrent migration projects while also contributing to our shared support responsibilities, helping publishers optimize their use of Newspack post-launch. This balance ensures that you stay connected to both the launch experience and the long-term publisher relationship, providing you with insight into the full publisher lifecycle.

The role requires flexibility and strong organizational skills to shift context between project work and support work—between heads-down, independent tasks and collaborative team problem solving. If you thrive on variety and can maintain momentum across different types of work, you'll find this structure engaging and rewarding.

As a Newspack Technical Account Manager, You Will:

  • Manage publisher migrations from alignment through launch, owning timelines and coordinating a variety of stakeholders across technical and business requirements. You’ll proactively navigate obstacles, make strategic decisions about scope and priorities, and ensure successful outcomes even when facing unexpected challenges. Your project management will strike a balance between thoroughness and momentum, keeping complex initiatives moving forward while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Develop close relationships with news publishers by understanding their business goals, operational needs, and technical challenges. You’ll troubleshoot technical and editor-facing issues as they arise, help publishers leverage and optimize Newspack's features, set realistic expectations that align with our scope of support, and proactively identify opportunities to drive customer success.

You’ll provide top-notch guidance to publishers, identify product improvement opportunities based on publisher needs, surface bugs and feature requests, and collaborate with engineering to resolve issues. Your closeness to publishers will make you a valuable voice in shaping the product’s evolution.

You’ll participate in our highly collaborative team culture: sharing unique solutions, seeking input on complex challenges, and contributing to the collective knowledge that helps all of us serve publishers better. This balance between autonomy and collaboration is crucial to our work approach.
  • Develop and refine project management, time management, and communication systems to work more effectively and efficiently. You’ll document solutions, identify patterns across projects that could inform process improvements, and contribute insights from your work to enhance our workflows, product features, and publisher success strategies.

In this role, success means:

  • Meeting launch timelines while maintaining quality and managing scope effectively.
  • Building strong publisher relationships that lead to successful long-term partnerships.
  • Responding to publisher needs and providing timely, effective support.
  • Thinking strategically about both individual projects and broader process improvements.
  • Collaborating openly with the team, sharing knowledge, and continuously learning.
  • Maintaining product expertise and contributing insights that improve Newspack for all publishers.

About you:

  • Solid working knowledge of WordPress core functionality, common plugins, and the WordPress ecosystem. (You don’t need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable troubleshooting WordPress sites and understanding how things work under the hood.)
  • Background in client services, account management, or technical support, where you’ve managed relationships and solved problems directly with customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and dependencies—proactively, not just reactively.
  • Comfort with technical troubleshooting, investigating root causes, and finding creative solutions within constraints.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and set appropriate expectations.

Benefits

  • Open vacation policy (no set number of days per year). We encourage all employees to take the time they need for vacation, to pursue their own interests, to stay healthy, and to spend time with friends and family.
  • Home office setup and coworking allowances. Working from a coffee shop? You can use your coworking allowance for the requisite latte!
  • We happily provide or reimburse the hardware and software you’ll need, as well as books or conferences that promote continued learning.
  • Company-sponsored life insurance.
  • Open parental leave (includes maternity, paternity, and adoption). If you’ve been with Automattic for 12 months, your leave is fully paid.
  • A spiffy set of wireless headphones at your seven-year anniversary.
  • Paid two to three-month sabbaticals encouraged every five years.
  • We cover all costs of company travel, so dust off that passport! Your team will get together one to three times per year in locations around the globe. Other benefits are country-specific and include health, vision, and dental insurance; matching retirement/pension contributions; childcare vouchers; income protection; travel insurance; and discount offers.

jobs.description:
A Dito é uma empresa de tecnologia que nasceu em 2008 em meio à atmosfera de inovação do San Pedro Valley, em Belo Horizonte. O objetivo da nossa plataforma é otimizar o relacionamento entre as empresas e seus clientes, com soluções personalizadas, aproximando os consumidores de suas reais necessidades de maneira inteligente, segmentada por meio de diversos canais.

Desde 2017, somos honrados como uma Excelente Empresa para Trabalhar, de acordo com o Great Place to Work®, e esse reconhecimento é, sem dúvidas, devido ao que mais valorizamos por aqui: as PESSOAS!

Quer fazer parte dessa trajetória? Vem ser FERA! Mas afinal, o que é ser FERA?

Ser FERA significa:

  • Absorver e propagar a cultura e os valores da Dito: pega e Faz, com foco e planejamento; age com Ética e transparência; se preocupa com o Resultado do cliente; trabalha com Alegria e sede por Aprender.

  • Agir sob a orientação de metas e dados, sempre com foco na excelência dos resultados dos nossos clientes e no bem-estar das pessoas que tornam isso possível.

  • Interagir, colaborar, usar e aprender, independentemente dos cargos ou das áreas. No mercado, estreitamos desvios e conectamos pessoas. Dentro da empresa não poderia ser diferente. Na Dito, as pessoas torcem umas pelas outras.

  • Compreender, respeitar e admirar as diferenças, transformar as oportunidades de enxergar o mundo a partir de perspectivas diferentes daquelas que já conhecemos.

  • Trabalhar com leveza e equilíbrio, valorizando o próprio bem-estar e, claro, o das outras pessoas.

Por que estamos criando um banco de talentos para Pessoas Negras?

A Dito é uma empresa comprometida com a promoção da diversidade, equidade e inclusão. Nosso time só é tão FERA pois incorporamos as diferenças e buscamos construir um ambiente de acolhimento, pluralidade e respeito às singularidades para que todas as pessoas se sintam livres para serem elas mesmas.

Sabemos que esse é apenas o início de nossa jornada, e estamos engajados no propósito de aumentar a representatividade de pessoas negras no time de FERAs. Por isso, este banco é exclusivo para pessoas pertencentes a essa comunidade.

Valorizamos pessoas que tenham o pega e Faz com Foco e planejamento na veia, que prezem pela Ética e transparência, tenham foco nos Resultados dos clientes, trabalhem com Alegria e sede por Aprender. Então, se você se encaixa e acredita que estes valores fazem a diferença, nós estamos buscando justamente por você!

Quem pode se inscrever?

Sabemos que ainda estamos muito distantes de ter uma sociedade igualitária e com oportunidades iguais para todos e que pessoas negras enfrentam uma forte desigualdade no mercado de trabalho e por esta razão criamos este espaço.

Por isso, se você se identifica como uma pessoa negra, candidate-se e #VemSerFERA!

Nossos benefícios:

  • Dito Flex - VR e VA flexíveis pagos no cartão Caju (você escolhe como usar seu saldo de acordo com suas necessidades e preferência);
  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil com abrangência nacional, sem coparticipação e com inclusão de dependentes (filhos e cônjuges);

  • Auxílio escritório, para ajudar a custear parte dos gastos gerados pelo trabalho remoto;

  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) com planos variados, inclusive um grátis;
  • Parceria com o Sesc, com descontos em serviços de educação, saúde, cultura, esporte, turismo, lazer e assistência;
  • Licenças maternidade e paternidade estendidas, válidas também para casos de adoção e guarda judicial. Durante esse período, a pessoa continua recebendo o VA/VR.

Outras vantagens que tornam a Dito um lugar especial ❤️:

  • Carga horária de 40 horas semanais com horários flexíveis de verdade;
  • Total liberdade de estilo, nada de dress code por aqui;
  • Diversos incentivos ao aprendizado (em participação em cursos, eventos, talks e meetups, compra de livros, biblioteca interna, entre outros);
  • Lanches, games e fliperama à vontade no escritório para relaxar durante os intervalos;
  • Convênios e descontos em vários restaurantes, academias, instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas, entre outros;
  • Confraternizações constantes e eventos de integração entre equipes para proporcionar novas associações e amizades;
  • Falando em equipes, nossos times de futebol (feminino e masculino), batem um bolão;
  • Para quem não vive sem música, temos uma banda de FERAs!
  • Comitês internos de diversidade que realizam eventos direcionados, debates, aprendizados e iniciativas de conscientização e inclusão de grupos minorizados.

A Dito é uma empresa que respeita e apoia a diversidade e a inclusão. Portanto, não fazemos diferenciação de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, religião ou deficiência. Nosso time só é tão FERA pois incorporamos as diferenças.

Se você gostou do que leu, encontrou uma oportunidade com o seu perfil e quer fazer parte de uma Excelente Empresas para Trabalhar, de acordo com o Great Place to Work®, inscreva-se agora mesmo para ter uma chance de se juntar a nós! Caso você dê match com alguma das nossas oportunidades, entraremos em contato =).

Boa sorte!

jobs.excerpt: Lead AI Engineer — Bridge-it AI Team Location: Remote Experience: 4–8 years in industry Team: AI Platform (Copilot) About Bridge-itBridge-it is an early-stage EdTech company building a career-readiness platform for K-12 students, counselors, and districts.
jobs.description:
Lead AI Engineer — Bridge-it AI Team

Location: Remote

Experience: 4–8 years in industry

Team: AI Platform (Copilot)

About Bridge-it

Bridge-it is an early-stage EdTech company building a career-readiness platform for K-12 students, counselors, and districts. Students explore careers, colleges, and non-college pathways; build multi-year plans; and get guidance from an AI Copilot that is grounded in their own plans, school data, and a curated knowledge base. Counselors use the same platform to supervise, nudge, and intervene at scale.

The AI Copilot is the heart of the product — a production LangGraph-based agentic system serving real students, where being right matters more than being fluent. We hold ourselves to strict grounding, safety, and tenant-isolation standards, and we measure everything.

About the role

You will join a small AI team that owns the Copilot end to end: the agentic orchestration graph, retrieval and grounding, safety guardrails, response contracts with the frontend, and the evaluation platform that keeps it honest. We are mid-flight on an ambitious redesign — collapsing multiple experimental graph variants into a single workflow-first architecture with typed claim verification, constitutional rules, and per-turn decision records — and you would step directly into that work.

This is a senior role with a visible leadership runway. Beyond writing excellent code, we expect you to analyze ambiguous product requirements, turn them into well-scoped technical specs and tickets, distribute work across the team, and communicate trade-offs clearly to product and leadership. For the right person, this role grows into a techno-management position.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and operate agentic LLM workflows in LangGraph — routing, planning, parallel retrieval, tool execution, verification, and streaming — serving live student and counselor traffic over WebSockets.
  • Own RAG quality: multi-source retrieval across vector stores (Milvus, pgvector), a knowledge graph (Neo4j), and structured platform data; chunking strategy; reranking; and grounded generation with typed claims and evidence citation.
  • Enforce safety and trust: input/output guardrails, constitutional rules, faithfulness verification, abstain/escalate behavior, and strict multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Build and extend our evaluation platform: online LLM-as-judge evaluators, offline regression suites on curated datasets (LangSmith), latency baselines, and A/B experimentation (PostHog feature flags).
  • Drive latency and cost optimization: model selection across providers (OpenAI, Gemini, open-weight models via OpenRouter), prompt and context engineering, selective retrieval, caching, and streaming intermediate responses.
  • Instrument and debug production behavior with LangSmith tracing, OpenTelemetry, New Relic, and Sentry; treat live-QA findings as first-class inputs to design.
  • Partner with backend (Django/Postgres), frontend (Next.js), and product teams on response envelopes, interaction contracts, and rollout plans.
  • Lead by doing: break epics into staged implementation plans with acceptance criteria, sequence work across engineers, review code, and mentor teammates.

What we're looking for (required)

  • 4–8 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2–5 years building LLM-powered products in production (not just prototypes or notebooks) and 2 years of leading a team.
  • Strong Python engineering fundamentals — typing, testing, async, service design.
  • Strong grasp of agentic architecture patterns — supervisor/executor splits, planner–retriever–verifier pipelines, tool/capability registries, routing and fallback tiers — and sound judgment about when a workflow should be deterministic versus agentic.
  • Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph strongly preferred; LangChain, or comparable state-machine/agent frameworks acceptable) including multi-step graphs, tool calling, and streaming.
  • Context engineering / harness engineering: deliberate construction of what the model sees each turn — context budgets, retrieval selection, system-prompt and tool-schema design, structured state passed between nodes — and the harness discipline (contracts, guards, fallbacks) that makes model behavior predictable.
  • Experience designing and optimizing agent memory: short-term conversation state (windowing, summarization/compaction, token-budget management) and long-term memory (user profiles, episodic stores, rollups) with sensible retrieval and staleness policies.
  • Deep practical knowledge of RAG systems: embedding models, vector databases (Milvus/Zilliz, pgvector, or similar), hybrid retrieval, rerankers (e.g., Cohere), chunking and knowledge-base design.
  • Proven experience building and operating LLM evaluation systems: online evaluators (LLM-as-judge) on live traffic, offline golden datasets and regression suites, faithfulness/hallucination and groundedness metrics, A/B experiment design — and the discipline to gate releases on eval results.
  • Hands-on AI observability: end-to-end trace instrumentation of agent runs (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, or similar), per-node latency/token/cost tracking, trajectory analysis, drift and quality-regression monitoring, and turning production traces into eval datasets and fixes.
  • Experience shipping structured outputs (JSON contracts, schema-validated responses) as the interface between models and product surfaces.
  • Comfort with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred: Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GCS, BigQuery).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills: you can explain a retrieval-quality trade-off to a product manager, write a spec another engineer can execute, and disagree constructively.
  • Demonstrated ability in requirement analysis and task decomposition — turning fuzzy asks into staged, dependency-ordered work — and willingness to step up into team-lead responsibilities.

Desirable

  • Experience at an early-stage startup — comfort with ambiguity, wearing multiple hats, and shipping under constraints.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): working knowledge of the spec and hands-on experience building or integrating MCP servers/clients to expose tools and data to agents.
  • Knowledge graphs (Neo4j/Cypher) in retrieval or recommendation contexts.
  • Durable workflow engines (Temporal) and event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub).
  • Multi-tenant SaaS security models (row-level tenancy, FERPA/COPPA-adjacent compliance awareness).
  • EdTech or other regulated/high-trust consumer domains.

Nice to have

  • AI infrastructure: model serving, GPU inference, gateway/router layers, and cost/latency-aware routing across providers.
  • SLMs and self-hosted LLMs: deploying and operating small language models or open-weight LLMs (vLLM, TGI, Ollama, or similar), quantization, fine-tuning/distillation for task-specific workloads, and knowing when a small model beats an API call.
  • Traditional ML: classification, ranking, embedding fine-tuning; scikit-learn/PyTorch.
  • Recommender systems: candidate generation + ranking pipelines, personalization.
  • Forecasting and data analytics: time-series methods, cohort analysis, product analytics.
  • Big data processing/streaming: BigQuery at scale, Spark/Flink/Kafka or Pub/Sub streaming pipelines, dbt-style transformation workflows.

Our stack (so you know what you're signing up for)

Python · LangGraph/LangChain · OpenAI + Gemini + open-weight models (OpenRouter) · Milvus/Zilliz · pgvector · Neo4j · Cohere reranking · LangSmith · Django + PostgreSQL · Temporal · GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GCS, BigQuery) · PostHog · OpenTelemetry/New Relic/Sentry · Next.js frontend over a WebSocket streaming protocol.

Bridge-it is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive, respectful remote-first workplace.

jobs.description:
The Value Builder Role at Exelab

Exelab builds custom, AI-powered solutions, each one tailor-made to a client's specific business objective. We run every engagement like a small product effort: we start from a real problem and craft a solution to move a real metric (revenue, efficiency, conversion, retention). We work in small, tight teams, close to the client's business, and we use AI directly in how we design and build. What matters to us is the impact we create for clients.

The Value Builder does what a Product Builder does, and leads a team while doing it. On our larger engagements, the ones that need a team, the Value Builder designs the solution, builds where it counts, and guides the small group that ships it. Working with our revenue team to shape the direction that creates value for the client, the Value Builder owns bringing it to life: on scope, on budget, on time, at quality. It is a builder's role first, with leadership alongside it, leading by doing and by clarity.

Key Responsibilities

The Value Builder owns the outcome of a larger engagement and leads the team that delivers it. The core responsibilities:

  • Own the outcome end to end: Take the direction shaped with the revenue team and be accountable for the result: a solution that answers the need, within scope, budget, and time. The Value Builder owns the how and the quality.

  • Design, and build where it counts: Design the solution and stay hands-on enough to make excellent calls and to prototype, putting hands where they add the most value and delegating the rest.

  • Lead the team that ships: Guide a small delivery team (a Solution Architect and specialists) to the result. Set clear goals, keep everyone on the rails, unblock, and hold the quality bar, leading by clarity and example.

  • Keep it grounded in the real need: Stay close to what the client actually needs and make sure the team builds to that, catching drift early.

  • Make it hold up: Put the work in front of real usage, find what falls short, and drive it to a product that does the job well.

In summary, the Value Builder is a maker who leads: product judgment and the ability to build, plus the leadership to bring a team to a real result. It is the role for someone who has shipped their own work and taken teams through complex delivery.

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile

Our ideal Value Builder has the Product Builder core and has led teams to deliver. There is no need to match every line: the essentials are a record of building and shipping, and of leading delivery.

  • A track record of shipping: Products or tools they personally built and put in front of users (side-projects count). We ask to see something they made.

  • Building with AI, and product judgment: They can turn a direction into a working product and make pragmatic calls on how to build it well.

  • Team leadership with results: They have taken complex projects home with a small team, on time, on budget, with a happy client, leading by clarity and example.

  • Learning agility: Every engagement is different; they get competent quickly and they are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • Practical: Native or C2-level Italian, and based in Italy. We value a track record of delivery and the things they have built.

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects, and connects the technology of the world's well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across 19 markets in North America, EMEA and APAC, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. Vantage's business is growing exponentially, through a combination of greenfield market expansion and acquisitions.

Business Optimization & Vendor Management Department

The Business Optimization & Vendor Management team supports effective planning, financial visibility, operational discipline, and informed decision-making. The team partners with budget owners, business leaders, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders to maintain reliable planning information, monitor financial commitments, improve reporting, and strengthen processes that help the organization use its resources effectively.

Position Overview

The Business Analyst, Budget Planning & Financial Operations supports budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities that help business leaders effectively manage approved budgets and financial commitments throughout the year.

This role partners with budget owners and business leaders to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor spending, identify risks and opportunities, and keep assumptions aligned with current business needs. The analyst helps stakeholders avoid unexpected overspend while also identifying available funding and planned activities that may need action so approved resources are used effectively.

The ideal candidate is analytical, highly organized, and comfortable working directly with stakeholders. As the individual develops knowledge of the business and its planning processes, they will take an increasingly active role in recurring forecast discussions, budget reviews, and follow-up with assigned budget owners.

Essential Job Functions

Budget Planning & Forecast Management

  • Support annual budget planning and recurring forecast cycles, including non-labor operating expense and capital expenditure planning.
  • Maintain and update forecast workbooks, planning files, assumptions, and supporting documentation throughout the year.
  • Work with budget owners to understand spending plans, project timing, contract obligations, purchase commitments, and changing business priorities.
  • Help budget owners maintain realistic forecasts that reduce the risk of overspending and highlight opportunities to use approved funding before year-end.
  • Track forecast changes, open actions, and decisions to ensure planning information remains current and explainable.
  • Identify potential overages, unused funding, timing shifts, and other risks or opportunities, and raise them for timely discussion and action.
  • Support capital planning, project cost tracking, and workforce or position planning activities as assigned.

Budget Owner & Business Leader Partnership

  • Build productive working relationships with budget owners and business leaders.

  • Prepare for and participate in recurring budget and forecast review meetings.
  • Ask thoughtful questions, clarify assumptions, document decisions, and follow up on required updates.
  • Explain budget, forecast, actual, and committed-spend information in clear business terms.
  • Provide budget owners with timely information that supports prioritization and spending decisions.
  • With appropriate training and experience, independently lead routine forecast conversations and serve as a primary point of contact for assigned budget owners.
  • Coordinate with Finance and other stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and keep planning data aligned.

Financial Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze budget, forecast, actual, committed, and planned spend information.

  • Perform variance analysis and identify the operational drivers behind changes in financial performance.

  • Review spending trends and summarize relevant risks, opportunities, and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, meeting materials, and concise leadership summaries.
  • Support ad hoc analysis, project financial reviews, business cases, and return-on-investment analysis as needed.
  • Contribute to budget planning scenarios and longer-range analysis using documented assumptions.

Data Management, Controls & Process Improvement

  • Reconcile financial and operational information across systems, reports, and source files.
  • Validate data, investigate discrepancies, and document assumptions, methods, and exceptions.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of forecast updates, commitments, decisions, and supporting information.
  • Create and maintain reports, dashboards, process documentation, and user guidance.
  • Identify practical improvements that increase forecast accuracy, strengthen controls, and reduce manual effort.
  • Support small-scale reporting, process, or tool improvement initiatives.
  • Handle additional duties as assigned by management.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Analytics,or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Approximately 2 to 5 years of experience in business analysis, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, operations, project controls, portfolio administration, or a related role.
  • Experience supporting budget planning, forecast maintenance, financial reporting, or variance analysis.
  • Working knowledge of operating expense and capital expenditure concepts.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and comfort working with detailed financial and operational data.
  • Ability to organize information, manage multiple priorities, and follow through on open actions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and communicate financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality, documentation, and confidentiality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Experience

  • Budget owner or business-partner support.
  • Non-labor forecast management, project portfolio support, or contract and vendor spend analysis.
  • Capital planning, project cost tracking, or multi-year planning.
  • Executive-ready reporting, dashboards, KPI reporting, or data visualization.
  • Experience with Power BI, Workday, ERP or financial planning systems, procurement systems, or similar business tools.
  • Process improvement, requirements gathering, or small-scale project coordination.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. jobs.description:
Why BR-DGE?

We're a payments company where a Sales Development Representative can open a conversation with a tier-1 operator and see it turn into a live enterprise deal.

Payments infrastructure is where fintech is being rebuilt, and our BR-DGE builders are at the heart of it. Founded in Edinburgh in 2018, BR-DGE is an award-winning pioneer in payment orchestration: our platform lets enterprise brands route, optimise and control payments across providers, without being locked into any single one. Our customers include The Hut Group and Betfred, and we work alongside partners like Visa and Worldpay. We closed a £10m funding round in 2026 to accelerate growth, and our transaction volumes are climbing fast.

We’re ~100 people and remote-first: big enough to have real customers, scale and backing, small enough that your work is visible and your voice carries weight. Here, you won't just join our roadmap, you’ll help us build it.

Why this role exists

The iGaming sector is one of the most dynamic, high-volume, and technically demanding ecosystems in digital commerce. Operators face relentless challenges with payment acceptance rates, regulatory shifts, cross-border routing, and checkout friction.

BR-DGE solves these critical pain points through our independent orchestration platform. To capitalise on our momentum, we are hiring a dedicated Sales Development Representative to spearhead our outbound engine across the iGaming vertical. You will be the tip of the spear - identifying operators, opening doors to key decision-makers, and laying the groundwork for high-value enterprise partnerships.

What you’ll be doing

As our Sales Development Representative for iGaming, you will drive high-quality pipeline by executing creative, multi-channel outreach campaigns. You will act as a trusted advisor from the very first touchpoint, cutting through the noise with targeted insights that speak directly to payment leaders' commercial priorities.

Your day-to-day will include:

  • Strategic Outbound Prospecting: Executing highly personalised, multi-channel cadences (phone, tailored email, and LinkedIn) targeting our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) across operators and platforms in the iGaming space.
  • Qualification: Conducting structured discovery conversations to assess prospect challenges against established qualification frameworks (such as MEDDIC or BANT) before securing meetings.
  • Handoffs: Scheduling qualified meetings for Account Executives, providing detailed briefing packs covering prospect pain points, commercial priorities, and key stakeholder maps.
  • Data / CRM Excellence: Maintaining flawless data hygiene within HubSpot, tracking touches, notes, and pipeline stages in real time to ensure reliable reporting.
  • Continuous Improvement: Regularly testing, analysing, and iterating on email copy, call angles, and sequence structures to improve response and conversion rates.

What we’re looking for

This role is for someone who wants autonomy with the ability to make a tangible mark on our growth. We are looking for someone who balances commercial curiosity with disciplined execution.

Essential Experience:

  • Proven track record in a B2B outbound prospecting role (SDR, BDR, or inside sales), consistently meeting or exceeding pipeline and meeting targets.
  • Prior experience prospecting within the payments, fintech, SaaS, or iGaming / gambling / sports betting sectors.
  • High confidence and capability across multi-channel outreach, with particular comfort conducting cold phone calls and crafting bespoke written pitches.
  • Hands-on experience working with sales qualification methodologies (e.g. MEDDIC, BANT, or similar).
  • Working knowledge of modern sales technology stacks, specifically CRM management within HubSpot.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a confident, low-ego, and consultative communication style.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms and data intelligence tools (e.g., Apollo, Salesloft, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

Our BR-DGE Builder Experience

→ Impact: Meaningful work, real industry influence.

→ Trust: High ownership, no micromanagement.

→ Flexibility: Balance that respects life outside work.

We provide a supportive and flexible growth environment where your impact is visible every day:

  • Flexibility: Remote-first, deliverable-focussed working culture that respects your priorities outside work.
  • Time Off: 33 days holiday (25 days annual leave + 8 floating public holidays) plus an extra day off for your birthday.
  • Home Office and Work-From-Home Setup: Everything you need to work comfortably from day one, plus £26 a month towards your home working costs.
  • Health and Wellbeing: Family private healthcare cover or family health cash plan and tech scheme, and access to our Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Financial Security: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives, pension scheme, and life insurance.
  • Growth: A culture that actively champions personal development.
  • Community: Regular virtual touchpoints, monthly socials, and quarterly in-person team events to keep our remote builders connected.

Ready to BR-DGE the gap? Apply today.

We value the unique talents and perspectives that each individual brings and are committed to creating a fair, accessible, and transparent hiring process for all.

Position: Databricks Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

At RevStar, we build cutting-edge cloud, data, and Generative AI solutions that transform how enterprise organizations operate. As a strategic partner in the AWS and Databricks ecosystems, we don’t just deliver code—we solve complex business problems, modernize legacy data estates, and deploy production-grade AI applications that drive real business value.

Our Core Values:

  • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.
  • Shared Destiny: We rise or fall together.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Databricks Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our growing Data & AI Practice. In this highly visible role, you will work embedded directly at the intersection of technical architecture, hands-on engineering, and executive client engagement.

As an FDE, you are both a master builder and a trusted technical advisor. You will own the full delivery lifecycle for high-impact enterprise accounts—designing scalable data foundations, implementing cutting-edge Generative AI solutions, and migrating complex workloads onto the Databricks Lakehouse platform. Simultaneously, you will drive customer adoption and consumption growth by identifying new use cases and building strategic alignment with client technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hands-on Solution Architecture & Engineering: Design, build, and deploy production-grade data pipelines, analytics engines, and Generative AI/LLM applications using the Databricks platform, Spark, Python/PySpark, and modern cloud ecosystems (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Enterprise Customer Delivery: Serve as the primary technical leader on strategic enterprise client engagements. Partner with C-level executives, VP/Directors of Data, and engineering teams to translate business challenges into high-performing technical solutions.
  • Databricks Migration & Estate Modernization: Lead complex legacy platform migrations (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, legacy Hadoop, SQL Server) onto the Databricks Lakehouse architecture.
  • GenAI & Advanced Analytics Implementation: Guide enterprise customers (Healthcare, Retail, Financial Services, etc.) in adopting GenAI solutions, RAG architectures, model fine-tuning, and MLflow/Databricks Mosaic AI integrations.
  • Drive Platform Adoption & Growth: Partner with account leadership to identify new, high-value technical use cases across client business units, expanding Databricks platform usage and driving measurable ROI for clients.
  • Technical Mentorship & Practice Building: Mentor and coach junior Solution Engineers, Architects, and Consultants. Contribute to internal RevStar code libraries, reusable accelerators, and technical delivery best practices.

Requirements

Technical Expertise:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Machine Learning, or Solutions Architecture.
  • 3+ years of deep technical experience within the Databricks Ecosystem (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Spark/PySpark, Databricks Workflows/Jobs, Mosaic AI).
  • Generative AI / ML: Practical experience designing and deploying RAG pipelines, fine-tuning LLMs, working with vector databases, and managing ML pipelines end-to-end.
  • Cloud Architecture: Strong expertise in cloud-native architectures (AWS preferred—S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, etc.).
  • Data Migration: Proven track record of migrating enterprise legacy data warehouses/lakes onto Databricks.
  • Databricks Certifications: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional and/or Machine Learning Professional preferred.

Client & Business Acumen:

  • Enterprise Experience: Demonstrated track record of leading technical delivery for Fortune 500 or large enterprise clients (Healthcare, Retail, Consumer Goods experience is a strong plus).
  • Consulting & Customer-Facing Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; comfortable presenting technical architecture, building POCs/demos, and managing client stakeholders up to the C-suite.
  • Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities within existing client accounts and serve as a technical advocate to grow account footprint.

Benefits

  • Remote-First Working Environment – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
  • Collaborative, Innovative Culture – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

jobs.excerpt: About Bonusly Bonusly is the recognition and rewards platform people actually use.
jobs.description:
About Bonusly

Bonusly is the recognition and rewards platform people actually use. We believe culture is built by everyone, not assigned by HR. When the whole team shows up for each other, something powerful happens: culture you can see, measure, and strengthen. Our AI companion, Bizy, helps people recognize each other better and helps leaders understand what's really happening across their organization.To learn more about working at Bonusly, check out our Un-Handbook:

Why this role exists

Our Insights business unit is one of our biggest bets: turning recognition data into strategic intelligence that helps leaders understand team health, engagement, and culture in real time. We're building AI-powered products (generative UIs, conversational analysis, culture visualizations) that surface patterns no survey could capture. The design conventions don't exist yet. We have to invent them.

The gap we're filling is creative energy. We're looking for someone who stretches us visually with fresh, imaginative ideas and a consumer sensibility that makes B2B software feel alive. You'll work alongside a product leader, an engineering leader, and another designer who leads the Insights BU, while collaborating with designers and engineers across the company.

What you'll do

  • Design AI-powered culture intelligence products from scratch: collaboration maps, engagement spotlights, organizational health dashboards. The UI has to earn trust
  • Shape product strategy with your product and engineering partners. You won't wait for specs. You'll help figure out what to build and why
  • Lead end-to-end design: research, flows, prototypes, high-fidelity visuals, and close collaboration with engineers through implementation
  • Bring a visual point of view. Push the craft through motion, illustration, layout, and thoughtful detail
  • Ship fast in ambiguity. Sometimes you lead with a concept, sometimes you refine an engineer's first pass. Designers here are partners from the first commit
  • Experiment with how Bizy shows up across the experience, from conversational interfaces to proactive insights that feel helpful, not intrusive

Design and AI at Bonusly

AI is changing what it means to be a designer. What the tools can't do is decide what's worth building, what feels right, and what will make someone pause. That's taste, and it's what we value most. We use AI tools daily and want someone with the judgment to know where they help and where they don't.

You're a great fit if you…

  • Have 5+ years of product design experience with a portfolio that shows range across UX thinking, visual craft, and interaction design
  • Have a creative streak beyond clean UI: illustration, motion, brand work, or side projects that show visual imagination
  • Can take complex, data-rich problems and make them feel simple and intuitive. Not by hiding complexity, but by designing through it
  • Have experience designing 0-to-1 products, especially in AI-powered environments where you had to invent the interface
  • Bring a consumer sensibility to B2B. You know what makes software feel good to use, not just functional
  • Have strong communication skills. You can make the case for a direction and bring people along
  • Are curious about AI as both a product space and a set of tools reshaping how you work

Bonus points for

  • Experience with data visualization, analytics products, or culture/HR tech
  • Comfort prototyping in code (HTML/CSS/JS, React) or a genuine desire to learn. Our stack makes it easy
  • Experience designing conversational or AI-native interfaces

A few things to know

Will I have a design manager who knows design?

Yes. You'll report to the VP of Product & Design, who has a design background and leads our product design and marketing team. Design leadership here isn't an afterthought. It's how decisions get made.

Is this fully remote?

Yes. But we sell culture for a living, so we're our own best example: weekly creative warm ups, a design guild that brings product and marketing designers together, regular play sessions, and intentional team travel.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Maintain accurate documentation so internal teams can act fast and clients get consistent answers.

We're looking for people who have:

jobs.excerpt: Welcome to the Agentic Commerce EraAt Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The Vice President of Marketing at Commerce.com sets and drives the marketing strategy for a business unit called Feedonomics — spanning demand generation, product marketing, brand, customer advocacy, and retention across all customer segments. This is an executive leadership role for someone who can operate as a strategic partner to the C-suite while staying close enough to the work to shape a pipeline forecast, a brand platform, and a customer story in the same week.


You'll own the marketing P&L, build and scale a multi-functional organization through your Directors, and be the executive voice for marketing across the business. You'll set the segment strategy that your team executes against, ensuring marketing's seat at the table in company-wide planning, and make the resourcing and investment calls that determine where marketing dollars create the most value. If you love setting direction as much as you love getting into the details when it matters, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do:


Marketing Strategy & Vision

  • Set the overall marketing strategy for Feedonomics, connecting brand, demand generation, product marketing, and customer advocacy into one coherent narrative and operating plan
  • Define how marketing prioritizes across customer segments (including Mid Market and Enterprise), balancing near-term pipeline needs against long-term brand and category investment
  • Represent marketing in company-wide strategic planning, working directly with the CMO and executive leadership team to align marketing investment with business priorities

Revenue & Pipeline Ownership

  • Own the marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue number across all segments, with full accountability for forecasting, performance, and in-flight strategy adjustments
  • Set budget and resource allocation across demand generation, product marketing, brand, and retention functions, and defend that investment with clear ROI
  • Partner with Sales and Finance leadership on shared revenue targets, funnel efficiency, and go-to-market alignment

Brand & Product Marketing Leadership

  • Own the company's brand positioning for Feedonomics & BigCommerce and ensure segment-level messaging (led by your team) rolls up into one consistent, differentiated market position
  • Set the go-to-market strategy for major product launches and act as the executive sponsor connecting Product, Sales, and Marketing on roadmap and positioning decisions
  • Ensure the voice of the customer — across every segment — is represented at the leadership table

Customer Advocacy & Retention Strategy

  • Set the strategy for turning customers into advocates and reducing churn through marketing-led retention and expansion programs
  • Champion customer marketing as a growth lever, not a support function, and ensure it's resourced and measured accordingly. Will be measured on NPS.
  • Partner with Customer Success leadership on a shared lifecycle strategy from first touch through renewal and expansion

Organizational & People Leadership

  • Build, lead, and scale a marketing team, setting the standard for speed, ownership, and storytelling across the function
  • Recruit, develop, and retain senior marketing leaders; build a bench of talent ready to grow into bigger roles
  • Create a culture where marketing moves fast without sacrificing brand integrity, and where every leader in the org is accountable for a number, not just activity

Executive & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as marketing's executive partner to Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Shared Services leadership, setting the operating model that lets segment teams move quickly
  • Own marketing's relationship with the executive team and, where applicable, the Board — communicating strategy, performance, and market insight clearly and confidently
  • Model the strategic thinking, storytelling, and analytical rigor you expect from every leader on your team

Who You Are:

  • 12+ years of marketing experience, including significant time in a senior leadership role owning multi-function marketing organizations (demand generation, product marketing, brand, and customer marketing/retention)
  • A track record of owning a company-level pipeline or revenue number and being accountable for it at the executive level, not just within a single segment or channel
  • Significant people leadership experience — you've built and scaled marketing organizations through managers of managers, and you know how to develop senior leaders, not just individual contributors
  • Executive presence and communication skills — you're comfortable setting strategy in the boardroom and just as comfortable getting into the details of a campaign brief or customer story
  • A track record of setting brand and go-to-market strategy that holds together across multiple segments or product lines
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership — you've operated as a true peer to Sales, Product, and Customer Success leadership, not just a marketing service provider
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity at the company level — you set direction with incomplete information and adjust as the market and business evolve
  • Experience marketing to small business and/or other core Commerce.com customer segments is a strong plus
  • Strong business and analytical instincts — equally fluent in a board-level revenue model and a brand platform

What Success Looks Like:

  • The company consistently hits or exceeds its marketing-sourced pipeline and revenue targets across all segments
  • A marketing organization that is motivated, growing, and consistently shipping high-quality, fast work
  • A clear, differentiated brand and product narrative that holds together across every customer segment and go-to-market motion
  • A steady, scaling engine of customer advocacy and retention programs that measurably reduce churn and grow expansion revenue
  • Marketing is seen by the executive team, Sales, Product, and Customer Success as a strategic growth driver and a trusted partner at the leadership table — not a support function


Compensation Transparency

The national base salary range for this role is posted above in this job post.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location. We also consider internal equity to help ensure fair and consistent pay practices across our teams.

Where applicable, this role may also be eligible for variable compensation (such as bonus or commission), equity, and benefits in accordance with local policies. Details will be shared during the hiring process. We are committed to equitable and transparent pay practices that align to market data, internal equity, and individual contribution.

Inclusion and Belonging

At Commerce, we believe that celebrating the unique histories, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes a difference for our company, our customers and our community. We are an equal opportunity employer and the inclusive atmosphere we build together will make room for every person to contribute, grow and thrive.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about the Commerce team, culture and benefits at

Identity Verification


To protect our candidates and company from fraudulent activity, our interview process includes a government ID and biometric verification via Persona, our trusted identity verification provider. All information is collected and processed securely in accordance with applicable privacy laws.



Protect Yourself Against Hiring Scams: Our Corporate Disclaimer


Commerce, along with many other employers, has become the subject of fraudulent job offers to hopeful prospective job seekers.

Be advised:

Commerce does not offer jobs to individuals who do not go through our formal hiring process.

Commerce will never:

  • require payment of recruitment fees from candidates;
  • request personally identifiable information through unsanctioned websites or applications;
  • attempt to solicit money from you as part of the hiring process or as part of an employment offer;
  • solicit money to complete visa requirements as part of a job offer.

If you receive unsolicited offers of employment from Commerce, we urge you to be extremely cautious and avoid engaging or responding.
