The Opportunity

As the firm scales, our associates need people management, feedback that helps them grow, and a real sense of belonging.

You'll own attorney development from the ground up. You'll build the feedback cadence, development programs, and sense of community that turns associates into long-term, fully utilized members of the firm.

Success at six months looks like associates who feel part of something bigger, are receiving real and consistent feedback, and are growing, reflected in stronger utilization. From there, the ambition grows: measurably better associate engagement and the launch of programs to enhance our attorneys’ experience at Sterlington.

You'll join the People Team and work closely with firm leadership.

  • Build a feedback cadence. Built around our firm-wide culture of feedback, support team members in receiving the feedback they need to propel their growth – not just an annual review.
  • Manage stakeholder relationships. Work closely with partners and firm leadership, tailoring your approach to each; this isn't a one-size-fits-all function.
  • Create a sense of community. Develop the programs and touchpoints that make associates feel like they belong to the firm, not just assigned to it.
  • Own learning & development. Design and manage L&D programs end-to-end, course design grounded in adult learning theory, that build associates' skills and support their career progression.
  • Coach and mentor. Work directly with associates as a people manager: coach individuals, resolve performance concerns, and help them navigate their development.

  • Bring a point of view on talent. Contribute to talent acquisition efforts, including future programs that grow our attorney team, and apply a working knowledge of US employment law where it touches development and performance.

  • Excellent English communication. Written and verbal — you'll be coaching attorneys and influencing leadership, so this needs to be a strength, not a gap.

  • The right temperament. People who thrive here don't wait to be told what to do — they're resilient, direct, transparent, and genuinely want to be part of a team. Comfort with ambiguity is table stakes, and being AI-forward and tech-savvy is essential.

jobs.description:
As a Salesforce Solution Architect, you are responsible for leading the design and implementation of Salesforce solutions that meet the business needs of PRO-spectus. This position works closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and develop comprehensive solutions leveraging the Salesforce platform. Your role will involve architecting scalable and sustainable solutions, guiding development teams, and ensuring alignment with best practices and industry standards.

This role will have a strong understanding of Salesforce CRM and its capabilities, coupled with the ability to customize and configure Salesforce to meet the needs of PRO-spectus. This role requires excellent communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and a deep understanding of PRO-spectus business processes.

Core Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Requirements Gathering:
    • Collaborating with stakeholders to understand business requirements, translating them into technical specifications, and identifying opportunities to leverage Salesforce products and features.
  • Solution Design:
    • Creating comprehensive technical solutions aligned with business requirements, leveraging the Salesforce platform's capabilities, including Health Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Salesforce Shield, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, and more.
  • Architecture Development:
    • Designing scalable and robust architecture solutions, including data models, system integrations, workflows, and customizations, ensuring adherence to best practices and standards.
    • Design and implementation of the Salesforce platform security model including visibility, accessibility, and sharing.
  • Salesforce Configuration and Customization:
    • Customize Salesforce applications by configuring standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, and workflow rules to meet business requirements.
    • Develop and maintain custom reports, dashboards, and workflows to provide actionable insights and streamline business processes.
    • Design, develop, test, and deploy Salesforce customizations including fields, objects, workflows, process builder, validation rules, and custom applications.
    • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify areas for process improvement and implement solutions within Salesforce; e.g., solutions within Salesforce to automate business processes and reduce manual tasks.
  • Solution Implementation:
    • Overseeing the configuration, customization, and development of Salesforce solutions, ensuring alignment with the agreed-upon architecture and design.
  • Technical Leadership:
    • Providing technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring the successful implementation and delivery of solutions.
  • Data, Analytics, and Integration Management:
    • Designing and implementing seamless integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise systems, including ERP, client CRMs, marketing automation, and other third-party applications.
    • Help maintain data integrity by defining and developing data governance policies, managing data quality, and performing regular data audits and clean-ups.
    • Administer data imports, exports, and data migrations between Salesforce and other integrated systems while ensuring data security and compliance.
    • Configure and maintain reports and dashboards to support client reporting needs.
  • Quality Assurance:
    • Conducting thorough testing and other quality assurance activities to ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of Salesforce solutions.
  • Documentation and Training:
    • Creating comprehensive technical documentation, including design documents, technical specifications, and user guides, and providing training and support to end-users as needed.
  • Stakeholder Management:
    • Leverage consultative approach, actively collaborating with business stakeholders (internal & external), project managers, developers, and other cross-functional teams, to ensure the successful delivery of Salesforce solutions on time and within budget.
    • Proactively identify user needs and implement enhancements to optimize user experience and drive adoption. Create and maintain user roles, profiles, permissions sets, and sharing rules.
  • Continuous Improvement:
    • Staying updated on the latest Salesforce features, best practices, and industry trends, and recommending enhancements to existing solutions to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Skills / Requirements

  • At least 5 years’ experience in a leading role in delivering Salesforce projects.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, customization, and administration.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security model and best practices.
  • Experience with Salesforce Health Cloud / Life Sciences in a production environment.
  • Experience configuring Salesforce reports and dashboards. Experience with Power BI is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
  • The following are preferred but not required:
    • Experience with Salesforce Lightning Experience.
    • Familiarity with agile/scrum methodologies.
    • Experience with Sales, Marketing or Service Cloud.
    • Working knowledge of data science programming languages; e.g., SQL, Python.

Education, Certifications and Experience:

  • Additional certifications such as Advanced Administrator (ADM 211) or Platform App Builder a plus.
  • Minimum 4+ years hands-on-keyboard Salesforce experience.
  • Experience in healthcare or proven ability to learn industry nuances quickly.
  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Administrator or similar role, with a deep understanding of Salesforce architecture, configuration, and customization.

Physical Requirements:

  • Keyboarding
  • Speaking
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times
  • Flexibility of working hours to support activities across EST to PST zones

At PRO-spectus we have created a culture that is supportive, dedicated, and teamwork driven. We celebrate each other’s joys in personal life and professional accomplishments, promoting meaningful relationships and friendships.

Our employees bring strength of mind and spirit to make the extraordinary happen every day. With humility and compassion at our core, PRO-spectus is proud of our relentless focus towards the higher purpose of improving the lives of patients we support.

  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.
  • A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures.
  • A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed.
  • A project you managed or a team you led or mentored.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

The Integration Lead owns the technical execution of every ERP integration Flick delivers. When a client runs SAP S/4HANA on-premise in Dubai, Oracle EBS in Riyadh, and Dynamics 365 for a subsidiary in Kuala Lumpur, you are the person who works out how invoice data leaves those systems, gets mapped to PINT AE or ZATCA or MyInvois format, and clears the tax authority - and then makes it happen.

This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory one. You will be in the field mappings, the middleware configuration, the connector deployments and the payload logs. As the team grows, you will guide Integration Consultants and Implementation Analysts on the technical approach for their projects.

  • Own the integration work stream end to end on enterprise implementations - from ERP discovery and field mapping through build, testing, go-live and hyper care
  • Design and implement data extraction and transformation from client ERPs into Flick's platform: REST/SOAP APIs, middleware flows, database views, scheduled file transfers and on-premise connectors
  • Minimum3 end-to-end ERP or enterprise integrations delivered, from discovery and design through production go-live.
  • Map client source fields to compliance formats - PINT AE / UBL 2.1 (UAE), ZATCA (KSA), MyInvois (Malaysia), FIRS (Nigeria), Fawtara (Oman) - including tax category, VAT treatment and document-type logic
  • Build and maintain Flick's integration playbooks per ERP (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zoho) so repeat implementations get faster each time
  • Deploy and troubleshoot on-premise connectors and AS4 transport in client-controlled environments, working alongside client IT and infrastructure teams

The Role

    Board Intelligence's clients include some of the most heavily regulated organisations in the world, and they trust us with highly sensitive board information. Security is fundamental to everything we build.

    • Build a clear picture of where our engineering security stands today, and agree a plan to improve it with the CTO and CISO

    • Bring consistent security tooling into every pipeline, including credential scanning, software composition analysis (SCA), static application security testing (SAST) and dynamic application security testing (DAST)

    • Configure that tooling to our standards so it helps engineers rather than creating noise they learn to ignore

    • Review system designs and architecture with engineering teams, applying security thinking early

    • Build agentic security testing: AI agents that continuously test our applications and alert engineers to issues

    • Work closely with our CISO and security team, turning security goals into working systems

    • Help engineers across the business build securely, through tooling, guidance and example

    • A genuine interest in security and a clear motivation to make it the focus of your work

    • The ability to influence engineers and win support for change without formal authority

    • Experience introducing security tooling, such as SAST, DAST, SCA or secret scanning, into an enterprise

    • DevOps experience in a regulated enterprise, such as financial services

    • Experience building AI agents or LLM-based automation

      • After three months: you understand our systems and how we build them, and you have agreed a clear security plan with the CTO and CISO. You have an initial view of our current engineering security posture

      • After six months: security scanning runs in every pipeline, tuned so that engineers trust it and act on it

      • After twelve months: agentic security testing is continuously testing our applications, and security is part of how every team designs and builds

Our Values

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

jobs.description:
Vill du bidra till att utveckla relevanta och användbara läromedel för gymnasiets yrkesprogram? Har du erfarenhet från yrkesutbildning och ett starkt intresse för språk, pedagogik och innehållsutveckling? Då kan ett långsiktigt konsultsamarbete med Liber vara något för dig.

Om uppdraget

Liber söker en redaktör för ett långsiktigt konsultsamarbete med fokus på utveckling och förvaltning av läromedel för gymnasiets yrkesprogram, framför allt bygg- och anläggningsprogrammet, VVS- och fastighetsprogrammet samt industritekniska programmet.

Som redaktör ansvarar du för det redaktionella arbetet och bidrar med ämnes- och målgruppsperspektiv genom hela processen – från idé och manusutveckling till färdig produkt i tryckt och digital form. Du arbetar nära författare, projektledare, yrkeslärare, branschrepresentanter, formgivare och illustratörer.

Du arbetar i nära samarbete med förläggaren. Förläggaren har det övergripande ansvaret för portföljen, prioriteringar och produktbeslut, medan du bidrar med redaktionell kompetens, ämneskunskap och förståelse för undervisning på yrkesprogram.

Dina huvudsakliga uppgifter

  • Planera och genomföra redaktionellt arbete i samarbete med förläggaren och övriga projektgruppen.

  • Bearbeta, strukturera och språkgranska elev- och lärarmaterial samt målgruppsanpassa innehållet.

  • Ge stöd till författare i manusarbete och följa upp innehållsfrågor under produktionen.

  • Bidra till att läromedlen följer aktuella ämnesplaner, styrdokument och behov i undervisningen.

  • Medverka i förvaltningen av befintliga tryckta och digitala produkter, bland annat genom att hantera ämnesspecifika frågor och föreslå förbättringar.

  • Bidra med underlag till sälj- och marknadsaktiviteter, exempelvis webbinarier och presentationer, när det är relevant för uppdraget.

Din profil

  • Du har erfarenhet från gymnasiets yrkesutbildningar, exempelvis som yrkeslärare inom något eller flera av de aktuella områdena.

  • Du har god förståelse för hur undervisning på yrkesprogram fungerar och för de behov som finns hos lärare och elever.

  • Du har god språklig förmåga och kan omsätta komplexa ämnesområden till tydliga och pedagogiska texter.

  • Du är strukturerad, noggrann och van att planera och driva redaktionellt arbete framåt.

  • Du trivs med många kontaktytor och har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av läromedelsutveckling, redaktionellt arbete eller andra roller där innehåll, pedagogik och kommunikation står i fokus.

Om Liber

Liber är en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom läromedel och kurslitteratur. Vi utvecklar genomtänkta och relevanta produkter och tjänster i både tryckt och digital form. Liber är en del av den europeiska koncernen Infinitas Learning.

Omfattning och upplägg

Samarbetet är långsiktigt och avses fortsätta över tid, med förlängning enligt överenskommelse. Omfattningen motsvarar cirka 50–100 procent av heltid, beroende på behov och överenskommelse. Start sker enligt överenskommelse. Det praktiska upplägget, inklusive arbetsplats och arbetstider, planeras i dialog med Liber.

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 30 november 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.

Kontaktperson: Per Granath Byrmo, avdelningschef.

Job Title: Program Integrity Auditor

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

The Program Integrity Auditor is responsible for the review of records for medical, behavioral, transportation, and other healthcare providers. The Auditor must have the ability to determine correct coding and appropriate documentation during the review of medical records. Activities include reviews/audits of provider records to ensure appropriate coding standards and documentation standards are being met. The Auditor will also be recommending follow-up action including (but not limited to) provider education, recoupment of funds or rebilling of claims, and referral to state regulators for any suspected fraud, waste, or abuse (FWA). The Auditor must also ensure that state and federal requirements are met and recognize any concerning billing patterns or trends.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as an audit team member for a health plan(s) which currently administers benefits to Medicaid members across multiple lines of business including acute, behavioral health, individuals with developmental disabilities, and children in out-of-home care.
  • Audit records on a routine basis, as well as records for audits (requested on an ad hoc basis) for all lines of business, in order to ensure coding and documentation meet regulatory standards. These may include (but are not limited to) appropriate code usage, appropriate modifier usage, appropriate place of service usage, etc.
  • Coordinate audit documentation and reports for review for internal and external staff and stakeholders.
  • Identify aberrant billing patterns and potential FWA, reporting this to internal staff. Assisting with further investigation and/or reports to state regulators through the utilization of developed critical thinking skills.
  • Assist with the development and implementation plan for prospective and retrospective FWA avoidance, detection, and referral.
  • Assist with the creation and submission of regulator deliverables through completion of timely audit activities.
  • Provide technical assistance and education to providers including training on regulatory requirements, as well as coding and documentation rules.
  • Maintain compliance with company policies and procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in reviewing and interpreting claims data, as well as medical records and appropriate documentation.
  • 3-5 years of experience with standard industry coding guidelines such as CPT, HCPCs, and ICD-10.
  • Willingness to work Monday-Friday from 8am-5pm Arizona Time Zone.
  • Must possess an active CPC (Certified Professional Coder), CCS (Certified Coding Specialist), or CPMA (Certified Professional Medical Auditor) license.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous auditing experience.
  • Previous Medicaid and/or health plan experience, including AHCCCS (Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System).
  • Previous experience with QuickBase.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate and work with a team, as well as work independently as needed.
  • Excellent presentational skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to be adaptable in a flexible environment.

Education

40

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Embedded Software Engineer or Software Architect specializing in Automotive Cybersecurity to join our engineering team.

In this role, you will drive the design, development, and integration of cybersecurity solutions for next-generation automotive systems. You will work across software, hardware, and manufacturing domains, ensuring that cybersecurity is embedded throughout the product development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate combines strong low-level software development skills with expertise in embedded architectures, cybersecurity engineering, cryptography, and automotive communication technologies. You will provide technical leadership, evaluate emerging security technologies, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and innovative automotive solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Cybersecurity Engineering and Risk Management

  • Conduct cybersecurity requirements analysis and reviews, identifying security implications and potential attack vectors.

  • Perform threat analysis and risk assessment (TARA), threat modeling, and cybersecurity design reviews.

  • Develop and implement security concepts and technical countermeasures to mitigate vulnerabilities and reduce cybersecurity risks.

  • Support cybersecurity assessments, audits, verification activities, and technical reviews throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Contribute to cybersecurity incident analysis, vulnerability management, and threat mitigation activities.

Software Architecture and Embedded Development

  • Define and review secure software architectures for embedded automotive systems.

  • Develop and evaluate low-level software solutions using C and embedded programming techniques.

  • Identify, customize, and leverage embedded platforms, operating systems, middleware, and system components.

  • Design and review hardware/software interfaces, including device drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and platform-specific integrations.

  • Evaluate and integrate security mechanisms across software, hardware, and connected services.

Automotive Cybersecurity Technologies

  • Design and support cryptographic mechanisms, secure boot, secure communication, authentication, and cryptographic key management.

  • Evaluate hardware-based security technologies, including Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Secure Hardware Extensions (SHE), ARM TrustZone, and Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs).

  • Analyze and secure automotive communication interfaces and protocols, including CAN, CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, Bluetooth, NFC, and Wi-Fi.

  • Assess emerging cybersecurity technologies and determine their suitability for future automotive applications.

  • Support the integration of cybersecurity requirements into hardware, software, and manufacturing processes.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance and cybersecurity expertise to software, hardware, systems, validation, and manufacturing teams.

  • Define implementation strategies for prototypes, proof-of-concept solutions, and technical demonstrations.

  • Guide engineering teams in adopting secure design principles, cybersecurity validation methodologies, and development best practices.

  • Review technical documentation, architecture designs, implementation approaches, and verification results.

  • Support cybersecurity knowledge sharing and the continuous improvement of engineering processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Strong proficiency in C programming and low-level embedded software development.

  • Solid understanding of embedded systems architecture, operating systems, networking, middleware, cryptography, and resource management.

  • Experience in embedded platform customization, system integration, or operating system-level development.

  • Practical experience in cybersecurity engineering, including threat analysis, risk assessment, vulnerability mitigation, and security design reviews.

  • Experience with security operations, incident handling, vulnerability analysis, or threat management.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Familiarity with engineering tools such as Enterprise Architect, Jira, and Polarion.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the automotive industry or development of safety- and security-critical embedded systems.

  • Knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE WP.29 cybersecurity requirements, and relevant SAE and ISO standards.

  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications, such as ISO/SAE 21434-related CSMS or cybersecurity engineering qualifications.

  • Hands-on experience with automotive communication protocols, including CAN, CAN-FD, and Automotive Ethernet.

  • Familiarity with Bluetooth, NFC, Wi-Fi, and connected vehicle technologies.

  • Ability to interpret electronic circuit schematics, hardware datasheets, and digital logic designs.

  • Experience designing and integrating device drivers, board support packages (BSPs), and hardware/software interfaces.

  • Knowledge of AUTOSAR Classic and/or Adaptive platforms.

  • Expertise in threat modeling, TARA, cybersecurity architecture, and security design reviews for emerging technologies.

  • Practical knowledge of hardware security technologies, including HSM, SHE, ARM TrustZone, and TEE.

  • Experience with secure boot, firmware integrity, software update security, key provisioning, and lifecycle key management.

Key Competencies:

  • Secure-by-design mindset.

  • Strong software architecture and embedded engineering expertise.

  • Ability to balance security, performance, reliability, and resource constraints.

  • Structured approach to threat analysis and risk-based decision-making.

  • Technical leadership and stakeholder management.

  • Curiosity about emerging technologies and continuous professional development.

Success Criteria:

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

  • Delivery of robust and maintainable cybersecurity architectures for embedded automotive systems.

  • Effective identification, assessment, and mitigation of cybersecurity risks.

  • Successful integration of security mechanisms across software and hardware components.

  • Improved cybersecurity validation practices and engineering processes.

  • Effective technical collaboration and knowledge transfer across development teams.

Customer Service Representative (CSR) – Remote

Customer Support | Phone | Email | Live Chat | Ticketing Systems

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Customer Service Representative (CSR) to deliver exceptional customer support across phone, email, live chat, and ticketing platforms.

This is a customer-first role where you’ll be responsible for:

  • Resolving customer inquiries
  • Managing support tickets
  • Troubleshooting issues
  • Maintaining customer satisfaction
  • Delivering timely, professional communication

You’ll serve as the frontline voice of the company, ensuring every customer receives a positive, solutions-focused experience while helping strengthen customer loyalty and retention.

If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and working in a fast-paced support environment, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

  • Handle inbound customer inquiries through:
    • Phone
    • Email
    • Live chat
    • Support tickets
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally and efficiently.
  • Troubleshoot common issues and escalate complex cases when necessary.
  • Deliver timely, high-quality customer support.
  • Manage multiple customer conversations while maintaining service quality.

Ticket & Case Management

  • Manage customer support tickets using platforms such as:
    • Zendesk
    • Freshdesk
    • Help Scout
    • Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Prioritize cases based on:
    • Urgency
    • SLA requirements
    • Business impact
  • Maintain accurate documentation of:
    • Customer interactions
    • Troubleshooting steps
    • Case resolutions
  • Monitor open cases through completion.

Customer Experience & Communication

  • Communicate clearly and professionally across all support channels.
  • De-escalate challenging customer situations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Build trust through proactive communication and consistent follow-up.
  • Capture customer feedback and identify recurring support trends.
  • Maintain a customer-first approach in every interaction.

Knowledge Base & Process Improvement

  • Maintain and update:
    • FAQs
    • Internal knowledge base articles
    • Support documentation
  • Improve:
    • Response templates
    • Support macros
    • Workflow documentation
  • Share recurring customer issues and improvement recommendations with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Operations
    • Billing
    • Technical Support
    • Product teams
  • Coordinate escalations and ensure smooth issue resolution.
  • Follow company policies, documentation standards, and privacy requirements.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in:
    • Customer Service
    • Customer Support
    • Call Center
    • Client-facing roles
  • Experience using customer support platforms such as:
    • Zendesk
    • Freshdesk
    • Salesforce Service Cloud
    • Help Scout
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent multitasking and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage high ticket volumes while maintaining quality.
  • Proficiency with:
    • Google Workspace
    • Microsoft Office
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers.
  • Background in:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Healthcare
    • Finance
    • Service-based businesses
  • Familiarity with:
    • Live chat platforms
    • Customer support automation tools
    • KPI-driven support environments
  • Multilingual communication skills.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy helping customers and solving problems.
  • You remain calm under pressure.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally.
  • You manage multiple priorities efficiently.
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized.
  • You take ownership of customer issues until they are fully resolved.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review and prioritize incoming support tickets.
  • Respond to customers via phone, email, and live chat.
  • Troubleshoot customer issues and coordinate escalations.
  • Document customer interactions and update support records.
  • Follow up on unresolved cases.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend service improvements.

In short: You deliver fast, professional, and solution-oriented customer support that strengthens customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • First Contact Resolution (FCR)
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Average response time
  • Average resolution time
  • SLA compliance
  • Ticket quality and documentation accuracy
  • Quality assurance (QA) performance

Why Join Us?

  • High-impact customer-facing role.
  • Opportunity to strengthen customer experience operations.
  • Exposure to modern customer support platforms and workflows.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Customer Support Representative
    • Customer Success Specialist
    • Team Lead
    • Operations Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Assessment (Customer Support Scenarios or Simulated Tickets)
  4. Client Interview with Support Leadership
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about helping customers, thrive in fast-paced support environments, and take pride in delivering outstanding service, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help create exceptional customer experiences every day.

jobs.description:
This position is posted on a continuous basis and does not have a fixed application close date. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

A Day in the Life and the Impact You’ll Make:

The Process Hazard Analysis Facilitator (PHA Facilitator) provides technical services and guidance to support Process Safety improvement activities globally (with a focus on USA and Canada) to clients in various industries. Position involves professional work in research, development, design, operation, evaluation, and improvement of chemical processes, plants, equipment, methods, or products with a primary emphasis in the areas of facilitating Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs). Provide recommendations for appropriate practical improvements, recommend testing (when needed), and assist clients in the interpretation and application of technical information applicable to their processing needs.

What You’ll Do:

  • Contribute to a safe and healthy work environment by actively participating, taking responsibility, and following established procedures and policies.
  • Primary responsibility will be to provide Process Hazard Analysis studies support which includes
    • Prepare, facilitate, and scribe PHA studies through a variety of methodologies (What-If, Checklist, FMEA, HAZOP, HAZID, etc.) and Layer of Protection Analysis (LOPA).
    • Selecting the PHA methodology based on the complexity of the process and hazards involved.
    • Ensure PHA scenarios, consequences, safeguards, and recommendations are complete and correctly identified and captured in the PHA software (PHAPro or similar)
    • Write and review technical reports.
    • Read and interpret piping and instrumentation drawings (P&ID), mechanical drawings, process flow diagrams, block flow diagrams, electrical line diagram etc.
    • Understand and comply with DEKRA and client procedures.
    • Ability to conduct PHAs and/or training in person as well as virtual
  • Effective and continued communication with clients and consulting team.
  • Able to work with a team on projects and independently on projects or tasks.
  • Perform technical reviews for peers which could include marketing papers, presentations, reports, etc.
  • Other duties may be assigned to meet business needs.
  • Be client-facing, having a proven record of building and maintaining positive and professional client relationships.

What You'll Bring:

  • BS (or Higher) in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, or Fire Protection) or other safety related field
  • Formal training in various PHA methodologies and LOPA is desired with a minimum experience of 5 years. Experience in facilitating PHAs in the Oil & Gas Industry is preferred.
  • Safety-related designation preferred (CSP, CFEI, CCPSC, PE, etc.)
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in process safety management
  • Experience and strong knowledge in safety-related areas (PSM, RMP, combustible dust, chemical reaction hazards, flammable liquids/gases, etc.) is preferred.
  • Knowledge of relevant safety standards and regulations (NFPA, Building & Fire Codes, OSHA, etc.) is preferred.
  • Strong personal communications and leadership skills
  • Must be able to work well under pressure within a team environment
  • Must deliver reports and analysis documents within time-driven deadlines

Physical Considerations:

  • Must be able to work in a variety of client locations, environments, and conditions. This may include climbing stairs, walking long distances, walking on rough and uneven terrain, walking through client work facilities, working in heat/cold conditions, indoors and outdoors.
  • Must be able to accommodate working during various shifts as client activities are scheduled.
  • Must be able to withstand the rigors of extensive travel.
  • May require difficult travel and long periods of driving.
  • Ability to move and conduct work with full range of motion.
  • Ability to lift 25-50lbs (luggage)
  • Extended periods of computer-based work
  • Extended periods of standing

Required Travel:

  • Position requires travel, up to 50%, and may require international travel.

What You’ll Receive for the Value You Bring:

Compensation:

This position allows for hourly professional fees according to confirmed project work; with fees ranging from $40/hour to $150/hour. Actual pay is based on several factors including market location, position-related knowledge, skills, and experience, and placement in a specific consulting level based on experience and work history.

Additional Position Details:

  • Reports to: Process Safety Consulting Manager
  • Work Model: Remote
  • Work Location: US-based Remote
  • Supervises Others: No
  • Status: Part-Time, Flexible
  • FLSA Classification: Non-exempt
  • Visa Sponsorship Eligibility: This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship

Growth in DEKRA:

DEKRA colleagues are welcome to apply for any position that is a potential match with their qualifications if performance in their current role is in good standing. The career path following this specific role is as follows:

  • Process Safety Engineer II

As a global provider of comprehensive services and solutions, we help our customers improve their safety, security, and sustainability outcomes. DEKRA is the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification (TIC) companies offering innovative professional services in the fields of vehicle inspection, expert appraisals, industrial product testing & certification, management system certifications, leadership consulting, and much more. DEKRA is a purpose-driven organization with a deep passion to make the world a safer place on the road, at work, and at home. jobs.description:
Video Editor – Remote

Video Editing | Motion Graphics | Social Media Content | Brand Storytelling

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Flexible to support deadlines and campaign launches)

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Video Editor to create engaging, high-quality video content across social media, marketing campaigns, training materials, and branded content.

This is more than a traditional editing role. You’ll transform raw footage into polished, platform-optimized videos that strengthen brand awareness, improve engagement, and support business growth.

Working closely with marketing and creative teams, you’ll produce everything from short-form social videos and paid advertising creatives to explainer videos, educational content, and long-form productions.

If you have a strong eye for storytelling, pacing, audience retention, and visual quality—and enjoy bringing ideas to life through video—this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Storytelling

  • Edit raw footage into polished videos for:
    • Social media
    • Marketing campaigns
    • Websites
    • Internal training
    • Branded content
  • Create compelling stories through:
    • Pacing
    • Sequencing
    • Transitions
    • Visual flow
  • Produce engaging short-form and long-form videos.
  • Ensure every edit aligns with brand guidelines and campaign objectives.
  • Deliver clean, professional content with exceptional attention to detail.

Motion Graphics & Visual Branding

  • Add:
    • Titles
    • Captions
    • Lower thirds
    • Callouts
    • Logos
    • Motion graphics
  • Create simple animations and branded visual elements.
  • Maintain consistency across all video deliverables.
  • Elevate content through modern editing techniques and creative enhancements.

Audio Editing & Color Correction

  • Synchronize audio and video accurately.
  • Improve sound quality through:
    • Noise reduction
    • Audio balancing
    • Sound mastering
  • Add licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and color grading to deliver polished final products.

Multi-Platform Video Production

  • Export videos optimized for:
    • YouTube
    • TikTok
    • Instagram
    • LinkedIn
    • Facebook
    • Company websites
  • Deliver multiple aspect ratios and platform-specific formats.
  • Optimize compression while maintaining high visual quality.
  • Ensure every video is publishing-ready and aligned with platform best practices.

Collaboration & Workflow Management

  • Collaborate with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Creative leads
    • Internal stakeholders
  • Manage feedback and revision cycles efficiently.
  • Maintain organized project files, raw footage, assets, and archives.
  • Utilize collaboration platforms such as:
    • Google Drive
    • Dropbox
    • Similar project management tools

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Proficiency with at least one of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
    • Final Cut Pro
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Storytelling
    • Video pacing
    • Audio editing
    • Color correction
  • Experience exporting content for social media and web platforms.
  • Strong project organization and file management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and time management.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with:
    • Adobe After Effects
    • Motion graphics
    • Animation
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertisements
    • UGC content
    • Performance marketing creatives
  • Understanding of:
    • Watch time
    • Engagement metrics
    • Click-through rate (CTR)
  • Experience in:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Agencies
    • Media companies
    • Content-driven businesses
  • Familiarity with social-first editing styles for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube Shorts

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Creative storyteller with a strong visual eye.
  • Excellent understanding of audience engagement and retention.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple editing projects.
  • Comfortable receiving and implementing feedback.
  • Passionate about creating high-performing content.
  • Able to balance speed, quality, and consistency under deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and brand consistency.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review raw footage and organize project assets.
  • Edit videos for social media, campaigns, training, and branded content.
  • Add captions, graphics, transitions, music, and visual effects.
  • Perform audio cleanup and color grading.
  • Export multiple platform-specific versions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders through review cycles.
  • Maintain organized project files and documentation.

In short: You transform raw footage into engaging, high-quality video content that strengthens brand storytelling, supports marketing campaigns, and drives audience engagement.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • On-time delivery of video projects
  • High editing quality with minimal revision rounds
  • Strong audience engagement and video performance
  • Consistent brand alignment across all content
  • Organized project files and asset management
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on creativity, quality, and turnaround time

Why Join Us?

  • Work on a diverse range of creative marketing projects.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing and leadership teams.
  • Opportunity to produce content that directly impacts brand growth and audience engagement.
  • Fully remote work environment with creative ownership.
  • Exposure to modern video production tools and content strategies.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Video Editor
    • Motion Graphics Designer
    • Creative Lead
    • Multimedia Producer
    • Creative Director

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Portfolio Review & Practical Editing Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re a creative video editor who enjoys transforming ideas into engaging visual stories, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in delivering polished, high-quality content, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help create compelling videos that drive engagement, strengthen brands, and support business growth.

This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

jobs.description:
RESPONSABLE DE L’IMPLÉMENTATION CLIENT

FCM adopte une approche globale des voyages d’affaires et se spécialise dans la gestion de programmes de voyages nationaux et internationaux pour les entreprises de moyenne et grande envergure.
Classée parmi les cinq plus grandes sociétés de gestion de voyages au monde, FCM dispose d’un réseau d’affaires présent dans plus de 97 pays, avec des sièges sociaux mondiaux à Londres, Brisbane, Singapour et New York. Appuyée par la force mondiale de Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combine une expertise locale et une portée internationale afin d’offrir à ses clients une expérience véritablement personnalisée.
Fondée en juin 2004, FCM a été nommée Meilleure société de gestion de voyages au monde pendant huit années consécutives aux World Travel Awards.

Pour en savoir plus sur FCM, veuillez cliquer ICI


À propos du poste

Joignez-vous à FCM à titre de Responsable de l’implémentation client et jouez un rôle clé dans la prestation d’une expérience d’intégration fluide auprès de clients nationaux et multinationaux. Ce poste est au cœur de la réussite client, veillant à ce que les nouveaux clients soient implantés avec succès, soutenus efficacement et positionnés en vue d’un partenariat à long terme. Vous collaborerez avec les parties prenantes internes et les équipes clientes, gérerez plusieurs projets d’implémentation simultanément et contribuerez à l’atteinte de résultats exceptionnels pour la clientèle. Si vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, coordonner des projets et offrir une expérience client remarquable, cette occasion vous permettra d’avoir un impact concret.

Responsabilités principales

  • Gérer l’implémentation et l’intégration de clients nationaux et multinationaux conformément aux processus d’implémentation établis.
  • Offrir une expérience client d'une qualité supérieure tout au long du cycle de vie de chaque projet.
  • Coordonner et animer les réunions d’implémentation avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Assurer le suivi des échéanciers et veiller au respect des jalons convenus pour chaque implémentation.
  • Identifier, communiquer et escalader les risques liés aux projets en appliquant les méthodologies de gestion des risques en place.
  • Maintenir à jour et avec exactitude la documentation d’implémentation, les énoncés de travaux (SOW) et les dossiers de projet.
  • Recueillir et valider de manière proactive les informations nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet.
  • Soutenir les projets d’implémentation régionaux pour les clients multinationaux ainsi que l’adoption continue des outils en ligne.
  • Assurer le suivi de l’avancement des projets et des échéanciers au moyen des outils internes de gestion de projet.
  • Veiller au respect des normes, systèmes, processus et meilleures pratiques liés à l’implémentation.
  • Collaborer efficacement avec les collègues, les gestionnaires et les parties prenantes afin d’atteindre les objectifs d’implémentation.
  • Appuyer les activités de tests d’acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) et veiller à l’exactitude des implémentations.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue grâce aux revues de projet et aux commentaires des clients.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus dans leur réussite.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche ou responsabilité connexe assignée.
  • Autres tâches et responsabilités assignées
  • Contribuer à un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus afin de s’épanouir

Expérience et compétences

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience au sein de Flight Centre ou 2 ans d’expérience à titre de Gestionnaire de l’implémentation ou dans un poste similaire.
  • Excellente compréhension des processus d’implémentation.
  • Feuille de route démontrée en matière de réussite dans des fonctions antérieures.
  • Solides compétences en coordination de projets et en gestion du temps.
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
  • Fort sens des affaires et excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des clients et des parties prenantes à divers niveaux organisationnels.
  • Connaissance des outils de réservation en ligne, un atout.
  • Approche souple et grande capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement d’affaires en constante évolution.
  • Disponibilité pour effectuer des déplacements occasionnels, au besoin.
  • Bilinguisme (français et anglais) requis
  • Une connexion Internet fiable et à haut débit est requise pour assurer les responsabilités essentielles du poste, y compris, sans s’y limiter, la vidéoconférence, l’accès aux systèmes de l’entreprise et le traitement sécurisé des données de l’entreprise.
  • Le bilinguisme français/anglais est requis, en raison de la nature du poste qui consiste à traiter avec des clients et des fournisseurs français et anglais.

Des conditions de travail qui ont de quoi séduire!

FCTG est reconnu dans le monde entier pour ses magnifiques conditions de travail et sa culture entrepreneuriale encore plus exceptionnelle. Nous savons que notre personnel est notre atout le plus précieux. C’est la passion et le dévouement de nos équipes qui maintiennent notre entreprise au sommet de son industrie. C’est également la raison pour laquelle nous offrons des avantages sociaux et des primes hors du commun à notre personnel.

  • Amusez-vous: l’importance d’avoir du plaisir au travail imprègne chacun de nos gestes.
  • Obtenez des récompenses et une reconnaissance: voyez vos succès et ceux des autres être applaudis lors des fameuses soirées Buzz que nous organisons régulièrement, ainsi qu’au rassemblement mondial annuel. Il faut le vivre pour le croire !
  • Puisez dans votre génie : nos collaborateurs se servent de leur vivacité d’esprit, de leur savoir-faire et de leur persévérance pour trouver en tout temps une solution.
  • L’amour du voyage : notre société a été fondée par des personnes qui voulaient voyager et qui souhaitaient que d’autres en fassent autant. Cette passion marque immanquablement tout notre personnel et l’ensemble de nos services.
  • Des liens personnels : le fondement de notre grande entreprise repose sur les relations personnelles.
  • Diversité, équité et inclusion : engagement envers la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion à travers des initiatives telles que la Journée de la diversité (congé payé pour observer un jour férié ou une célébration culturelle de votre choix) Groupes de ressources pour les employés (équité raciale, équité des genres, LGBTQ2IA+, accessibilité, justice environnementale ), les initiatives éducatives du DEI et les pratiques équitables, y compris des évaluations régulières de l'équité et des protocoles de recrutement inclusifs.
  • Une carrière, et non un boulot: nous offrons à tous de véritables possibilités de croissance et d’évolution personnelle.
  • Nous offrons notre soutien tout temps à nos employés : nous nous engageons fermement à soutenir chaque employé dans son développement professionnel et personnel.
  • Redonner en retour : nous nous engageons à faire une différence grâce à notre programme de responsabilité sociale d'entreprise, qui soutient les organismes de bienfaisance désignés via le bénévolat et la collecte de fonds, notre programme environnemental de bureau, des espaces de bureau certifiés LEED® Gold et une journée de bénévolat rémunérée par année civile.

Voici un aperçu des avantages offerts :
Avantages

  • Politique généreuse de congés payés
  • Avantages et rabais liés aux voyages
  • Programmes de santé et de bien-être et services de bien-être financier pour les employés
  • Soirées de reconnaissance et conférences nationales et internationals
  • Avantages sociaux collectifs, incluant l’assurance maladie complémentaire, les soins dentaires et de la vue, les soins d’affirmation de genre et les soins de fertilité
  • Assurances, incluant l’assurance vie, l’assurance décès et mutilation accidentels, l’assurance maladies graves et l’assurance invalidité de longue durée
  • Programme d’aide aux employés
  • REER/RPA avec contribution de l’employeur
  • Programme de remboursement des frais de scolarité
  • Régime d’actionnariat des employés – possibilité d’acheter des actions de la société à la Bourse australienne, avec une contribution partielle de l’employeur, sous réserve des modalités et conditions applicables
  • Possibilités de carrière à l’échelle mondiale au sein d’un réseau de marques et d’entreprises

Emplacement – TÉLÉTRAVAIL, Canada

Si vous pensez que c’est là le poste que vous cherchiez et que vous souhaitez adhérer à notre culture entrepreneuriale primée, POSTULEZ SANS TARDER.

Cette offre d'emploi correspond à un poste vacant que nous cherchons actuellement à pourvoir.

Dans le cadre de notre processus de recrutement, nous pouvons utiliser des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour soutenir différentes étapes, notamment la présélection et l’évaluation des candidatures. Ces outils nous aident à évaluer les candidats en fonction des qualifications, des compétences et de l’expérience pertinentes pour le poste. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont prises par notre équipe de recrutement et les parties prenantes concernées.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de candidats ayant des expériences variées.

Avant de postuler à un poste interne, vous devez être dans l'entreprise ou dans votre poste actuel depuis au moins 6 à 12 mois et en informer votre responsable avant de postuler.

Vous avez des questions sur cette opportunité? Communiquez avec notre équipe de recrutement à l'adresse

Pour ce poste, nous prévoyons offrir un salaire annuel compris entre 88 000 $ et 90 000 $. Le salaire de base sera établi en fonction de divers facteurs pertinents, notamment l’expérience, l’emplacement géographique et les exigences du poste.

Notre philosophie numéro un? Nos employés. La promesse de Flight Centre Travel Group est de fournir un environnement où prônent le respect, la dignité et des opportunités pour tous nos employés. Nous valorisons un lieu de travail inclusif et solidaire qui reflète véritablement la diversité de notre société.

Bookkeeper (Property Management | Buildium & QuickBooks Online) – Remote

Property Management | Buildium | QuickBooks Online | Bank Reconciliations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Latin America (Remote)
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)
Compensation:$1,500–$2,000 USD/month

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Bookkeeper to support the financial operations of a growing property management company.

This is a hands-on bookkeeping role where you’ll be responsible for:

  • Bank reconciliations
  • Property management accounting
  • Accounts payable
  • Financial reporting
  • QuickBooks Online & Buildium management

You’ll work closely with the property management team to ensure accurate financial records, timely reporting, and efficient accounting operations across multiple properties and business entities.

If you enjoy maintaining organized financial records, solving discrepancies, and supporting property management operations, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Bank Reconciliations & Financial Accuracy

  • Reconcile multiple bank accounts across various properties using Buildium.
  • Review financial records for accuracy and completeness.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies and outstanding items.
  • Maintain audit-ready financial documentation.

Bookkeeping & Accounting

  • Maintain multiple QuickBooks Online company files.
  • Record and categorize financial transactions accurately.
  • Ensure accounting records align with NARPM Chart of Accounts guidelines.
  • Keep financial records organized and up to date.

Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

  • Monitor payment schedules and outstanding bills.
  • Prevent duplicate payments and billing errors.
  • Coordinate with vendors regarding payment inquiries.

Property Management Accounting

  • Prepare owner draws accurately and on time.
  • Reconcile Buildium and QuickBooks Online data.

    • Owner statements
    • Trust account management (when applicable)

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare monthly financial reports and summaries.
  • Support leadership with financial reporting requests.
  • Maintain supporting schedules and documentation.
  • Deliver reports accurately and on schedule.

Process Improvement

  • Improve bookkeeping workflows and accounting processes.
  • Maintain consistency between Buildium and QuickBooks Online.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Assist in documenting accounting procedures and best practices.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of bookkeeping experience.
  • Experience in:
    • Property management
    • Real estate bookkeeping
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Buildium
    • QuickBooks Online
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Bank reconciliations
    • Bookkeeping principles
  • Experience managing multiple accounts and entities.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and dedicated home office.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing books for a property management company.
  • Experience working with multiple LLCs.
  • Familiarity with:
    • NARPM Chart of Accounts
    • Florida landlord-tenant accounting practices
  • Experience preparing owner statements.
  • Experience managing trust accounts.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Experience improving accounting workflows and financial systems.

Tools & Technology

  • Buildium
  • QuickBooks Online
  • Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail)
  • Property Management Accounting Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • You maintain a high level of financial accuracy.
  • You can manage multiple properties and entities simultaneously.
  • You proactively identify discrepancies and resolve issues.
  • You communicate professionally with internal teams and vendors.
  • You thrive in structured, deadline-driven environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Reconcile bank accounts.
  • Review financial transactions.
  • Process accounts payable.
  • Update QuickBooks Online.
  • Verify Buildium records.
  • Calculate management fees and owner draws.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports.
  • Investigate discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with property managers on financial matters.

In short: You help keep the company’s financial records accurate, organized, and compliant while supporting the successful operation of multiple managed properties.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Accuracy of bank reconciliations
  • Timely monthly financial reporting
  • Accounts payable accuracy
  • Reduction of financial discrepancies
  • Accurate owner draw and management fee calculations
  • Data consistency between Buildium and QuickBooks Online
  • Timely month-end close activities
  • Overall financial record accuracy

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Fully remote role based in Latin America.
  • Opportunity to work with a growing U.S. property management company.

Interview Process

  1. Assessment (10–15 minutes)

  3. Client Interview

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now
