jobs.description:
overview of position

Editor-in-Chief (Paediatric), International Journal of Language and Communication Disorders (IJLCD)

We are seeking an Editor-in-Chief (Paediatric) for the IJLCD to co-lead our supportive editorial team from February 2027.

The IJLCD is an international, peer-reviewed, clinically applied journal, which draws together findings from research in speech, language, communication, and swallowing disorders.

The role of Editor-in-Chief is a senior leadership position in SLT research. It offers the post-holder the opportunity to lead on strategic and editorial development of the journal, to maximise the dissemination of high-quality research in the field of communication and swallowing disorders.

the role

The successful candidate for this position will:

  • Have a PhD in a relevant academic discipline
  • Have extensive knowledge, skills, and senior experience in research
  • Have extensive experience handling peer-review / in academic publishing, ideally at least at an Associate Editor level
  • Have a working understanding of current key issues and opportunities in academic publishing, including the Open Science, implications of AI and other items
  • Have knowledge, skills, and experience in leadership and strategic development
  • Commit to carrying out the role for a minimum term of three years

Senior clinical and research experience as an SLT and membership of the RCSLT are desirable. Applicants from diverse backgrounds and/or under-represented groups are welcomed.

what we can offer you

This role receives an annual payment of £3,500 (with 2% increase per year).

how to apply

Application procedure

Applicants should send a covering letter, curriculum vitae and list of publications along with a short statement outlining the following:

  • An assessment of the strengths and areas for development for the IJLCD, presenting a vision for the IJLCD and how they would like to see it develop in the short and longer term.

Please send applications by 9:00am on 05/10/2026.

Applicants will be invited to attend a virtual interview in October/November (date and times tbc).

Please note: We will be actively reviewing applications. If the right candidate is found before closing date, we may close the recruitment process.

For further information please contact RCSLT’s Head of Research & Outcomes or the current Editor in Chief (paediatric), Jill Titterington .

our commitment to equity, diversity, and belonging (edb)

IJLCD is published by Wiley on behalf of the RCSLT. As a signatory to the Joint Commitment for Action on Inclusion and Diversity in Publishing, which aims to drive positive change within scholarly publishing, Wiley is committed to implementing sustainable and positive change to advance diversity, equity, and inclusion through the editorial processes and policies of its publications. This includes encouraging diversity, equity, and inclusivity within our editorial teams, reviewers, and authors as appropriate and consistent with local regulations. Our publications do not tolerate harassment or discrimination against an individual on the grounds of age, ancestry, colour, religious creed, physical or mental disability, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, national origin, race, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual identity, sexual orientation, political affiliation, or any other category protected by law.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Nurse Practitioner to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:
  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed
  • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Per diem employees qualify for:
  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)
  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)
  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications
  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)
  • Board certification (required)
  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

12

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$37.66 - $81.11

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Great benefits for great people

jobs.description:
CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.

Check out our website for more information:

We are currently hiring a Staff Security Engineer within the Imunify360 product.

Imunify360 is CloudLinux's security suite for Linux web servers. It protects hundreds of thousands of hosting servers and the websites running on them, so it sees most large-scale web attacks early — often in the first hours.

Check out our website for more information:

Role Mission & Scope

At Imunify360, protecting customers from evolving cyber threats requires close collaboration between security research, engineering, and other teams. Responding to complex attack campaigns involves more than identifying threats — it requires understanding attack techniques, developing effective detection and mitigation strategies, and ensuring customers are protected.

As a Staff Security Engineer, you'll take end-to-end technical ownership of complex security challenges, from initial threat discovery and analysis to detection, mitigation, and post-incident review.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on practical security engineering rather than SOC monitoring, compliance, or purely theoretical research. You'll analyze malware and exploit code, develop detection and mitigation tools, anticipate emerging attack techniques, and ensure security findings translate into production-ready detections, mitigations, and fixes.

You'll work closely with engineering, security research, support, external partners, and the broader security community to coordinate responses and drive continuous improvements in our security capabilities.

As an individual contributor, you won't have direct reports or people management responsibilities. All security research and testing are conducted within authorized boundaries, with clearly defined scope and responsible disclosure practices.

Your mission is to strengthen Imunify360's ability to detect, prevent, and respond to emerging threats, delivering measurable security improvements that protect customers at scale.

What you will own

Malware and campaign mitigation

  • Lead response to large-scale exploitation and malware campaigns: triage, root cause, and mitigation across every protection layer of the product.
  • Reverse-engineer malware and exploits targeting Linux servers and web applications.
  • Track campaigns over time, not just individual samples: cluster indicators, connect activity to known actors and toolkits, anticipate the next variant.
  • Define and run measurable outcomes per campaign: time to detect, time to protect, cleanup effectiveness, reinfection rate.

Security response coordination

  • Own the security incident and response process, both for threats against our customers and for vulnerabilities in our own product: severity model, runbooks, communication, escalation.
  • Coordinate with external parties — software vendors, partners, CERTs/CSIRTs, abuse desks, other security vendors. Drive responsible disclosure where we find vulnerabilities.
  • Be the technical voice in security advisories and partner briefings, together with Product and Support.
  • Triage external vulnerability reports.

Offensive security on our own product

  • Red-team our product and infrastructure. Assume a capable attacker who already has a foothold.
  • Threat-model new features before they ship; own the security review gate for high-risk changes.
  • Turn findings into fixes with the owning teams, not just reports.

Detection engineering and tooling

  • Raise the quality bar of detections: false-positive budgets, test corpora, staged rollout with measurement gates and fast rollback.
  • Build and automate the analysis pipeline: dynamic analysis, honeypots, telemetry-driven hunting, ML-assisted triage where it measurably helps.
  • Write production code for these tools; expect 30–50% of your time to be hands-on building.
  • Turn telemetry into intelligence: emerging exploits, attacker infrastructure, trends — shared as internal briefs and selected public research.

People multiplier (no direct reports)

  • Mentor analysts and engineers; raise the security skill level across teams.
  • Bar-raiser in security hiring loops.

Key Milestones

  • 30 days: Analyzed real threats end-to-end. Mapped the current response flow and where it breaks. Shipped at least one detection or mitigation to production.
  • 90 days: Security response process and severity model published and agreed. Led at least one real campaign response with a written post-mortem. Baseline response metrics in place.
  • 6 months: Time from first sighting to protection measurably reduced vs. baseline. First red-team review completed, top findings fixed. Working relationships with key external partners.
  • 12 months: Recognized internally and externally as the owner of security response. Public research or disclosures published. Teams can run a standard campaign response without you.

Requirements

Must have

  • 10+ years in security engineering, malware research, incident response, or offensive security, with several years leading cross-team work at Staff/Principal/Lead scope.
  • Deep hands-on malware analysis and reverse engineering skills.
  • Strong web application security and practical exploitation experience.
  • Deep Linux knowledge from both the attacker's and the defender's side.
  • Proven incident response leadership on large-scale events: you have run the response, written the advisory, and closed the post-mortem.
  • Production coding in Python plus a systems language (Go, Rust or C).
  • Experience with coordinated vulnerability disclosure and working with the security community.
  • Clear, short writing for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders; works well async across time zones.
  • Daily user of AI tools for analysis and coding, with critical judgment about their output.

Nice to have

  • Background in hosting or large web ecosystems.
  • Detection authoring at scale (signatures, WAF/IDS rules).
  • Kernel-level monitoring and rootkit detection.
  • Threat intelligence practice and actor tracking.
  • ML for malware classification.
  • Public track record: CVEs, published research, talks, CTFs, open-source security tools.
  • Relevant certifications are a plus, not a requirement.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • Stay hands-on technically while owning complex, high-impact engineering work.
  • Work on challenging Linux, automation, and cybersecurity problems across mature and newer products.
  • Influence technical direction and make meaningful architectural decisions.
  • Work independently with a high level of ownership and autonomy.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours.
  • 24 paid vacation days, 10 national holidays, and unlimited sick leave.
  • Private medical insurance compensation.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Education budget.
  • Opportunity to receive a reward for innovative ideas that the company can patent.

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence™ (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform.Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity, Ecstatic Clients, and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun—celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Commercial Systems is responsible for owning and evolving the commercial systems that power EnableComp's go-to-market engine — Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, and Accord. This role treats the commercial stack as a product: a connected operating system that should get smarter, faster, and more automated every quarter, not just kept running. The ideal candidate is the owner and steward of how EnableComp's revenue systems talk to each other, and increasingly, how AI does the connecting — using tools like Claude to redesign workflows and reduce manual work across the commercial organization, not just administer existing configuration.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as platform owner for Salesforce (system of record), HubSpot (marketing/demand gen), Gong (conversation intelligence), Clay (data enrichment/workflow automation), and Accord (mutual action plans/deal execution).
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and Client Success leadership to prioritize the systems roadmap and translate business requirements into technical specs and developer handoffs.
  • Develop and maintain the integration design across these tools — object models, data flows, triggers, and automations — so information moves cleanly from first touch to closed-won to renewal.
  • Analyze and translate GTM strategy into system design: new motions, territory or segmentation changes, and reporting needs all become clean, scalable configuration, not spaghetti workarounds.
  • Lead the use of AI (Claude and similar tools) as a core part of how the team works — building AI-assisted workflows, automations, and internal tools that reduce manual admin work across the commercial org.
  • Conduct data integrity and governance reviews across the stack: field standards, deduplication, permissioning, and audit-readiness.
  • Coordinate dashboards and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and rep performance.
  • Evaluate and pilot new RevTech and AI capabilities, building the business case and rollout plan for anything recommended.
  • Identify and manage the systems side of the deal lifecycle — pipeline stages, forecasting categories, quoting/CPQ-adjacent workflows, and MAP/mutual-close-plan tooling via Accord.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered)
  • 5+ years administering or managing Salesforce in a commercial/RevOps context (certifications a plus, not required)
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Gong, and ideally Clay and/or Accord (or clearly transferable tools in the same category)
  • Real, demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build workflows, automate tasks, or transform how a system or team operates — not just casual use
  • Strong SQL/SOQL or equivalent query fluency, and comfort translating messy business asks into clean data models
  • Experience writing technical specs and partnering with developers or implementation vendors to ship system changes
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills; healthcare, RCM, or complex B2B sales environment experience is a plus
  • Timely and regular attendance.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES

  • Minimal travel required (occasional on-site collaboration or team events).
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • A product mindset — comfortable owning a roadmap, prioritizing competing requests, and iterating based on feedback; genuine curiosity about applying AI to eliminate manual, repetitive work
  • Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission.
EnableComp is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V. All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment.
EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you.
Don’t just take our word for it! Hear what our people are saying:
“I love my job because everyone shares the same vision and is determined and dedicated. People care about you as a person and your professional growth. There is a genuine spirit of cooperation and shared goals all revolving around helping each other.” – Revenue Specialist
“I enjoy working for EnableComp because of the Core Values we believe in. EnableComp stands true to these values from empowering employees to ecstatic clients. This company is family oriented and flexible, along with understanding the balance of work, life, and fun.” – Supervisor, Operations

Job Title: In-Home Physician Full Time - Columbus

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

jobs.excerpt: About InvestEngineInvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need.
jobs.description:
About InvestEngine

InvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need. Unbeatable value, market-leading automation, and built for easy, long-term investing. We’ve built a strong foundation, have over £3 billion invested, award-winning service, and a passionate team, now we’re ready to scale.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Designer to join our Growth stream and help deliver consistently high-quality product design work at pace.

This is a hands-on IC contract role. The core expectation is simple: deliver build-ready design with low churn. Especially on our highest-priority, higher-risk customer journeys, that means getting work to a confident, build-ready state with minimal rework, through strong upfront clarity, solid collaboration and good judgement.

You'll work closely with Product and Engineering day to day, and partner with Design on standards, craft and our evolving Design System

What You’ll Do

  • Own design work end-to-end in the Growth stream, from early framing through to build-ready delivery and iteration after release

  • Produce clear, implementation-ready design output such as flows, states, edge cases, content and acceptance criteria, so engineering has less back-and-forth

  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to clarify problems early and avoid late-stage rework

  • Contribute to Design System usage and consistency through your delivery, reusing and improving patterns where needed

  • Use AI as part of your workflow to accelerate exploration and delivery, in a way that stays repeatable and legible to the team

  • Take part in our research and evidence practice. We run concept, usability and comprehension testing across the team, and you'll help plan and run studies, then turn findings and product and behavioural data into design decisions

  • Design in a regulated context, with a strong bias toward clarity, fair treatment and customer comprehension

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience designing digital products as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex product experiences.

  • Strong product design craft, spanning interaction design, systems thinking and end-to-end journey ownership

  • Comfortable being hands-on with research. You're happy to get stuck into user research as part of the role, with our support, and you make design decisions from evidence rather than opinion

  • Data-driven design. You use product and behavioural data, along with experiment results, to frame problems, prioritise and prove that designs actually work

  • High ownership and autonomy, comfortable operating as a senior contractor, clarifying ambiguity and driving work forward

  • Excellent collaboration, working as a partner to Product and Engineering rather than a service desk

  • Pragmatic judgement on quality versus speed, knowing where polish matters most

  • Comfort working within a design system and contributing to it

  • Comprehension-first, fair-treatment mindset. You design for genuine customer understanding, not just usability. Experience in a regulated environment such as financial services, insurance, healthcare, gambling or utilities is a strong advantage, but what matters most is that you can clearly evidence this mindset, whether or not it comes from regulated work

  • English fluency (C1 level and above) — we are a UK-based company, and the role involves regular communication with the team

Nice to Have

  • Experience with growth experimentation and funnel optimisation

  • Strong prototyping skills for quick validation

  • Prior experience operationalising AI in team workflows, beyond personal use

  • Fintech or investing-domain experience specifically. Regulated experience is a strong advantage, and the sector itself is a bonus

How We Work

We’re a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership, and transparency.
You’ll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to follow through, and the backing of a team that values clear thinking and open dialogue. We believe in solving problems at the root, not just treating the symptoms.

What We Offer

Impact from day one
You’ll take on meaningful work from the start, tackling real challenges that drive the stability, efficiency, and growth of our business.

Room to grow
As we scale, you’ll have opportunities to expand your responsibilities, influence how we work, and help shape our long-term direction.

Transparent and open cultureWe share decisions openly, keep communication channels clear, and encourage collaboration across every part of the business.

Supportive, high-calibre teamWork alongside talented professionals who are experts in their fields — smart, driven, and generous with their knowledge.

Remote first and flexible
Work in the way that best suits you. We focus on results, not rigid hours, and trust you to manage your time effectively.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Introductory call with our Talent team

  2. Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve

  3. Competency interview focused on your experience in operational risk and controls (may include a short task or case study)

  4. Senior leadership interview to explore alignment with our culture, values, and strategic direction

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

12

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

jobs.description:
Olá!

Estamos à procura do futuro Professor(a) de Psicologia (Acesso ao Ensino Superior/Maiores 23) que queira juntar-se a uma equipa que sonha em mudar a forma como as pessoas aprendem.

O setor educativo não consegue evoluir nem aproveitar o poder da tecnologia para maximizar as oportunidades de cada estudante de tirar todo o seu potencial, e é daí que nasce a ideia da Ucademy.

Junta-se a nós?

O nosso objetivo é tornar o caminho dos nossos alunos mais simples, curto e agradável para alcançarem os objetivos que estabeleceram. É simples assim.

Para isso, oferecemos um método de estudo flexível e 100% personalizado através de uma plataforma que aprende com os acertos e erros do aluno para recomendar o caminho a seguir no dia a dia.

Somos 2 engenheiros apaixonados por tecnologia e educação, com vários projetos de empreendedorismo. Há pouco mais de 2 anos, decidimos dar o passo em frente (mais uma vez) e oferecer uma forma diferente de aprender.

Nos nossos primeiros anos:

  • Desenvolvemos uma plataforma totalmente personalizada para que os alunos atinjam os seus objetivos. Este é, claro, o nosso principal objetivo e queremos que você também faça parte dele.

  • Somos uma empresa Great Place to Work (entre as 100 melhores empresas para trabalhar em Espanha em 2023).

  • Ganhámos o prémio de excelência educativa como a melhor academia online de Espanha!

  • Crescemos de 4 para 62 pessoas!

Mas somos muito ambiciosos e não gostamos de nos conformar, por isso, este ano, o desafio é implementar a estratégia de expansão, abrindo escritórios na América Latina e em Portugal, e formar uma comunidade de mais de 12.000 alunos e 1.000 professores.

O que procuramos num Professor(a) de Psicologia?

Procuramos alguém com grande vontade de ensinar e de se juntar ao desafio de fazer parte de uma equipa que gosta de assumir riscos, adaptar-se a mudanças e é amante da inovação.

Em poucas palavras, será responsável por ensinar e motivar os nossos alunos no seu novo desafio: a Universidade! Se gosta de explicar, sente-se à vontade com tecnologias e é apaixonado por educação, este é o seu lugar!

A motivação e o compromisso são o nosso motor, por isso procuramos alguém que partilhe essa paixão e entusiasmo pelo que faz. É um deles?

Quais serão as suas responsabilidades?

  1. Criar conteúdo atualizado e de qualidade em formato digital, tanto escrito como gravado, sobre os tópicos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior. Não perdemos o foco no detalhe, por isso consideramos fundamental todas as melhorias que possam ser feitas.

  2. Revisar e atualizar os conteúdos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior existentes na nossa plataforma. Ser eficiente está no nosso sangue e queremos que você também faça parte disso.

  3. Dar aulas online em direto aos alunos. Tudo o que considerar que pode funcionar para que os alunos sejam mais produtivos e gostem de estudar, será da sua responsabilidade.

  4. Dar apoio aos nossos alunos Ucademy nas suas dúvidas e consultas relacionadas com os conteúdos de Acesso ao Ensino Superior fornecidos na plataforma, bem como correção de tarefas.

Deve ter excelentes habilidades de comunicação dinâmica, juntamente com a capacidade de priorizar tarefas e cumprir prazos estabelecidos. Será uma peça-chave no processo de seleção.

O que esperamos de si?

  1. Experiência prévia como Professor(a) de Psicologia de Acesso ao Ensino Superior/Maiores 23.

  2. Estar habituado(a) a trabalhar com plataformas tecnológicas e bases de dados.

  3. Experiência a gerar conteúdo digital escrito e, idealmente, conteúdo videográfico.

  4. Como diríamos aqui, "a atitude não é negociável": ter proatividade é indispensável.

  5. Que a motivação e o bom ambiente façam parte do seu ADN, que venha para se divertir e se adapte às mudanças que temos no dia a dia.

  6. Valorizamos que tenha trabalhado previamente em empresas do setor de educação ou tecnologia. Assim, entenderá muito melhor todos os nossos processos!

O que oferecemos?

  1. Total liberdade para decidir, dar opinião e criar. Juntos organizamos o como, você decide o que.

  2. Trabalho 100% remoto!

  3. Contrato de prestação de serviços (freelance/recibos verdes).

  4. Remuneração económica muito competitiva – Explicamos tudo na primeira chamada!

  5. Um excelente ambiente de trabalho numa equipa apaixonada por formação e tecnologia!

Temos tantas coisas para lhe contar que não sabemos como resumir. O melhor é candidatar-se e nós contamos-lhe!

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Primary Mission:

The Assistant Lane Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) is an integral member of the West Virginia National Guard (WVNG) Ridge Runner Irregular Warfare Exercise (IWX) Program, responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of complex Special Operations Forces (SOF) training exercises. The position assists the Lane Support SME in coordinating logistics, manpower, resources, exercise infrastructure, and administrative requirements across assigned areas of operation.

The Assistant Lane Support SME must demonstrate strong organizational, logistical, asset deconfliction, and project management capabilities while supporting multiple exercises in various stages of development and execution. The position requires effective coordination with military personnel, Government agencies, civilian authorities, and domestic and international exercise participants in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Provide operational, logistical, and administrative support to the WVNG Joint Staff Office, WVNG J37, WVNG J3 Joint Operations Center, and Ridge Runner Program in support of exercise planning, coordination, and execution.
  • Assist the Lane Support SME with planning, development, coordination, and execution of Ridge Runner training activities, including Concept Development Conferences (CDC), Initial Planning Conferences (IPC), Mid Planning Conferences (MPC), Final Planning Conferences (FPC), and post-exercise closeout activities.
  • Coordinate with domestic and foreign exercise participants, military organizations, Government agencies, and external stakeholders to synchronize exercise requirements, resources, schedules, and operational support.
  • Support exercise lane development, site preparation, setup, execution, and recovery, including coordination with local business owners, municipal officials, and private landowners for access to facilities, infrastructure, and training locations through the Realistic Military Training (RMT) Packet process.
  • Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, emergency management organizations, and emergency medical services to support exercise integration, public safety, and operational requirements.
  • Prepare and coordinate exercise notifications and required Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) or Letters of Understanding (LOUs) with applicable jurisdictions, organizations, and property owners.
  • Assist the Lane Support SME with exercise lane management, safety coordination, logistical support, personnel accountability, and resolution of operational or administrative issues during exercise execution.
  • Support the coordination and delivery of Irregular Warfare training activities, instructional preparation, and exercise-related briefings in accordance with established Ridge Runner training objectives and program requirements.
  • Perform administrative functions including event scheduling, calendar management, email and telephone correspondence, meeting coordination, note-taking, records maintenance, document organization, and tracking of assigned actions.
  • Assist with coordination of foreign participant requirements, including foreign visit requests, installation access procedures, and communication with appropriate Government representatives when required.
  • Maintain effective communication with Ridge Runner leadership, the Lane Support SME, exercise controllers, and participating organizations to identify emerging requirements, resolve coordination issues, and ensure continuity of exercise support.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Required Qualifications and Education

  • Special Operations Experience: Minimum five (5) years of operational experience as an operator within a U.S. Special Operations organization, including USASOC, MARSOC, or NSWDG, with at least three (3) years of administrative or operational support to senior leaders in high-tempo or mission-driven environments.
  • Operational or Executive Support Experience: At least three (3) years providing administrative or operational support to senior leaders in military, law enforcement, executive, or other mission-driven environments will be considered.
  • Organizational and Logistical Management: Demonstrated ability to manage calendars, coordinate travel, track personnel and resources, deconflict logistical requirements, and support complex schedules with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Discretion and Security Awareness: Experience handling sensitive or confidential information with a strong understanding of operational security (OPSEC), information protection, and applicable security procedures.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across diverse teams, cultures, and organizational levels, including military leadership, Government agencies, civilian stakeholders, and international participants.
  • Problem-Solving and Adaptability: Proven ability to anticipate requirements, resolve issues proactively, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing operational conditions in high-pressure environments.
  • Education: High school graduate.

Preferred Qualifications and Education

  • Graduate of the U.S. Army Special Forces Qualification Course or a comparable advanced Special Operations qualification course from another U.S. SOF component, including SEAL Qualification Training or the MARSOC Individual Training Course.
  • Five (5) years of documented experience as a primary instructor or course manager at a U.S. Special Operations schoolhouse.
  • Experience supporting joint, interagency, or multinational military training exercises, including exercise planning, logistics coordination, and operational execution.
  • Familiarity with Irregular Warfare training environments, Realistic Military Training (RMT) coordination procedures, and military exercise planning processes.

Work Authorization / Security Clearance requirements

  • Must possess a Secret security clearance or be eligible to obtain and maintain one in accordance with Government and contractual requirements.
  • Must comply with applicable installation access requirements, operational security procedures, and information protection standards.
  • Must be available to participate in pre-exercise planning conferences, coordination meetings, exercise execution, and post-exercise activities as required.
  • Must be capable of performing duties in office and field environments, including varying weather conditions and terrain.

Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Must maintain the physical readiness necessary to perform assigned duties in a Special Operations training environment, including field movement, exercise setup, and operational support under varying environmental conditions.
  • Environment: Office and field environment
  • Equipment Used: standard office equipment, computer
  • Sitting: 30%
  • Standing: 40%
  • Walking: 30%
  • Lifting: Up to 35lbs. 40% of Time

Additional Notes

  • Must exercise sound judgment, professionalism, integrity, and discretion when coordinating with military personnel, Government representatives, civilian authorities, and exercise participants.
  • Must be capable of managing multiple competing requirements while maintaining accountability, responsiveness, and continuity of support throughout the exercise planning and execution cycle.

jobs.description:
Twin Rivers Paper Company, headquartered in Madawaska, Maine, is an integrated specialty paper manufacturer producing 400,000 tons of paper per year for the packaging, publishing, label, and technical sectors. With 100 years of papermaking history, the company operates a pulp mill in New Brunswick, and diverse paper assets in northern Maine and upstate New York that produce uncoated and coated white papers in a broad range of basis weights and finishes.

Customized product development and dedicated technical services support are company hallmarks. With a sound financial structure and a strong balance sheet that fuels continuous investments in its assets, Twin Rivers Paper offers its customers the security of local product availability through a strong, domestically-owned manufacturer and the assurance of long-term viability.

Scope:

Reporting to the Director of Field Technical Services, the Field Technical Service Representative will be a critical member of the commercial team by ensuring that all customers receive technical support on Twin products.

This role is remote, but ability to travel 50-75% of time is required

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure customer satisfaction through building meaningful relationships with customers and mill personnel. This position is the conduit between sales, manufacturing, and our customers.
  • Represent all of Twin Rivers' paper markets (publishing, label, packaging, and technical).
  • Collect, analyze, and define field problems as well as help drive the internal and external resolution.
  • Understand the paper making and finishing processes that enable effective description of issues to help solve customer concerns.
  • Participate in new product and improvement trials at the end users in an effort to provide meaningful and timely feedback to the mills.
  • Periodically visit warehouses and contracted converters to be sure they are representing Twin Rivers and our products in a professional manner.
  • Generate reports to communicate and build a database of customer feedback and knowledge.
  • Provide technical support to the paper mills ensuring that all applicable quality standards are adhered to.
  • Awareness of GMP’s, HACCP Principles and Food Safety Standard.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field or equivalent in experience.
  • 10+ years’ experience in paper manufacturing and/or converting with a strong understanding of paper making.
  • Ability to travel frequently (50% - 75%) to customers and mills. This could include air travel, driving and multiple nights on the road each week as well as international travel.
  • Work within safety parameters in all our mills as well as any converters and customer facilities.
  • Proficient computer skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) plus analytical software (such as MiniTab, P1 Process Book, Proficy)
  • Ability to learn Manufacturing Execution Software (such as ELIXIR/OptiVision)
  • Self-starter with good organizational and planning skills.
  • Good written presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively throughout the Twin Rivers organization, customers, and suppliers.
  • Must possess strong attention to detail and have good problem-solving abilities.

Twin Rivers is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: The Security Engineer is responsible for testing, deploying, documenting, and improving internal security controls for safety, soundness, and operational efficiency.
jobs.description:
The Security Engineer is responsible for testing, deploying, documenting, and improving internal security controls for safety, soundness, and operational efficiency. This role includes project work, including meetings, design, and project tasks. This position requires collaboration with different stakeholders to ensure board approved risk appetite is maintained and deliverables are met. This position includes on-call responsibilities on a rotating basis.

Work Arrangement:This position is able to work onsite, hybrid, or remote (must reside within the State of Michigan).

To be considered for this role, candidate must currently reside, or have plans to reside upon hire, within the state of Michigan as described above. Occasional travel on a quarterly basis to MSUFCU Headquarters (East Lansing, MI) may be needed.

Schedule- Monday - Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm ET.

An offer of employment with MSU Federal Credit Union and affiliates is contingent upon the agreed work arrangement (onsite/hybrid/remote) and work location. MSU Federal Credit Union may or may not be able to accommodate temporary or permanent changes to work arrangements or allow employment outside the city and/or state of residency in which the new hire resides at the time of offered employment.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Salary Range: Principal Security Engineer - $120,000 - $150,000+ annually, depending on experience
  • 100% Company-Paid Health, Dental, Vision, Life, and Long-Term Disability Premiums
  • Up to 26 days of PTO within your first year, as well as Volunteer Time Off & 11 Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) with a company match
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Up to 12 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave
  • Learn more about our benefitshere

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate on critical IT projects to ensure that security issues are addressed throughout the project life cycle. Participate in project meetings, consult on security related topics, and execute on security related tasks resulting from those projects.
  • Manage security configurations and operation standards for security systems and applications.
  • Manage advanced security technologies, including but not limited to: SIEM/SOAR, Firewalls, IPS, Endpoint Protection, DLP, and email security technologies.
  • Assist in the collection of system information and procedures required by internal and external audits and examinations.
  • Assist Security Operations team with security incident response, including determination of root cause, as needed.
  • Understand the Credit Union's policies and procedures to ensure compliance and accountability for managing operational risks. Adhere to established internal controls and procedures to safeguard assets, prevent fraud, and maintain the integrity of credit union operations.
  • Participate in threat assessments, documenting risk and compensating controls.
  • Test, implement, and document new security controls in partnership with stakeholders.
  • Lead complex security projects and initiatives independently.
  • Assist members of the Security Engineering team with complex problems. Participate in knowledge transfer to junior Security Engineers.
  • Create and maintain Security Engineering standard-type procedures and documentation.
  • Assist with strategic direction of the Information Security Program.
  • Align with Security Operations and Security Architecture regarding security program objectives.
  • Assist in the development of education and training materials for consumption by different business units and stakeholders.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, or similar -OR- 5+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, Information Security, or similar in lieu of a degree
  • Previous experience leading a security engineering team from an individual contributor or peer leadership perspective.
  • Advanced security certifications required (i.e. GIAC, CISSP, or equivalent)
  • CompTIA Sec+ is required.

Competencies:

  • Core Competencies that must be demonstrated by all Credit Union employees include Communicate, Navigate Change & Evolve, Solve Problems & Make Decisions, Plan, Prioritize, and Achieve, and Collaborate.
  • Functional Competencies:
    • Adaptability - Adapts quickly to change and considers new approaches
    • AI & Digital Proficiency - Leverages artificial intelligence and digital tools to enhance decision-making, identify trends, and manage emerging risks. Applies AI-driven insights to support due diligence, validate outcomes, and refine prompt engineering techniques. Continuously adapts to advancements in AI to improve efficiency and effectiveness within the role.
    • Analytical Thinking - Breaks down complex information into smaller parts.
    • Critical Thinking - Takes outside knowledge into account while evaluating information.
    • Initiative - Takes proactive and prompt action to accomplish work goals. Takes action to achieve results beyond requirements.
    • Research - Investigates and studies sources to understand situations before reaching conclusions or acting.
    • Resilience - Thrives and grows in a rapidly changing and complex environment. Displays flexibility, utilizes networks, and adopts a continuous growth mindset to learn from mistakes and bounce back from adversity.
    • Teamwork - Works well with internal and cross-functional teams to achieve individual, team, department, and/or organizational goals. Values diverse perspectives and working with others to achieve the best outcome possible.
    • Time Management - Manages time and resources to ensure work is completed efficiently.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • May be required to remain in a stationary position for an extended period.
  • Ability to operate standard office technology, equipment, and tools, which may include many hours of computer and phone usage.
  • Occasionally needs to move about inside of an office area.
  • Exposure to potentially hazardous condition, i.e. robbery. Receives detailed instructions and procedures to be followed to minimize the exposure.
  • This position can work in remote, hybrid, or onsite working arrangements.

Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. This document does not represent a contract of employment, and MSU Federal Credit Union reserves the right to change this position description and/or assign tasks for the employee to perform, as MSUFCU may deem appropriate.
  • MSUFCU is an affirmative-action, equal-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Case Manager I (MSW/RN) Medicare/DSNP
jobs.excerpt: This position is remote.  We are targeting an individual who lives in the Seattle area and is knowledgeable of the area and its available resources.
jobs.description:
This position is remote. We are targeting an individual who lives in the Seattle area and is knowledgeable of the area and its available resources. This is essential in being able to assist our Medicare and Dual Plan members by providing education coordination with care teams and connecting to community-based resources.

**Priority will be given to Washington State Residents**

Who we are

Community Health Plan of Washington is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any actual or perceived protected characteristic or other unlawful consideration.

Our commitment is to:

  • Strive to apply an equity lens to all our work.
  • Reduce health disparities.
  • Create an equitable work environment.

About the Role

Responsible for the operational delivery of the plan’s case management and coordination programs and processes. Provides case management services for CHPW members with short term, long term, stable, unstable, and predictable course of illness, and/or highly complex medical/behavioral and social conditions. The goal is to improve members' quality of life and ensure cost-effective outcomes by using internal and community-based resources.

To be successful in this role, you:

  • Have a Bachelor’s degree in nursing, or a master’s degree in social work and/or related behavior health field (preferred)
  • Possess Current, unrestricted license in the State of Washington as a registered nurse (RN) (required) OR
  • Current, unrestricted license in the State of Washington as a Social Worker (LSWAA, LSWAIC) (required), OR
  • Current, unrestricted license in the State of Washington as a Mental Health Counselor (LMHC), Mental Health Professional (LMHP), or Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) (required)
  • Have a minimum of one (1) year case management, home health or discharge planning experience; or a combination of education and experience which provides an equivalent background required OR
  • Have a minimum of one (1) year facility-based medical or behavioral health experience and/or outpatient psychiatric and substance abuse/substance abuse disorder treatment experience, required; or equivalent combination of education and experience and/or working with children and families. Experience with those who have disabilities and knowledge of Child and Families Services
  • Have a minimum three (3) years of clinical experience in an acute care and/or outpatient setting (required)
  • Experience and proficiency with Microsoft Office products
  • Possess a Case Management Certification (preferred)
  • Have Bilingual abilities (preferred)

Essential functions and Roles and Responsibilities:

The Case Manager I is responsible for performing telephonic case management for members with acute, chronic, and complex needs. Examples listed below are not necessarily exhaustive and may be revised by the employer.

  • Advocates on behalf of members and facilitates coordination of resources required to help members reach optimum functional levels and autonomy within the constraints of their disease conditions.
  • Works within a multi-functional team to connect with providers, members, caregivers, contracted vendors, community resources, and health plan partners to assess the member's health status, identify care needs and ensure access to appropriate services to achieve positive health outcomes.
  • Assesses, evaluates, plans, implements, and documents care of members within the organization’s clinical database system, in accordance with organizational policies and procedures.
  • Responsible for the assessment of members, including identifying and coordinating access to the appropriate level of care and treatment. Uses the assessment information to assign the appropriate risk and complexity level, and create and document a care plan in coordination with the member, family and health team input.
  • Initiates a plan of care based on member-specific needs, assessment data and the medical/behavioral plan of care. Goals for members are measurable and developed in conjunction with the patient/family to improve quality of life.
  • Plans care in collaboration with members of the multidisciplinary team, and considers the physical, behavioral, cultural, psychosocial, spiritual, age specific and educational needs of the member in the plan of care.
  • Reviews and revises the plan of care with the interdisciplinary care team to reflect changing member needs based on evaluation of the members’ status, and/or as a result of reassessment.
  • Implements the plan of care through direct member care, coordination, and delegation of the activities of the health care team. Promotes continuity of care by accurately and completely communicating to health care team the status of members for whom care is provided. Engages community resources where applicable.
  • Conducts interdisciplinary care team meetings with the member/family to assess care plan and recommend adjustments as indicated.
  • Continuously evaluate members’ progress towards goals, identify potential barriers to attaining goals and expected outcomes in collaboration with other health care team members.
  • Documents all case activity using the CHPW care management system and follows documentation standards and protocols.
  • Collaborates with the Transition of Care (TOC) team if a member is hospitalized.
  • Serves as a liaison at various local and statewide meetings and/or workgroups and provides clinical support to providers’ network to enhance integrated care coordination.
  • Assesses barriers to care and assist members and health care team to address concerns.
  • Implements developed workflow activities and activities for designated programs.
  • Conduct member case management in the field at Provider(s) office, member’s home, inpatient medical or psychiatric hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, adult family homes, or in a community setting.
  • Attend member appointments or care conferences in collaboration with the members care team when indicated.
  • This position may requires traveling on behalf of the Company and working in the field. It is essential that a current driver’s license, proof of insurance and an acceptable driving record are maintained.
  • Employees are expected to report to work as scheduled, participate in all assigned meetings, and meet established performance and accountability standards.
  • Other duties as assigned. Essential functions listed are not necessarily exhaustive and may be revised by the employer, at its sole discretion.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Managed care (Medicaid and/or Medicare) experience
  • Previous experience using Care Management software applications
  • Knowledge of, and experience with, community resources preferred
  • Knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid regulations
  • Experience in care management workflow systems
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Effective organizational, time management, and project management skills
  • Ability to work independently
  • Comfortable presenting in a group setting
  • Perform all functions of the job with accuracy, attention to detail and within established timeframes.
  • Meet attendance and punctuality standards

Note: If you think you do not qualify, please reconsider. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they feel they meet every qualification. However, everyone brings different strengths to the table for a job, and people can be successful in a role in a variety of ways. If you are excited about this job but your experience doesn’t perfectly check every box in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

As part of our hiring process, the following criteria must be met:

  • Complete and successfully pass a criminal background check

Criminal History: includes review of criminal convictions and probation. CHPW does not automatically or categorically exclude persons with a criminal background from employment. The applicant’s criminal history will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis considering the risk to the business, members, and/employees.

  • Has not been sanctioned or excluded from participation in federal or state healthcare programs by a federal or state law enforcement, regulatory, or licensing agency
  • Candidates whose disabilities make them unable to meet these requirements are considered fully qualified if they can perform the essential functions of the job with reasonable accommodation.

Compensation and Benefits:

The position is FLSA Exempt and is not eligible for overtime and has a 10% annual incentive target based on company, department, and individual performance goals. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

CHPW offers the following benefits for Full and Part-time employees and their dependents:

  • Medical, Prescription, Dental, and Vision
  • Telehealth app
  • Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts
  • Basic Life AD&D, Short and Long-Term Disability
  • Voluntary Life, Critical Care, and Long-Term Care Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement and generous employer match
  • Employee Assistance Program and Mental Fitness app
  • Financial Coaching, Identity Theft Protection
  • Time off including PTO accrual starting at 17 days per year
  • 40 hours Community Service volunteer time
  • 10 standard holidays, 2 floating holidays
  • Compassion time off, jury duty

Sensory/Physical/Mental Requirements:

Sensory*:

  • Speaking, hearing, near vision, far vision, depth perception, peripheral vision, touch, smell, and balance.

Physical*:

  • Extended periods of sitting, computer use, talking, and possibly standing
  • Simple grasp, firm grasp, fine manipulation, pinch, finger dexterity, supination/pronation, wrist flexion

Mental:

  • Must have the ability to learn and prioritize multiple tasks within the scope and guidelines of the position and its applicable licensure requirements, many requiring extremely complex cognitive capabilities. Must be able to manage conflict, communicate effectively and meet time-sensitive deadlines.

Work Environment:

Office environment Employees who frequently work in front of computer monitors are at risk for environmental exposure to low-grade radiation.

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
