About the Position

We are seeking a board-certified Endocrinologist to join our virtual care team on a flexible, PRN basis. This opportunity is ideal for an endocrinologist who values flexibility and wants to provide high-quality specialty care to adult patients through a convenient telehealth model.

Our practice combines virtual care with innovative AI-supported technology designed to help physicians streamline clinical workflows, reduce administrative burden, and focus more of their time and attention on patient care. AI tools are used to support—not replace—physician judgment and clinical decision-making.

The physician will evaluate, diagnose, and manage a broad range of endocrine and metabolic conditions while providing patient-centered care through virtual visits.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive virtual consultations and follow-up visits for adult patients.
  • Evaluate, diagnose, and manage common endocrine disorders.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on each patient's clinical needs, history, laboratory results, and other relevant data.
  • Manage conditions such as diabetes, thyroid disorders, osteoporosis, adrenal and pituitary disorders, and other general endocrinology conditions.
  • Order and interpret appropriate laboratory and diagnostic testing.
  • Prescribe medications and adjust treatment plans as clinically appropriate.
  • Educate patients regarding their conditions, treatment options, medications, and lifestyle modifications.
  • Coordinate care with primary care providers and other members of the patient's healthcare team when appropriate.
  • Utilize AI-enabled clinical and administrative tools to support documentation, information review, workflow efficiency, and patient care.
  • Exercise independent clinical judgment and maintain responsibility for all diagnoses, treatment decisions, and patient care.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant electronic medical records.
  • Deliver high-quality, evidence-based care consistent with applicable clinical standards and telehealth requirements.

Qualifications

  • MD or DO degree from an accredited medical school.
  • Completion of an accredited Endocrinology fellowship.
  • Board certified in Endocrinology.
  • Active, unrestricted medical license(s) in the state(s) where patients are located
    • MN, WI, NY, NJ, MA, CT preferred
    • IMLC preferred
  • DEA registration.
  • Strong clinical judgment and communication skills.
  • Comfortable providing care through telehealth technology.
  • Comfortable working with technology and AI-supported clinical tools.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a virtual care team.
  • Commitment to compassionate, patient-centered care.

Why Join Us?

  • Full time (36 clinical hours) and part time (>20 clinical hours) available
  • 100% virtual practice with no requirement for an onsite clinic schedule.
  • AI-supported workflows designed to reduce administrative burden and help physicians work more efficiently.
  • Opportunity to provide specialty care to adult patients from the convenience of your own workspace.
  • Supportive, technology-enabled virtual clinical environment.
  • Meaningful opportunity to expand access to endocrinology care.
  • The ability to focus on what matters most: providing excellent patient care.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure
  • Malpractice insurance coverage
  • Work from anywhere in the US
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance options
  • CME Allowance $2000 Annually

Our Approach to AI

We believe technology should augment physicians, not replace them. Our AI-enabled tools are designed to assist with appropriate clinical and administrative workflows, allowing physicians to spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time engaging with patients and making clinical decisions. Physicians retain full responsibility for clinical judgment and patient care.

Compensation:
$330,000—$330,000 USD

Who We Are:

Behind every leading health system is K Health’s AI-powered virtual care engine.

Esteemed health systems like Mayo Clinic, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Hackensack Meridian Health, and Hartford Healthcare partner with K Health to build and run modern primary virtual care clinics on their behalf.

Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. And for the health systems, we deploy our top-grade Virtualists in AI-powered virtual clinics 24/7 to capture the patients' care journeys at step one, retain the journey through the system for longitudinal care, and strengthen profitability.

We’re founded in 2016, headquartered in New York City, and backed by nearly $400 million from leading investors including Valor Equity Partners, Claure Group, Mangrove Capital Partners, 14W, Notable Capital, Lerer Hippeau, Primary Venture Partners, Comcast Ventures, PICO Venture Partners, Max Ventures, and other strategic healthcare partners.

We offer competitive compensation packages based on industry benchmarks for function, level, and geographic location. Offer amounts are determined by multiple factors such as a candidate's experience and expertise.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, citizenship, military or veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. We’re deeply committed to building teams as diverse as the patients we serve and strive to cultivate an environment where everyone can bring their most authentic self to work. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our users.

jobs.title: Java Engineer – Application / Database Modernization
jobs.excerpt: Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm.
jobs.description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.

Enterprises stuck on Oracle carry license renewals, vendor-specific SQL nobody wants to touch, and application layers welded to the database underneath them. This role sits in our Application & Database Modernization pillar: you'll work an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration where Aedeon handles the mechanical conversion at scale and you own what the tools can't the refactoring judgment inside large enterprise Java codebases. You'll rewrite the SQL the application actually depends on, align it with the modernized schema, prove functional parity, and see the application through production cutover. Not a proof of concept. A system that ships.

What you will do?

  • Analyze and remediate large enterprise Java codebases — replace legacy and database-specific SQL constructs with modern, standards-compliant SQL.
  • Convert embedded SQL in Java services and MyBatis XML mappers: rewrite vendor-specific functions, sequences, pagination logic, dynamic SQL, and error-handling patterns.
  • Work closely with schema and database migration engineers so application-layer SQL lands aligned with the modernized target schema.
  • Refactor Java transaction logic, error handling, drivers, and ORM/DAO layers to match the behavior of modern databases.
  • Run unit, integration, and performance testing to confirm functional parity and hit performance SLAs post-modernization.
  • Support production cutover — validation, monitoring setup, rollback planning, and stabilization until the system holds.
  • Produce engineering documentation that outlives the engagement: SQL remediation guides, code-migration runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-transfer material for customer teams.
  • Work across distributed teams (US and India) and with customer SMEs to keep business logic aligned and the modernization on track.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional Java development experience (Spring, JDBC, MyBatis/Hibernate or equivalent).
  • Experience with application modernization, database migrations, or large-scale refactoring initiatives.
  • Strong SQL expertise you can analyze, interpret, optimize, and rewrite complex SQL embedded in Java applications.
  • Deep understanding of JDBC, ORMs, Java transaction patterns, and database-driven application flows.
  • Experience on enterprise-grade, high-performance applications with complex data interactions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with global distributed teams in US time zones.

You will be preferred if

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Aurora PostgreSQL, or modernization from legacy databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2.
  • Exposure to automated code-refactoring tools or GenAI-assisted remediation workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD environments, performance testing tools, and observability stacks.
  • Consulting or professional services experience delivering fixed-timeline modernization projects.

How we work?

    Agents do the repetitive 60–70% of the work a traditional consulting engagement of equivalent scope staffs humans for. Engineers do the rest, and the rest is the interesting part. You won't spend months grinding through mechanical SQL conversion; Aedeon and its regression harness cover that. Your hours go to refactoring judgment, risk tradeoffs, production cutover, and post-cutover optimization. We commit to delivery dates and absorb the overage cost for delays inside our control, which means the engineering has to be right the first time. That's the job.

Life at Mactores

We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.
1. Be one step ahead
2. Deliver the best
3. Be bold
4. Pay attention to the detail
5. Enjoy the challenge
6. Be curious and take action
7. Take leadership
8. Own it
9. Deliver value
10. Be collaborative
We would like you to read more details about the work culture on

The Path to Joining the Mactores Team

At Mactores, our recruitment process is structured around three distinct stages:

Pre-Employment Assessment:

A series of evaluations of your technical proficiency and suitability for the role.
Managerial Interview: The hiring manager engages with you in multiple discussions, 30 minutes to an hour each, covering technical skills, hands-on experience, leadership potential, and communication.
HR Discussion: During this 30-minute session, you'll have the opportunity to discuss the offer and next steps with a member of the HR team.

jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on ourYouTube Channel orBlog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

jobs.description:
Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.

Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source. Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.

With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.

With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.

We are hiring a Sr Technical Marketing Manager - Alliances & Competitive Strategy to own two of the highest-leverage narratives at Obsidian: why we are better together with our strategic partners, and why our architecture solves problems no one else can.

This role sits at the intersection of alliances marketing and technical product marketing, and it owns competitive intelligence for the company. You will define how Obsidian shows up alongside our strategic technology alliances, building the joint value propositions, launch narratives, and enablement that turn partnerships into pipeline and supporting the GTM models that bring those alliances to market. At the same time, you will go deep with Product and Engineering to understand how the platform works, from our knowledge graph to our data depth and detection architecture, and elevate that "how" into a durable "why": why Obsidian is uniquely positioned to secure third-party applications and AI agents where alternative architectures structurally fall short.

You will be the positioning authority the field, our partners, and our executives turn to for evidence-based answers on how we win, both in architecture and in direct competition.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can think strategically, move quickly, and help shape how we scale both partner marketing and competitive positioning at Obsidian.

What you’ll accomplish

Own the Alliance Narrative

  • Develop joint positioning, messaging, and better-together value propositions for strategic technology alliances
  • Build messaging that helps customers understand when and why to adopt Obsidian alongside partner platforms, and helps alliance partners position Obsidian with clarity and conviction
  • Lead product marketing for joint launches, co-marketing campaigns, and major alliance field moments, coordinating across alliances, product, and marketing teams
  • Support the GTM models behind each alliance, including marketplace, co-sell, and integration motions, with the positioning, content, and enablement they need to perform
  • Create enablement that alliance sellers actually use: solution briefs, pitch decks, objection-handling guides, and co-branded campaign materials
  • Drive co-marketing programs with strategic alliances that deliver measurable pipeline contribution and deal acceleration

Own Competitive Intelligence & Technical Positioning

  • Own the competitive intelligence function: monitor competitor products, architectures, disclosures, and market signals, and distill them into succinct, actionable guidance for sales, product, and leadership
  • Build and maintain the compete program, including battlecards, compete decks, objection handling, and win/loss insights, that gives the field and partners clear evidence for why Obsidian wins
  • Elevate "how we do things" into "why it matters": articulate why Obsidian's architecture solves problems that point tools and adjacent platforms cannot
  • Develop technical marketing content such as architecture narratives, technical briefs, blogs, webinars, and demos that proves differentiation rather than asserting it
  • Bring competitive and market insights back into product, alliances, and executive planning to sharpen roadmap framing and GTM strategy

About You

  • Technical to the core, fluent in the "why." 8+ years in product, technical, or partner marketing in cybersecurity or enterprise software, ideally with a hands-on technical background.
  • A competitive strategist. You have built compete programs and turn competitor analysis and win/loss data into positioning the field trusts. You know the difference between a feature comparison and a structural advantage.
  • Experienced in technology alliance marketing. You have built better-together narratives, joint launches, and enablement with strategic technology partners, and understand marketplace, co-sell, and integration GTM motions.
  • Fluent in the cybersecurity buyer. You know how security leaders evaluate and buy, and how to help alliance partners have that conversation on Obsidian's behalf.
  • Strategic, hands-on, and collaborative. You see the big picture but are comfortable writing, building, and shipping the work yourself, and you align alliances, sales, product, and engineering without owning all the decisions.

We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

The Customer Engineer plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between technical expertise and sales acumen. This position requires a blend of technical knowledge and interpersonal skills to effectively communicate the value of complex technical solutions to potential clients. The Sales Engineer collaborates closely with the sales team to understand customer needs, provide technical demonstrations, and offer tailored solutions that address client requirements. This role is instrumental in driving revenue growth by effectively positioning the company's products or services within the marketplace.

Location. This role is remote in the continental United States.

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Bring a high-ownership, self-starting mindset with a willingness to fill gaps, solve problems, and support the team. Thrive in ambiguity, step up without waiting for direction, and contribute beyond your role to drive shared success.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to customers and sales peers regarding Armada’s products and services. Understand client challenges and propose the appropriate solutions to meet their needs.
  • Lead technical demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and workshops to showcase features, functionalities, and benefits of the company’s offerings. Tailor demonstrations and execute workshops to address specific client challenges.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to support sales, including customer engagements, technical scoping, and proposal development. Influence and align internal teams to drive solution strategy, resource prioritization, and successful business outcomes.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with key client stakeholders, including technical decision makers and influencers. Serve as a trusted advisor through thought leadership, understanding their challenges, and providing tailored solutions based on technical business needs.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, competitive developments, and emerging technologies. Leverage market awareness to identify opportunities for product innovation and differentiation.
  • Enhance field team understanding of technical concepts, product features, and selling strategies. Provide ongoing support and enablement resources to empower sales representatives in their client interactions.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a Secret or higher security clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years proven experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or solution architecture role supporting technical products.
  • Conceptual understanding of networking and connectivity fundamentals, including IP addressing, firewalls, SD-WAN, and satellite or cellular-based communication systems (e.g., Starlink, LTE/5G).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, virtualization or containerization technologies, and modern enterprise infrastructure.
  • Proficiency in at least one core technical domain such as AI/ML infrastructure, connected devices, or data center systems (see Technical Focus Areas below).
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms, modern networking concepts, and containerization or virtualization technologies.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity.
  • Self-starter who thrives in dynamic environments and effectively manages multiple priorities.
  • Must be willing and able to travel, including potential international travel, as business needs dictate.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience with MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, Command of the Message etc.; and managing to a sales process.
  • Demonstrable expertise in one or more Technical Focus Areas:
    • AI & Edge AI Solution Architecture - This specialty emphasizes expertise in scoping, qualifying, and shaping AI-powered solutions. AI development fundamentals—such as training data quality, data granularity, resolution, variability, and event detection use cases—and how these factors impact model confidence, false positives, and deployment feasibility. Defining inputs (e.g., cameras, sensors) and estimating compute requirements. Familiarity with AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX) and the broader AI/ML lifecycle is essential, along with a strong grasp of practical AI applications.
    • Modular Data Center Systems & Rack Solutions Architecture – This specialty requires strong systems integration skills and the ability to translate customer requirements into reliable, scalable infrastructure solutions. jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's AI has helped prevent accidents that would have harmed an estimated 380,000 people per year. Every model we ship runs in the real world, on real roads, protecting real drivers.

This is the most senior individual contributor role on our Safety AI team. The role is focused on taking models from research to production in safety-critical systems.

You'll sit at the intersection of cutting-edge computer vision research and production systems that run across millions of IoT devices globally. The models you build run on the edge, in real time, on the trucks and vans and heavy equipment that keep the world moving.

  • Scale: Millions of AI dash cams, 100B+ miles/year (~99% of U.S. roads), 25T+ data points
  • Problems: Driver behavior understanding, 3D scene reasoning, and long-tail event detection in real-world environments
  • Stack: Modern vision models (e.g. transformers), large-scale training pipelines, and optimization for edge inference on constrained devices

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • You will be the technical thought leader and you will lead the design and implementation of our most critical Safety AI initiatives including real-time perception systems that run across millions of edge devices in the physical world and the cloud. The scale and constraints make this an extremely unique applied ML problem. You will:
    • Architect end-to-end computer vision pipelines for real-world safety detection — object detection, tracking, semantic segmentation, multi-camera fusion, and beyond
    • Drive the technical roadmap for edge and cloud perception, including how we optimize and deploy models on constrained hardware without sacrificing accuracy
    • Partner closely with our hardware and firmware teams — we build our own devices, which means you'll have a rare ability to co-design the full stack
    • Work with petabyte-scale multimodal data (video, sensor, telematics, diagnostics) to train and iterate on production models
    • Stay at the frontier of CV and perception research and translate what matters into shipped product
    • Mentor and technically guide senior scientists and engineers across the team
    • Bring clarity to ambiguous problems — translating customer and business needs into precise, solvable engineering challenges.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Vision, or a related quantitative field.
  • 10+ years as a scientist or ML engineer, with experience leading end-to-end AI systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in computer vision (e.g., object detection, tracking, segmentation) for real-world environments.
  • Experience with multimodal perception and sensor fusion (e.g., camera, lidar, radar, GPS/IMU).
  • Experience with transformer-based architectures and vision-language models (VLMs/VLAs).
  • Experience building and deploying real-time or edge ML systems optimized for low-latency inference.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive systems from research through production deployment, including performance optimization and reliability at scale.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience applying perception to real-world systems such as driver assistance, fleet safety, or operations automation.
  • Publications or patents at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, NeurIPS).

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$200,200—$357,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.description:
VP, Product

Role Overview

Ad Results Media (ARM) is building the next-generation operating platform that powers how the agency plans, buys, measures, and reports across audio and emerging channels. Internally known as the ARM Suite, this platform unifies order management, finance connectivity, and — over time — planning, buying, communications, and measurement into a single environment used by ARM, our clients, and our network partners.

We are seeking a Vice President, Product to serve as the internal product owner of the ARM Suite. This role is responsible for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and governance. The VP, Product will partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Client Services to translate agency and client needs into a durable, scalable product.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. The VP, Product will set long-term product direction while operating in the day-to-day decisions that shape how ARM Suite is built, governed, and adopted.

Platform Ownership & Impact

ARM Suite is transitioning from a vendor-led build to an internally owned product. This role mitigates vendor dependency risk, restores institutional knowledge, and ensures the platform evolves in alignment with how ARM actually wins, retains, and grows business.

The VP, Product will be accountable for ARM Suite as a product — not as a collection of features, dashboards, or vendor deliverables. That means owning the charter, defining what the platform is (and is not), establishing a prioritization framework, and making the trade-offs required to ship a durable system rather than a set of bespoke responses to internal requests.

ARM Suite is, at its core, an API-driven platform. It depends on durable pipelines to media buying systems, measurement partners, finance, network partners, and client-side data sources to keep users in ARM’s environment rather than dependent on parallel tools. The VP, Product owns the API and integration strategy that makes this possible.

Key Responsibilities

Product Vision & Roadmap

  • Be accountable for the end-to-end product vision and multi-year roadmap for the ARM Suite, including order management, finance connectivity, planning, buying, communications, and measurement workflows.

  • Translate ARM’s commercial strategy, client needs, and partner relationships into a clear product narrative and sequenced roadmap.

  • Define what ARM Suite is, what it is not, and what “done” looks like at each phase, with explicit trade-offs documented for leadership.

  • Own ARM Suite’s API and integration strategy, including API pipelines into media platforms, measurement partners, finance and billing systems, network partners, and third-party enrichment sources that keep users inside ARM Suite.

Vendor Reduction & Internal Capability Building

  • Lead the structured reduction of third-party dependency by extracting institutional knowledge, documenting business rules, and transitioning ownership of roadmap and prioritization in-house.

  • Review and approve product designs, scope, and delivery plans proposed by vendors; ensure work aligns to ARM’s long-term roadmap

  • Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure clean separation between platform design (Product) and data correctness and pipeline ownership (Engineering / Analytics).

Governance, Prioritization & Intake

  • Establish and operate a product-governed intake and prioritization framework that replaces ad hoc requests with a defensible, transparent process — while preserving fast paths for revenue-critical work.

  • Define and enforce the authority split between Product (system design and prioritization) and Analytics (metric definitions, QA, and interpretation).

  • Document and socialize standards for product decisions, business rules, and platform constraints so they persist beyond individual contributors.

  • Partner with Analytics to operationalize a formal QA delegation model within ARM Suite intake and delivery workflows.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted partner to Analytics & Insights, Reporting, Data Science, Strategy, Planning, Operations, Finance, and Client Services.

  • Bridge the gap between platform capability and agency workflows, ensuring product decisions reflect how ARM teams actually plan, buy, and report.

  • Influence and align senior leaders on roadmap sequencing, trade-offs, and investment cases without relying on positional authority alone.

  • Build a product practice over time — starting solo, with a clear path to scale through hires and contributors as the platform matures.

Client & Partner Orientation

  • Ground product decisions in real client and network-partner needs through structured exposure to top-revenue accounts, partner conversations, and pitch motions.

  • Ensure ARM Suite produces standardized, credible artifacts for sales, planning, and renewal motions rather than bespoke, one-off deliverables.

  • Position ARM Suite as a durable differentiator that creates switching costs and supports long-term client retention and expansion.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including senior product leadership (Director, Sr. Director, or VP) at a SaaS, agency-tech, ad-tech, mar-tech, or analytics platform company.

  • Demonstrated experience owning a B2B platform or product line end-to-end — vision, roadmap, prioritization, governance, and stakeholder management.

  • Track record of leading internal product ownership through transitions away from third-party engineering vendors, contractors, or outsourced build partners.

  • Experience operating in environments that combine internal teams with external engineering partners, with a clear philosophy on what should be owned in-house vs. outsourced.

  • Deep, hands-on capability with API-driven product design — including standing up API pipelines, integrating third-party data sources for user-facing enrichment, and shipping products built on APIs from scratch.

Preferred Experience

  • Prior experience in media, advertising, agency, ad-tech, or mar-tech environments, with an understanding of planning, buying, measurement, and client reporting.

  • Familiarity with order management, finance/billing connectivity, and workflow tools that span multiple internal stakeholders.

  • Broad working knowledge of APIs across the advertising, media, and ad-tech ecosystem (e.g., DSPs, programmatic platforms, measurement and attribution partners, audio and CTV systems), with a track record of using them to extend product capability.

  • Comfort working closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Data Science functions; able to engage substantively on data models, BI tooling, and measurement frameworks without owning them.

  • Experience standing up product governance, intake frameworks, and prioritization processes in organizations transitioning from ad hoc to durable operating models.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong communicator and executive-level storyteller; can move comfortably between vendor architecture reviews, leadership strategy discussions, and client-facing conversations.

  • Pragmatic and business-oriented, with an appreciation for balancing ideal product strategy with real-world commercial and operational constraints.

  • High ownership mindset; comfortable being the only product leader in the room and building the function from the ground up.

  • Collaborative, curious, and motivated by building durable systems that compound the value of every team they touch.

Ad Results Media is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and believe strong product organizations are built at the intersection of operational excellence, business judgment, and a deep understanding of how teams and clients actually work.

Profesor/a Universitario/a PhD

Negocio, Marketing & Innovación en Salud
Grado Universitario en Liderazgo Biofarmacéutico, Innovación y Tecnología en Salud
📍 Remoto / Media Jornada
✨ ¿Te gustaría formar parte de un proyecto educativo que busca reinventar cómo se forma el talento en salud en España?

Desde HR Lean, acompañamos a Farma Leaders Talento en la incorporación del profesorado para el lanzamiento de un nuevo grado universitario desarrollado junto a la Universidad Camilo José Cela.

Se trata de un proyecto académico innovador que nace para reducir la distancia entre la investigación científica y la implementación real de la innovación en el mercado, formando profesionales capaces de liderar la transformación del sector Farma, Biotec y de tecnología sanitaria.

Buscamos docentes que quieran ir más allá de la enseñanza tradicional y participar en un modelo educativo basado en aprendizaje activo, proyectos reales y metodologías innovadoras.

🎓 Áreas docentes abiertas

Buscamos un/a profesor/a responsable para asignaturasdentro de las siguientes áreas:

  • Fundamentos de Marketing y Comportamiento del Consumidor (6 ECTS)

  • Fundamentos de Análisis de Mercado (6 ECTS)

  • Fundamentos de modelos de Negocio en Salud (6 ECTS)

  • Fundamentos de Emprendimiento y Gestión Empresarial (6 ECTS)

  • Economía de Empresa (6 ECTS)

◾ ¿Cómo será tu rol?

Fase 1 | Diseño académico (Junio – septiembre 2026)

  • Diseño del proyecto docente junto al equipo académico.

  • Preparación y grabación de contenidos asíncronos y materiales formativos.

  • Desarrollo de entregables y experiencias de aprendizaje.

Fase 2 | Docencia y acompañamiento (a partir de Septiembre)

  • Impartición de docencia síncrona online (principalmente entre septiembre y mayo)

  • Tutorías y seguimiento del alumnado.

  • Evaluación y acompañamiento del aprendizaje.

La dedicación aproximada por asignatura es de 30 horas por cuatrimestre (15h de docencia + 15h de tutoría) para grupos de hasta 30 alumnos.
En caso de superar este número, la carga docente se ampliaría proporcionalmente.

Horarios de las clases: preferentemente por la tarde, pero tendrán flexibilidad y se coordinará según la agenda del profesor.

◾Modalidad de colaboración

  • Junio – septiembre 2026: colaboración profesional en modalidad freelance.

  • Desde el inicio del curso académico (Septiembre): contratación docente a través de la Universidad Camilo José Cela en modalidad remota, con posibilidad de encuentros puntuales presenciales en Madrid, previamente coordinados.

◾ Requisitos

  • Imprescindible Doctorado (PhD) en el área relacionada con la asignatura.

  • Nivel de inglés C1.

  • Acreditación ANECA (valorable; si no la tienes, también puedes aplicar).

Valoraremos especialmente

  • Experiencia docente universitaria.

  • Experiencia profesional en industria farmacéutica, biotecnológica y de tecnología sanitaria; consultoría en salud; gestión sanitaria.

  • Conocimiento de metodologías activas de aprendizaje.

  • Familiaridad con herramientas digitales y entornos colaborativos (Notion u otras), así como uso de IA aplicada a docencia.

  • Mentalidad colaborativa y orientación a la innovación educativa.

◾ ¿Qué encontrarás en este proyecto?

  • Participar en el lanzamiento de un grado universitario pionero.

  • Modelo educativo innovador centrado en el estudiante.

  • Trabajo colaborativo con un equipo académico multidisciplinar.

  • Docencia flexible en formato remoto.

◾ Importante antes de aplicar

Durante el proceso de candidatura te pediremos que selecciones:

  • el área docente de tu especialidad

  • las asignaturas con las que tienes mayor afinidad

  • tu experiencia académica y profesional relacionada

  • tu nivel de inglés (certificado).

Si crees que la educación puede transformar carreras, industrias y personas, y te gustaría formar parte de este nuevo proyecto académico, estaremos encantados de conocerte.🔝

Sobre nosotros

En HR LEAN nos especializamos en búsqueda de talento, desarrollo de recursos humanos y mejora continua, poniendo a las personas en el centro de la organización. Nuestro objetivo es facilitar que los candidatos encuentren la oportunidad laboral que buscan y que las empresas consigan el equipo que necesitan para alcanzar sus objetivos, asegurando una integración adecuada en la cultura y el equipo corporativo.

En HR LEAN, estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno laboral inclusivo donde cada individuo sea valorado y respetado por sus talentos y habilidades. Creemos firmemente que la diversidad enriquece nuestras organizaciones y comunidades, y nos esforzamos por garantizar igualdad de oportunidades.

🌱 Asimismo, estamos comprometidos con el medioambiente, intentando reducir al máximo el uso del papel en nuestros procesos de selección.

jobs.title: Vice President of TV & Direct Response Media
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. About Sell2Rent Sell2Rent is a Miami-based residential real estate company pioneering the sale-leaseback: we help homeownerssell their home and stay in it as renters, unlocking their equity without moving.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About Sell2Rent
Sell2Rent is a Miami-based residential real estate company pioneering the sale-leaseback: we help homeowners
sell their home and stay in it as renters, unlocking their equity without moving. Our customers are equity-rich,
cash-constrained homeowners at real financial inflection points — divorce, debt, retirement, or the need for
business capital. Most have never heard of a sale-leaseback, and many start skeptical. That makes marketing the
growth engine of this company: education creates the category, trust converts it, and disciplined lead economics
make it profitable.
The Opportunity
We have product-market fit, transaction history, strategic capital partners, and a seven-figure media portfolio
already secured — national Spanish-language TV, local broadcast news, DRTV, CTV, and out-of-home. Your first
year isn’t about fighting for budget; it’s about deploying real firepower brilliantly and proving the unit economics
that justify scaling far beyond it.
For the right candidate, success here means becoming a foundational leader of a growing team at the front of
an emerging asset class — residential sale-leaseback — with the chance to define how an entire category is
marketed on television in America. As the company scales, this role scales with it: the leader who deploys this
portfolio brilliantly and delivers the numbers will grow in title, scope, and compensation as Sell2Rent grows.
Successful performance will be rewarded accordingly: the right leader will be considered for stock options in the
company, because we want someone who builds enterprise value and owns a piece of what they build.
The Role
You own television end-to-end: strategy, buying, negotiation, creative direction, delivery verification,
measurement, and the budget behind it — including our secured media portfolio of national Spanish-language
TV, local broadcast, DRTV, CTV, and adjacent offline media (DOOH, cinema).
This role runs the TV side. Our existing digital marketing team — organic/SEO, Google Ads, and outbound calling
  • continues to be led by our current VP of Marketing. The two of you operate one funnel under one acquisition-
cost discipline: television creates demand and generates leads at scale; digital captures, nurtures, and retargets
them. You are peers with complementary mandates, and the handoff between your channels is where this
company wins.
This is a hands-on operator role — not brand, not communications. The question that defines the job: “If we put
another $1 million on television, where will the next profitable transactions come from?” You must be able to
answer it with data, and be accountable for the answer.
Two Non-Negotiable Requirements
1. Mastery and control of television as a lead-generation medium. You have personally negotiated with
networks and station groups (rates, dayparts, adjacency, make-goods), built and scaled DRTV and CTV campaigns
with lead attribution to spot and daypart, verified delivery against post-logs yourself, and made weekly kill/scale
decisions on TV using cost-per-lead and cost-per-transaction. Overseeing an agency that did this does not
qualify.
2. Deep residential real estate experience acquiring home sellers. A substantial career chapter marketing to
homeowners who want or need to sell — with a real estate wholesaling operation, home-buying / “we buy
houses” company, iBuyer, sale-leaseback or home equity platform, or seller-side lead-gen business — ideally
with television as a primary channel. You natively know motivated-seller economics (cost per lead, appointment,
contract, close), seller triggers, speed-to-lead discipline, and how to market to homeowners under pressure
without ever being predatory.
A candidate missing either pillar is not a candidate, regardless of title.
Core Responsibilities
  • Own the television budget and P&L: allocation across networks, stations, and dayparts, with CPL and cost-
per-closed-transaction targets for TV-driven leads
  • Deploy the media portfolio — national Spanish-language TV (~20% of media, executed through the right
creative and intake resources), local broadcast news, DRTV, CTV, and adjacent offline media (DOOH,
cinema) — through trigger-based campaigns (divorce, debt, retirement, business capital) in 3–5
concentrated metros
  • Negotiate directly with networks and station groups; verify delivery against post-logs; enforce make-goods
and remedies
  • Direct TV creative: briefs, :30/:60/:120 direct-response spots, long-form formats, and testing rotations —
managing production partners to output
  • Build TV response measurement and attribution from scratch, and integrate it into company-wide
acquisition reporting
  • Partner with the VP of Marketing on retargeting, landing pages, and lead handoff so TV-driven demand is
captured digitally — and with sales on lead definitions and speed-to-lead

Requirements

  • 8+ years in direct-response/performance marketing; 5+ years leading marketing or media teams where
revenue depended on consumer lead generation
  • Both non-negotiable pillars above, with CPL/CAC numbers you can defend line by line
  • $1M+ annual media budgets managed, television as the major component
  • Built measurement infrastructure from scratch; managed production and agency ecosystems
  • Preferred but not required: Spanish-language TV experience; long-form educational content; credit/barter
media structures; metro-concentration strategies; category-creation experience
Who This Role Is Not For
Digital-only performance marketers who have never controlled television; agency-side TV veterans without in-
house P&L ownership; marketers without residential real estate seller-acquisition experience; brand or
communications executives; big-company delegators who haven’t personally placed a buy or read a post-log in
years; anyone whose instinct is to report impressions when asked how marketing is doing.
If, instead, you read “own cost per closed transaction across DRTV, local broadcast, and CTV for a category
America hasn’t heard of yet” and felt your pulse pick up — we should talk.

Benefits

Compensation
Competitive base salary, performance bonus tied directly to TV-driven CAC and transaction targets, and stock
option consideration for the right candidate — a package built for a leader who wants their upside tied to
enterprise value in an emerging asset class, not capped at a salary.

jobs.excerpt: About Us Nox Health is a global sleep health leader on a mission to improve people’s lives through better sleep.
jobs.description:
About Us

Nox Health is a global sleep health leader on a mission to improve people’s lives through better sleep. Every year, more than three million people in 50 countries benefit from Nox products and services.

Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, and with operations in Reykjavík, Iceland, Denver, Colorado, and Vila Nova de Gaia, Portugal, Nox provides a range of solutions from comprehensive sleep diagnostic technology for providers to value-based comprehensive sleep management programs for self-insured employers and payers.

Nox is a wake-up call for healthcare providers, payers, and sleep-deprived people everywhere. Most people are being left in the dark regarding all the health issues that poor sleep impacts. Even for those who are aware of these issues, there are limited human, medical, and technological resources available to address sleep problems.

At Nox, we enable a consumer-centric experience, leveraging our state-of-the-art technology portfolio and value-based sleep management solutions to simplify access, reduce costs, and improve health outcomes.

Nox has three market-facing business lines: Sleep Diagnostic Solutions, Sleep Care Management, and Prescription Digital Therapeutics.

The Nox Cloud Platform was designed to connect all the different groups involved in a person's sleep health care—individuals (Population), Payers, and Providers.

Nox is currently expanding the use of the Nox Cloud infrastructure beyond the initial SleepCharge (Nox Health Enterprise business) while simultaneously enhancing the user experience for each group, including creating dedicated access and tailored plans.

About the role

The Role We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer who loves the balance between high-level system design and hands-on coding. In this role, you will split your time 50/50 between two critical areas:

  1. Upstream Architecture (50%): You will act as the technical anchor in a multidisciplinary triad alongside Product Managers and Product Owners. You will translate Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) into comprehensive Technical Design Documents (TDDs), defining the architecture, assessing feasibility, and providing the estimates that shape our roadmap.
  2. Hands-On Execution (50%): You won't just design systems and hand them off. You will embed with one of our four Scrum teams as an active developer. You will help the team break your TDDs down into actionable user stories, write production-ready code in Java/Kotlin, and mentor the team through code reviews and technical hurdles.

Key Responsabilities

  • Architect & Design: Lead the technical design of new commercial cloud products, creating highly scalable, secure, and resilient microservices architectures on AWS.
  • Collaborate Upstream: Partner directly with Product Management to evaluate PRDs, identify technical trade-offs, and establish concrete TDDs.
  • Build & Code: Spend half your time in the trenches with your Scrum team, contributing high-quality, maintainable code across our stack (Java, Kotlin, Angular).
  • Lead the Breakdown: Guide developers in translating high-level TDDs into well-scoped user stories and sprint deliverables.
  • Mentor & Elevate: Raise the technical bar for the team through code reviews, pairing, and establishing engineering best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Deep Technical Expertise: Extensive experience building highly scalable microservices using Java and/or Kotlin.
  • Cloud Native: Proven experience designing and deploying distributed systems.
  • Database Mastery: Strong working knowledge of both relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases.
  • Full-Stack Awareness: While the heavy lifting is in the backend/cloud, you should have experience or comfort working with frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Architectural Chops: A track record of writing clear technical design documents, architectural proposals, or RFCs.
  • Agile Leadership: Experience working in a Scrum environment and a knack for breaking down complex architectural epics into digestible developer tasks.
  • Communication Skills: You can explain complex technical constraints to a Product Manager just as easily as you can explain a design pattern to a junior developer.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with the healthcare technology sector, highly regulated environments, SaaS platforms, or sleep diagnostics.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Experience or familiarity with continuous integration/continuous deployment processes.

Why Join us?

  • Impact: Contribute to life-changing solutions that significantly improve patient outcomes and make a real difference in the field of sleep medicine.
  • Growth: Be part of a dynamic company in a major growth phase, offering unparalleled opportunities for career advancement and professional development.
  • Innovation: Work in a forward-thinking environment where your ideas, technical expertise, and contributions will be highly valued and recognized.
  • Collaboration: Join a global team of passionate innovators, doctors, and technologists dedicated to making a difference in healthcare through technology.

jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyThe company is a fast-growing PropTech organization in the United States, transforming the rental industry through innovative technology and solutions designed to expand housing access for renters while helping landlords and property managers improve occupancy and leasing conversion.
jobs.description:
About the Company

The company is a fast-growing PropTech organization in the United States, transforming the rental industry through innovative technology and solutions designed to expand housing access for renters while helping landlords and property managers improve occupancy and leasing conversion.

The company works with property owners and managers to address qualification gaps caused by conditional approvals, limited credit histories, and the absence of guarantors. Its mission is to create better opportunities for renters while helping housing providers convert demand into signed leases.

Our Mission

The company is focused on expanding access to housing by helping landlords approve more qualified renters without increasing risk.

By partnering with owners and property managers, the company helps close the qualification gap and improve leasing conversion and occupancy. The long-term vision is to become a widely adopted solution across the U.S. rental market, creating greater housing choice while helping property owners and operators grow their businesses.

Our Hiring Philosophy

We seek exceptional talent with relentless intellectual curiosity—individuals who:

  • Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement.
  • Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues.
  • Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize.
  • Create innovative solutions others believe are impossible.

We deliberately seek rare, high-impact performers who attract similar talent. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard.

We believe exceptional talent is the foundation for building exceptional companies. By assembling a team of high-performing individuals, we are creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and establish new standards of excellence.

The Opportunity

We are expanding our executive presence on LinkedIn and are looking for an exceptional content professional to help shape how the company and its leadership are perceived in the market.

This is not a standard content marketing role.

You will own the voice of senior leaders, transforming rough ideas, voice notes, conversations, and business updates into compelling content that builds brand authority, generates meaningful engagement, and positions the company as a defining player in the U.S. PropTech and rental market.

You will work directly with the Head of Marketing and company founders, meaning your work will have a direct impact on how the industry perceives the organization.

Every post, thread, and campaign will be a direct representation of the company. Speed, originality, and strong editorial judgment are non-negotiable.

Important Note

This is a writing role in the truest sense.

We expect original and creative thinking that demonstrates a genuine understanding of the business, audience, and brand voice. There will be a written component as part of the interview process.

Candidates whose submissions rely heavily on AI-generated content will not move forward. AI is used as a workflow and productivity tool—not as a ghostwriter.

Key Responsibilities

  • Executive content strategy and production: Own the LinkedIn presence of founders and senior leaders, transforming voice notes, rough ideas, and business updates into polished, high-performing content that builds authority and drives engagement.
  • Brand voice and consistency: Define and maintain a distinct tone of voice for the company and key executives across written channels, ensuring every piece of content sounds authentic, credible, and aligned with the brand.
  • Content calendar and execution: Plan, schedule, and publish content across LinkedIn and relevant channels while managing multiple drafts, revisions, and feedback cycles with discipline and speed.
  • SEO and GEO integration: Incorporate keyword strategy and search optimization into content production without compromising voice, readability, or authenticity. Contribute to visibility across traditional and AI-driven search environments.
  • Performance analysis and iteration: Track content performance and engagement metrics, using data and feedback to continuously improve strategy, tone, and content quality.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with the Head of Marketing and founders to align content with product launches, partnerships, market trends, company milestones, and strategic initiatives.
  • Competitive and trend intelligence: Monitor competitors, industry leaders, and emerging trends on LinkedIn to identify opportunities for differentiation and thought leadership.

About You

We are looking for someone exceptional who takes ownership of the brand and its communication.

You have a natural understanding of LinkedIn and know what makes people stop scrolling, read, and engage.

You bring fresh, original ideas to every conversation and hold yourself to a very high standard of writing and strategic thinking.

You work quickly, take responsibility, and thrive in environments where things are not always clearly defined.

You can take a short voice note, conversation, or rough idea and transform it into compelling content without requiring extensive direction.

Everything you create has a clear purpose and contributes to business growth.

Preferred Experience

We are looking for an exceptional writer with a genuine passion for brand, content, and storytelling—someone who understands LinkedIn deeply and knows how to create content that educates, challenges perspectives, and converts.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in content creation, copywriting, editorial content, or brand writing, ideally within technology, real estate, fintech, PropTech, or startup environments.
  • Demonstrable experience writing for founders, executives, or high-profile individuals on LinkedIn, supported by a portfolio showcasing range, originality, and strong editorial judgment.
  • Strong understanding of SEO and GEO, with the ability to write for both human audiences and search engines without sacrificing quality or authenticity.
  • Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and transform a voice note, rough brief, or half-formed idea into compelling content.
  • Fluency with AI tools for research, ideation, and workflow acceleration, combined with strong editorial discipline to ensure content remains original and human.
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working directly with senior leadership in a fast-moving, high-expectation environment.
  • Genuine curiosity about people, businesses, real estate, technology, and how category-defining companies build their brands publicly.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

This is an opportunity to join a rapidly growing U.S. PropTech company at a pivotal stage of its growth.

You will play a direct role in accelerating the company's commercial expansion while helping housing providers create better experiences for residents, renters, and property teams across the country.

You will work alongside a team of exceptional performers, have direct access to senior leadership, and have significant ownership over outcomes from day one.

The organization moves quickly, values high performance, and gives talented individuals the autonomy to make a meaningful impact.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive, above-market compensation; compensation is optimized for the right candidate.
  • Remote-first working environment.
  • Annual company offsite in international locations.
  • High-autonomy, low-bureaucracy environment.
  • Direct access to founders and senior leadership.
  • Significant ownership and visibility within the organization.

Working Environment

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating with speed, accountability, autonomy, and a high degree of ownership.

The right person will be energized by the opportunity to build within a rapidly growing company, work closely with senior leadership, and play a meaningful role in shaping how the organization is perceived by its customers, partners, and the broader industry.

Why This Is a Dream Job

You’ll be working directly with an established, scaling South Australian business (Solar Power Direct) who:

  • Values Your Growth: Builds deep, in-demand expertise in trades management software (SimPro) and provides access to an assigned Success Manager (CSM) for professional coaching through your first 90 days.

You’ll get career transformation, high-level visibility, and genuine ownership of critical operations—without being stuck in a generalist "virtual assistant" rut.

You aren't just filing forms; you are catching errors before they reach install day, maintaining clean stock levels, and ensuring field crews have accurate information.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • SimPro Job Scheduling: Keeping SimPro job schedules updated in real time, liaising daily with the job allocator to reflect on-the-ground changes accurately.

  • End-to-End Purchasing: Raising and tracking Purchase Orders in SimPro, chasing supplier confirmations within 24 hours, and logging receipts consistently.

  • Data Integrity & Auditing: Conducting regular stock and component audits to eliminate phantom/incorrect stock data before it impacts live job installs.

  • Supplier Communication: Serving as the reliable point of contact for vendor follow-ups, resolving stock/cost discrepancies proactively.

Requirements

  • Are a SimPro Power User: You have direct, hands-on experience managing job scheduling and purchasing modules within SimPro Enterprise.

  • Are a Data Guardian: You catch errors before they become problems, possess a natural inclination to double-check details, and treat discrepancies as challenges to solve.

  • Are an AI-Adaptive Operator: You actively use modern AI tools to streamline administrative tasks and speed up supplier follow-ups.

  • Have prior experience in trades, solar, electrical, or field-service operations administration.

  • Are High-Accountability: You manage dual workstreams (scheduling and purchasing) independently without needing daily hand-holding.

  • Communicate with elite fluency and professional confidence in written and spoken English.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • The System is Fortified: SimPro job schedules are updated same-day with zero unresolved scheduling discrepancies flagged by the job allocator.

  • Production is Seamless: Purchase orders are issued on time, supplier confirmations are logged within 24 hours, and no follow-ups fall through the cracks.

  • Impact is Measured: Stock and component data discrepancies show a measurable reduction, eliminating install-day delays caused by stock errors.

  • Trust is Earned: The operations team relies on your data accuracy so completely that routine schedule and PO updates no longer require double-checking.

Final Word If you’ve ever thought: "I am an operations specialist who knows SimPro inside out and catches errors before they happen—I just want a client who is organized and values my technical depth," this is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) Fellowship brings together top researchers and domain experts to collaborate on high-impact work that are shaping the future of AI.   • Collaborative Work: Get invited to engage in high-impact projects with our partnered AI labs and platforms. Design complex, domain-specific problems and datasets to rigorously evaluate AI models, and provide expert insights that enhance their accuracy, reasoning, and overall performance.

  • Competitive Pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and are depending on a number of factors, including but not limited to; projects, scope, skillset, and location.

  • The Analytical Technical Lead (ATL) is the single global point of contact and accountable owner for analytical lifecycle management of assigned commercial products across major markets (US, EU, China, Australia, Canada) and supports Rest of World (RoW) expansion and post-approval maintenance.

  • At Director level, this role is responsible for making risk-based, inspection-defensible decisions on methods, specifications, stability, and analytical investigations across a distributed internal/external QC network for small molecule products.

  • This leader ensures the analytical control strategy remains robust over the product lifecycle, drives harmonization, and enables reliable supply while meeting GMP, pharmacopeial, and regulatory expectations.

  • The Analytical Technical Lead (ATL) may own relevant global business processes, ensure compliance and efficiency.

Essential Functions of the Job:

A. Global Analytical Point of Contact (PoC) for Approved Commercial Products

  • Act as the global PoC for all analytical-related matters for assigned products, to ensure analytical readiness.

  • Provide governance and technical leadership for analytical topics spanning drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), and critical raw materials/reagents as applicable.

  • Translate global product strategy into aligned expectations and deliverables for internal QC sites, external QC labs/CMOs, AST, and MST.

B. Analytical Lifecycle Management: Changes, Deviations, and Investigations

  • Lead and approve strategy for analytical investigations and performance issues (OOS/OOT/OOE, atypical results, invalidations), ensuring scientifically sound root cause analysis and effective CAPA, including method optimization.

  • Drive analytical change control impact assessments and execution plans, including method updates, revalidation/verification, reference standard changes, and instrument/software upgrades.

  • Own escalation management for supply-critical analytical events; align actions with Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain.

C. Global Business Process & Knowledge Owner: Methods, Specifications, Stability, Retest/Shelf Life

  • Serve as global business process and knowledge owner for:

    • Commercial analytical method lifecycle (validation/verification strategy, transfers, periodic review, trending, method robustness improvements)

    • Global specifications governance (release and stability), including harmonization and lifecycle updates

    • Stability program ownership (protocol strategy, commitments, pull schedules, trending, annual review narratives)

    • Retest period/shelf-life governance (extensions, commitments, labeling impacts, country-specific constraints)

  • Take over “submission-ready” documentation sources from development: analytical control strategy, method history, validation packages, specification rationale, and stability trend narratives.

  • Ensure defensible alignment between analytical control strategy and product risk profile (CQAs/CPPs), including small-molecule impurity control.

D. Regulatory Support: RoW Filings and Post-Approval Variations

  • Provide analytical SME leadership for global regulatory submissions relevant to QC:

    • RoW filings (Module 3 analytical sections, stability commitments, method/spec alignment)

    • Post-approval changes (variations, supplements), including comparability narratives and analytical bridging

  • Partner with Regulatory CMC on health authority interactions and responses related to analytical controls, stability trends, and specification justification.

E. Partner and Network Oversight (Internal QC and External Labs/CMOs)

  • Provide governance for external QC networks: align expectations, metrics, investigation quality, and issue escalation pathways (with ESQ as needed).

  • Contribute to audits/inspections as product analytical SME; ensure inspection readiness for assigned products and analytical systems.

  • Influence lab capacity planning and capability upgrades with a risk-based view.

  • N/A
